data.//: intentionally reload only because flechette shot is not available commercially or used by the military
data.description: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts, definitely not a factory loading.  Flechettes won't pattern as well as normal shot, and they'll likely do less damage.  However, they may fare better against armor than other shotgun loads.

This antiquated single shot pistol would complete a pirate's outfit nicely.  While its loading may be slow, it does not require brass casings to fire, and is theoretically sustainable.  Range and accuracy are hampered by lack of rifling, but this old design is still plenty lethal.

This is an old revolver designed during the period of westward expansion.  Black powder paper cartridges must be loaded for each shot, which is a fairly lengthy process.  Despite its age, this type of weapon would perform adequately against most two-legged threats.

An antique design, this smoothbore long arm would look more at home on a pre-1850's battlefield than in your hands in the Cataclysm.  Its loading may be slow, but it does not require brass casings to fire, and is theoretically sustainable to fire.  Range and accuracy are hampered by lack of rifling, but this time-tested design is plenty lethal.

A single discharge from this plasma rifle easily melts through conventional armor and flash-incinerates anything behind it, but its state of disrepair limits the number of shots it can fire in quick succession.

Even a second of exposure to the plasma fan generated by this weapon is enough to flash-incinerate anything, but its state of disrepair limits the amount of time its destructive power can be sustained.

An older single shot grenade launcher, looking something like a sawn off shotgun.  Though it's mostly been replaced by underbarrel launchers, dedicated models like this have seen use by law enforcement and riot personnel.  Still deadly against hard or soft targets, depending on what cartridges are available.

This large, clumsy looking launcher looks like the offspring of a machine gun and a mortar; its bore is huge, and its action is just as massive.  A huge belt of grenade cartridges loads into its tray, allowing several grenades to be launched in rapid succession.  If one grenade fired from this isn't enough to solve your problems, surely a dozen more are.  This must be mounted on a frame to be fired, and reloading is a bit slow.

data.//: more like granadepistole
data.description: A stubby single shot pistol with a large bore barrel, suitable for launching grenades or flares.  This is a slightly more convenient way to transport a grenade launcher than mounted to one's rifle, a practice more common among special forces.  In more recent years, variants were sold commercially to ostensibly launch flares.  With the right cartridges, this would be devastating against hard or soft targets.  This could be attached to a suitable rifle, if so desired.

use_action.msg: You make the launcher ready for attachment.

data.description: Looking something like a large revolver from a cartoon this launcher is capable of firing six grenades in rapid succession.  Its huge cylinder is wound by a clock spring, which hastens firing, but slows reloading, as it must be re-wound.  Needless to say, six well placed shots is an incredible amount of firepower, depending on the cartridges loaded.

Since the early days of western expansion, when ammunition supply was infrequent, shooters sought to share ammo between their sidearms and long arms.  This tube magazine lever-action carbine allows the shooter to reduce the number of calibers carried and squeeze more power from their pistol ammunition.

This pistol is a tiny machinegun you can stuff into a holster, with which you could dump its magazine at a blistering rate into any close range foes.  Machine pistols mostly see use by vehicle crewmen or bodyguards of VIPs.  Due to its preposterous rate of fire it is difficult to control.

A modern pistol fit for duty, military service, or personal defense, with a detachable box magazine and a reliable action.  Though its chambering is capable of meeting FBI penetration minimums, the lack of a shoulder stock limits its utility.

data.name: survivalist carbine
data.description: These small carbines share ammunition and magazines with common pistols, offering a more controllable carbine than a normal rifle, while also reducing ammunition costs.  Because of their compatibility, they pair well with duty pistols, allowing one to transition to a more stable weapon without carrying extra ammo or magazines.

Revolvers like this, chambered for standard defensive calibers, were a favorite of police departments for nearly a century, up until the 1986 Miami shootout.  Afterwards, the slow reloading and shooting of revolvers were considered liabilities; still, this model's accuracy and moderate recoil make for a serviceable sidearm, and there are no magazines for you to lose or damage.

data.name: submachine gun
data.description: Chambered in common pistol ammunition, this compact long arm is perfect for trench raiders, vehicular crewmen, SWAT teams and special forces.  Though not as accurate as a proper rifle, especially at longer ranges, it is very controllable in automatic fire.  It feeds from detachable box magazines, which are easy to unload into close range targets.

data.name: survivor subgun
data.description: A crudely constructed fully automatic submachinegun, accepting standard pistol and submachine gun magazines.  The heavy bolt makes accurate fire difficult, and its questionable construction makes for poor reliability and longevity.  Similar designs of desperation from the Second World War served their nations well enough, so this should be good for zombies… right?  Accepts standard pistol ammunition.

This large pistol is almost as heavy as a small carbine, and just about as powerful too.  Chambered in hard hitting magnum calibers, it is suitable for hunting medium game, humans, or offsetting any of one's perceived deficiencies.  Though traditionally such magnums are revolvers, this one is a magazine fed semi-automatic.
data.//: We're just going to pretend that .357 and .44 magnum deagles will run .38's and .44 special just fine

data.description: A modern re-imagining of the classic western lever-action, this larger rifle accepts powerful magnum pistol ammunition as well as weaker pistol ammo.  Carrying this along side a magnum pistol would allow one to reduce the number of calibers carried, and allow you to squeeze more power from ammunition.

A crudely constructed carbine, chambered for magnum pistol ammo and standard pistol ammo.  It feeds from commercial magnum pistol magazines, and locks with a rudimentary lever-action system.  Its powerful cartridge and relative precision should serve well against zombies and medium game.

A firearm made from a stout pipe, reinforced at the chamber.  It holds a single a round of standard or magnum pistol ammunition, and has a crude assembly to fire it.  There's no extractor, so it might be slow to reload, and its construction makes for poor reliability and longevity.

Early handgun hunters helped develop this revolver's magnum ammunition from standard calibers, which needed heavier revolvers to safely fire it.  These revolvers' cylinders can thus chamber both magnum and standard pistol ammunition.  You could take medium to large game with this hefty piece.

With near non-existent recoil and inexpensive ammunition, rifles like this one are popular introductory firearms.  It has a built in magazine, capable of holding an impressive amount of its small cartridges.  You could take small game with this, but anything bigger might not even notice.

data.name: target pistol
data.description: This medium sized pistol fires cheap and plentiful plinking ammo, and is exceptionally popular for practice or target shooting.  This pistol is unsuited for taking on anything but small game, as it is meant to poke holes in paper.  Accepts box magazines.

data.name: zip gun
data.description: A crude single shot firearm made from improvised or homemade components, chambered for tiny plinking ammunition.  Zip guns like these often turned up in the hands of criminals and insurgents.  There's no extractor, so it might be slow to reload, and its construction leaves its longevity in question.
A cheap varmint air rifle chambered in .177, suitable for hunting small game.

The products of decades of improvement, rifle such as this are handy, reliable, and adaptable.  An 'assault rifle', it is capable of providing both accurate semi-automatic fire and bursts of automatic fire.  Short of large creatures and light vehicles, this should take care of most of your problems out to several hundred meters.

The light machine gun is a formidable implement for suppressive fire, an important part of squad tactics.  Its belt feed allows for hundreds of rounds to be loaded, and its heavy components can withstand long bursts of fire.  While perhaps not as precise as a service rifle, a light machinegun does allow for a considerable amount of energy to be sent down range.  Slow to reload.

data.name: sniper rifle
data.description: Sniper rifles fill military, police and civilian needs for precise, accurate fire.  Modern examples feature detachable magazines and various mounting interfaces for optics and supports.  With care and practice, all should be quite capable of eliminating bipedal threats from very safe ranges.

data.name: sporter carbine
data.description: Though often mislabeled an assault rifle, this common, cheap magazine fed carbine isn't capable of automatic fire.  While almost as effective as a proper rifle, the wider variety of components and varying levels of maintenance make these less reliable than their military brethren.  These rifles are just as adequate for taking on anything smaller than large game, however.

A battle rifle popular among the Exodii.  Reliable and powerful, though slightly unwieldy to use as an infantry weapon.  Just different enough from local weaponry that the same ammunition cannot be shared between them.

data.name: foreign sniper rifle
data.description: A sniper rifle popular among the Exodii.  Just different enough from local weaponry that the same ammunition cannot be shared between them.

data.name: foreign cannon rifle
data.description: A powerful Exodii rifle, reserved for the later stage of cataclysm.  It should be considered an anti-tank rifle in modern world, but the round is bigger than any anti-tank round on Earth.

data.name: railgun rifle
data.description: A handheld railgun which magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Powered by UPS.

data.name: combination rifle shotgun
data.description: A break action firearm comprised of a rifle barrel over two smooth bore shotgun barrels.  Historically used by egomaniac hunters in Africa, now used by their egomaniac descendants in New England.

Large, intimidating, and overbuilt, this hefty rifle fires huge projectiles with relative precision.  Though it resembles a sniper rifle, this anti-material weapon is best suited for blinding tanks, shooting at aircraft, or destroying explosives.  It feeds from comically oversized magazines.

Elegantly engraved, with deep glossy blued steel and figured wood, this break-action double rifle is almost too nice to shoot.  Your shoulder might beg you not to; the chambers are almost wide enough for two fingers and the recoil is monstrous.  You could probably kill anything with this, especially if you were to fire both barrels at once.

This large, ungainly  belt-fed machine gun fires huge projectiles, originally intended for turn of the century anti-vehicular use.  While no longer suitable for modern tanks or aircraft, thinner skinned vehicles or drones are just as susceptible, as are any other 'smaller' threats.  Slow to reload, incredibly loud, and must be mounted to be fired.

Constructed of fiberglass, with crude plastic sights and a titanium barrel, this is a launcher for a single rocket.  Though not as effective as other anti-armor weapons, the true value in this disposable rocket launcher is its portability and lack of dead weight once expended.  Has a backblast, so make sure nothing you mind destroying is behind you.

This heavy, gigantic rifled tube features a complex optical sight and can launch a wide variety of payloads, including rockets or laser guided missiles.  Depending on the warhead loaded, such weapons are effective against older tanks, most vehicles, bunkers and personnel.  These are meant to be operated by a two-man crew, so reloading might be a bit slow.  Its recoilless design allows for superior range and damage, but it produces tremendous backblast, so make sure nothing you mind destroying is behind you.

An old-fashioned double barreled shotgun, with a trigger for each barrel.  Follow up shots are incredibly quick with this, but reloading is a bit slow.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.

A crudely handmade double barreled shotgun, with a trigger for each barrel.  Follow up shots are incredibly quick with this, but reloading is slow, as there are no extractors or ejectors.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.

data.name: sporting shotgun
data.description: A simple, popular design, sporting shotguns are used by law enforcement, civilians and occasionally militaries.  Its internal magazine is small by modern standards, and reloading can be quite slow.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.

data.name: short shotgun
data.description: A simple, shotgun without a stock used by law enforcement and occasionally militaries.  Its internal magazine is small, and reloading can be quite slow.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.

data.name: tactical shotgun
data.description: A detachable magazine fed shotgun, mostly oriented towards overly enthusiastic civilians.  Featuring rails and a menacing black appearance, this sort of shotgun doesn't really look like it has a sporting use.  The magazines reduce lengthy reloading times associated with shotguns.  Though known for being somewhat finicky, these can be tuned to run with some reliability.
A crude shotgun, composed of two thick steel pipes, an end cap, and a nail.  The lack of sights make this weapon only useful at point-blank range.
A crude shotgun, composed of four thick steel pipes, two end caps, and two nails.  The lack of sights make this weapon only useful at point-blank range.
Small shotgun, assembled from underbarrel shotgun modification and a pistol grip.  Not the best weapon, but has a really small size and weight.

data.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  Thousands of these were deployed by the US military before the Cataclysm and they were valued for their use in engaging anything up to light vehicles at long range without exposing the operator.  This one is fitted with a heavy machinegun.

Thousands of these were deployed by the US military before the Cataclysm and they were valued for their use in engaging infantry without exposing the operator.  This one is fitted with a light machine gun.

A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with a revolver grenade launcher.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.

These TALON-derived riot control platforms were widely publicized a few years before the Cataclysm as a new semi-autonomous device that could fire less-lethal rounds with far more accuracy than a human, ensuring safer hits against a target's limbs.  They were quickly adopted by prisons and inner city police forces, where they demonstrated that 'less lethal' is not the same as 'non-lethal'.  In the days before the Cataclysm, massive stockrooms of the things were put into circulation.  On the bright side, although it shoots autonomously, it requires a human operator to relocate, so it's not so mobile anymore.

text: Something snaps behind your eyes, and the world turns black.
A sudden sharp pain in your eyes, then you are lost in the darkness.
Your eyes fail you, and everything turns dark.
The lights grow uncomfortably bright.
The world starts turning wildly, and you stumble.
Your arms start itching.
Something is crawling under your skin.
You pause for a moment.  The movement under your skin doesn't.
Your arms hurt!
Your arms cramp!
Something shifts in your arm, painfully.
Your hands seize up for a moment, and you drop your weapon!
Your arms fall down paralyzed, and your weapon tumbles to the ground!

You are but a child again, fighting over the dinner's remains with your brothers and sisters.  There were times for mirth and playfulness, but this is not one of those - the time nears when the smallest will be cast aside, and you're all terrified of being chosen.

You soar above the plains, but the pickings are slim today.  The shadows lengthen already, and you turn homewards with a flick of your wings, steeling yourself to the disappointed cries of your chicks and another hungry night.  You must do better tomorrow, lest this year's brood will be lost too.
You long for the skies, to watch the tiny problems of the ground disappear below you.
You remember feeling less attached to the ground.  What are you missing?
You need more if you are to fly South before the cold comes.  Much more.
Is your beak strong enough?  Your feathers long?  No, you need more.
You need enough bird primer and catalyst in your system while you are sleeping to complete your change.
You won't be able to change without enough catalyst, the right primer and being asleep.

You prowl the forest with your nestmates in search of prey - you're a strong brood with bright feathers and sharp talons, but fortune seems to elude you lately.  You take them towards the edge of the forest, where the air always smells of smoke, and sneak up on a pack of monkeys with too-colorful fur sitting on a fallen tree and chattering amongst themselves.  The smallest notices you and waves excitedly, just before you pounce.

You dream of blood on your talons, and the air catching your feathers as you try to balance on your struggling prey.  It feels almost like a game, something you'd have played in a previous life.  Lost in thought you almost miss the moment when the threshing grows still, until your brothers' screech brings you back to the present - time to eat.
Slow.  Too slow.  Slower than prey.
You'll never wet your talons at this rate.  You need to become better.
Scenes of a chase, claws, blood on the leaves flash before your eyes.  You need more to truly understand it.
Not a care in the world, only the hunt.  How you wish you were that far gone already.
You need enough raptor primer and catalyst in your system while you are sleeping to complete your change.
You won't be able to change without enough catalyst, the right primer and being asleep.
<bird_dream>
<raptor_dream>

You are desperate to stop your disgusting ape hands from pulling out handfuls of your beautiful feathers, but they move on their own accord.  You manage to hold one of the useless things between your talons, and bring your beak down on it…Just a dream.  Still, food for thought.

You wake to a sudden itch in your arms, and you shake them vigorously.  To your painful surprise a new cover of long, strong feathers broke the surface, bloody dead skin and plumage falling on the ground.
<bird_dream>

Clouds surround you as you soar through the sky.  You look down and see the wilderness stretching out as far as the eye can see, but you can't stay here.  You need to go somewhere else, to the land of warmth and plenty.  Your eyes wander over your beautiful wings propelling you along, and you're mesmerized by their rhythmic beating.  Much better than your…hands.  You have hands, not wings.  Not yet.

You dream of jumping from a cliff for your first flight, but the feathers on your clumsy arms can't hold you.  You hit the ground, and your hands are mangled beyond recognition.  After waking, the pain persists, and you're startled to see your useless fingers snap and disappear in your rich plumage.  Good riddance, you think, before falling unconscious.
You need the right nectar, otherwise you will never be queen.
You long for a safe, dark place to complete your change.
You could build a hive, if only you were better.  What are you missing?
More of the <color_yellow> good nectar</color>.  That's what you need.
You can't be expected to metamorphose with so little.  You need more.
You need enough insect primer and catalyst in your system while you are sleeping to complete your change.
You won't be able to change without enough catalyst, the right primer and being asleep.

You and your sisters have worked diligently, made your home safe and prosperous.  You felt so proud.  But lately Mother has been growing slower, and more cells are empty than with brood.  You see hesitation on your sisters as well…does the hive need you to step up?  Would they follow?  Could you defeat Her?

You dream of a dark, damp place permeated by the smell of sawdust.  You feel like this is all you've ever known, each bend in the walls and scratch on the floor your handiwork.  It feels like home, but deep down you know that you'll have to change and emerge into the dangerous, light-battered outside.

You have stuffed yourself to bursting for the fourth time today, but your hunger doesn't abate.  You would need to escape your too-small skin to be able to eat enough, you're sure of it.  Take the knife to one of the stretch marks on your back, and part the skin - it springs to the side readily and with no pain.  You work your way down your sides, changing the knife between hands as needed and free your <color_light_green>new skin</color> from its fleshy prison.

Getting the bodybag was harder than you would have thought, and ordinary garbage bags would just not do.  You eat your fill for the last time with this mouth, undress (you won't need clothes after the change), and climb in the bag.  Closing the zipper from the inside is a challenge, but you need complete darkness for what comes now.  You wait.
And wait.
And wait.

Could you have been wrong?  You were so sure the time was right.
You need to get out of here, but you can't move your…anything.  Do you even have anything to move?
<insect_dream>

Your try going about your day as usual, but your vision seems to dim every few seconds for no reason.  You reach to your eyes in annoyance and feel a disgusting fleshy membrane periodically covering them with a squeaky, wet motion.  You grasp them tightly and pull hard despite the pain until they tear off with a shower of red ichor coating your eyes.  You lick it away, and finally you can see clearly.

After another day of dazed mundanity you make your way back home to your dingy cellar apartment, but miss a step and fall down the stairs, landing on your face with a wet thud.  Consciousness fades, but the pain stays.  The pain, and the feeling of myriad cockroach legs running on your skin, coating your wounds in a skittering, biting cloak.

You wake, shedding the weird apey memories, and you are stunned by a dizzying cavalcade of colors you could never have imagined before.  This is a step in the right direction, you decide, regarding your newly-expanded perspective with appreciation before the vertigo takes you.
<insect_eye_success>

You dream of a throbbing headache, and the feeling of an imminent molt.  You find a suitable recess, freeze in place and **push**, trying to rip your old exoskeleton up with you pressure of your new armor but nothing happens.  All the pressure seems to well up into your head, and finally you feel a wet snap and a shower of too-warm mammal ichor on your feelers.

You wake up in a puddle of your own blood under your head, a puddle you can see despite looking straight up.  It will be some time before your eyes' crystals harden properly, but already the colors are even richer than they were before, and the world seems somehow sluggish.

data.description: They said college what make me smart, this is a lot to lug around!
Your eyes bulge out several inches from your skull.  This does not affect your vision in any way.
Something is shifting painfully behind your eyeballs.  <color_red>This change will be reversible.  The next one might not be, should you continue.</color>

Your eyes have turned into iridescent spheres bulging out of their original sockets.  Your detail vision suffered terribly, and the expanded field of view is dizzying.  <color_red>You can still go back to how you used to be.  If you continue changing in this direction you will be permanently changed.  Progress from this state will need the matching threshold.</color>

You remember having tiny, unassuming eyes condemned into cramped slits in your face.  No more.  Since your last molt your eyes take up most of your head, giving you unparalelled reactions at the cost of fine vision.  You wouldn't want to cover up too much of the view, however.  <color_red>This change is permanent.</color>

Your legs have consolidated into a single muscular 'foot' that goes up into your belly.  You move about a fourth of your previous speed and can no longer wear pants or shoes, on the other hand you make significantly less noise.  In addition to being harder to knock down, you can move through sludge-covered surfaces easily.

Your arms feel…different.  Occasionally something shifts under the skin - sometimes it does so without pain.  Whatever is happening in there, it's far from done.  <color_red>This change will be reversible.  The next one might not be, should you continue.</color>

Your forearms are covered by long, stiff feathers.  While they are impressive to look at and resistant to water and other contaminants, they always get in the way and you hate it when they get filthy.  <color_red>You can still go back to how you used to be.  If you continue changing in this direction you will be permanently changed.  Progress from this state will need the matching threshold.</color>

Your arms have mostly transformed into a huge pair of feathered wings.  Though you retain a few fingers, your fine manipulation is greatly hampered.  On the other hand, you can glide from ledges and will take less damage if you fall, provided you're healthy and unburdened.
Your legs and feet have become bird-like, with long talons arranged three ahead and one behind.  They probably won't fit in human shoes, but they're perfect for gripping onto precarious perches.
You have a pair of stubby little wings projecting from your shoulderblades.  They can be wiggled at will, but are useless.

You have started culling the herd.  It should be easier remove the rest now.

+30 speed.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 2 times.

onmove_buffs.name: Pouncing Charge
onmove_buffs.description:
You recklessly throw yourself into battle to overpower your prey.  Strike first and strike hard.

+2 accuracy, +10% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.

data.description: You are a pupil of the Venom Clan.  You start with one of the five deadly venoms: Centipede, Viper, Scorpion, Lizard, or Toad.
You have lingering memories of training to fight cyborgs and war machines in zero gravity using the obscure Panzer Kunst.
The ancient arts of drunken brawling come naturally to you!  While under the influence of alcohol, your melee skill will rise considerably, especially unarmed combat.
You have studied the deeds and legends of ancient heroes.  From your research, you have learned an ancient form of combat called Hylian Swordsmanship.
Who needs weapons?  You deal more melee damage while your hands are empty.  This damage improves as your unarmed skill increases.
You are trained in the ways of the Jedi.  Your knowledge allows you to utilize a form of lightsaber combat.
You are well versed in the monstrous Pocket Fist martial art.  Train well, because it is your destiny to be a master.
You are a martial adept and learned one of the martial disciplines of the Sublime Way.  You start with your choice of Desert Wind, Diamond Mind, Iron Heart, Setting Sun, Stone Dragon, or Tiger Claw.

info.name: Magiclysm
info.description: Cataclysm but with magic spells!

description.str: A spell for a monster to heal themselves.  How DARE they!
Projects a spray of acrid blood and gore all around the monster while also doing damage.
A spell for the mi-go fleshwarper to cause a random mutation.

data.//: Random 25% to 75% chance to cause a mutation

description.str: A spell for the mi-go nethermancer to summon a nether being.  It's a bug if you have this.
Pull a target or set of items to you.
Prevent the target from being able to teleport.
Shield yourself from Nether damage, and secondarily from bullets, if you're a mi-go Nethermancer.
Call up brambles to trap a pathetic mammal.  This is the triffid version with no math.
This spell causes an animated vine to burst from the ground and attempt to seize a nearby target and hold it fast.
Spews pollen in a cone.
Heals other triffids.
Increases the speed of other triffids.
Blind target and emit pollen.
Causes a pollen emit when the triffid seedshaper uses other spells.

data.name: Smite
data.description: Evil has become pervasive throughout the world.  Let your power be the light that shines in the darkness!

data.name: Life Conversion
data.description: You channel lifeforce itself into your spiritual energy.  You consume a rune to regain mana.

data.name: Mind over Pain
data.description: With an intense ritual that resembles crossfit, you manage to put some of your pain at bay.

data.name: Summon Undead
data.description: An ethereal-looking undead rises from the depths of the earth to fight for you.  The type of undead you summon get deadlier with increasing spell level.

description.str: Abstract of Summon Undead spell.
Summon a zombie.  Part of Summon Undead spell.
Summon a tough zombie.  Part of Summon Undead spell.
Summon a zombie brute.  Part of Summon Undead spell.
Summon a skeleton zombie.  Part of Summon Undead spell.
Summon a skeletal brute.  Part of Summon Undead spell.
Summon a skeletal juggernaut.  Part of Summon Undead spell.

data.name: Summon Undead Swarm
data.description: A group of undead animals rises from the depths of the earth to fight for you.  The type of undead you summon get deadlier with increasing spell level.

description.str: Abstract of Summon Undead Swarm spell.
Summon a zombie dog.  Part of Summon Undead Swarm spell.
Summon a skeletal dog.  Part of Summon Undead Swarm spell.
Summon a decayed pouncer.  Part of Summon Undead Swarm spell.
Summon a skeletal wolf.  Part of Summon Undead Swarm spell.
Summon a barghest.  Part of Summon Undead Swarm spell.
Summon a boneplate wolf.  Part of Summon Undead Swarm spell.
Summon a Hulking Horror.  Part of Summon Undead Swarm spell.
Summon a spearcat hunter.  Part of Summon Undead Swarm spell.

data.name: Necrotic Gaze
data.description: Using the power of blood contained within a rune, you imbue necrotic energy into your gaze, damaging the target you look at.
Performing a ritual, you turn some of your blood into an animist rune.  You can use the rune to summon creatures, or as a catalyst for recipes.
data.//: I'm not sure if this should train anything, since it's an innate ability.

data.name: Domination
data.description: Force the undead creature you pick to obey your command, making it your ally for a short time.

data.name: Life Detonation
data.description: Force life energy into an allied undead, making them explode with tremendous force.

description.str: Detonation for life detonation spell.

data.//: would be cool to make it deal damage the same as hp of the monster, but not possible sadly
data.//2: actually possible using math and u_hp/u_max_hp, need to test it

data.name: Convert
data.description: Kill an allied creature, converting its life energy into a compact rune that you can use afterwards.

data.name: Soulrend
data.description: Violently tears the spirit from the body and binds the resulting shade to your will.

data.name: Disruption Bolt
data.description: Release a resonant bolt of spiritual energy at a nearby target.  It will disrupt the natural link between matter and animus, causing heavy, non-lethal damage.

data.name: Wrathful Spirits
data.description: Grant brief corporality to orphaned spirits and allow them to fight under your command.

data.name: Spirit Walk
data.description: Momentarily plunge into the underworld and swap positions with any spirit you command.

data.name: Lesser Banishment
data.description: Banish a monster to a lesser-known nether dimension.  If a monster is more powerful than you can handle, the spell drains your life force to make up the difference.

data.name: Ignus Fatuus
data.description: Summons ghostly foxfire worked from living marsh vapor to lead your enemies astray.  With more experience, this spell can conjure multiple ghost lights.

data.name: Bleed
data.description: Agitate old wounds on a creature, causing blood to ooze out of them.
You link your living blood to dead bones, creating a club hungry for the flesh of the living.
You link your living blood to dead bones, creating a club hungry for the flesh of the living.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.

data.name: Rupture
data.description: You pour mana into an unwilling and unprepared vessel, causing cellular break-down, internal hemorrhaging, muddling ley lines, and overcharging electronics.  The more powerful the spell, the faster the damage happens.  Immensely gruesome and crude, it was once illegal world-wide, not that it matters now.

data.name: Devour
data.description: Kill an allied creature, consuming its life energy to regain some health.
data.//: added this min/max damage for player, so it will be visible how much hp would be healed.

description.str: Deal deadly damage to ally.  You can see it only in debug mode.
Heal the player.  You can see it only in debug mode.

data.name: Sense Outsiders
data.description: You can sense the presence of nearby beings from the Nether.
Summon a watcher spirit, whose senses overlap with your own and through whose eyes you can see.  Although they are spirits, they are fragile and dissipate easily in the face of any assault.

data.name: A Shadow in the Crowd
data.description:
Sever the connections between your spirit and the spirits of everyone around you, rendering them incapable of perceiving you; the light might hit their eyes and the sounds their ears, but they cannot recognize what those impressions mean.  Anything outside the spell's area of effect will have no trouble spotting you.

This spell does not affect any target without a spirit, such as a robot.

name.str: A Shadow in the Crowd Self

description.str: Puts an effect on you so anyone affected by A Shadow in the Crowd knows to ignore you.  It's a bug if you have this directly.

data.description: Attract spirits of good fortune to a bone, granting minor bonuses as long as it is carried.  Though benevolent, the spirits are capricious, and exactly what benefits they will provide cannot be determined ahead of time.  The bone crumbles to dust when the spell duration expires and the spirits leave.

Transform your body to pure spirit, making you invisible and intangible.  You can move incredibly quickly while the spell is in effect and can pass by enemies unseen, but you will be unable to affect the physical world or cast spells.

data.name: Guardian Spirit
data.description: Summon a benevolent spirit to keep watch over you and warn you of imminent attacks, allowing you to dodge some of them.
data.//: Despite providing a buff, this is a Conjuration spell because the buff is provided by the summoned spirit.

data.name: Abjure Spirits of Rot
data.description: Placing a warding on food or drink, preventing the spirits of decay from nesting within it.  The mage may affect as much food or drink as they can carry.  The principles by which this spell functions were not discovered until the 20th century, but some animists maintain that radiation is frightening to decay spirits.

data.name: Magic Fissile
data.description: I cast Magic… Fissile?  At the darkness?

description.str: Spawns a radiation field near the target.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: The Inner Voice
data.description: Channel magic through your soul instead of your voice, allowing you to cast spells that require speech even when mute.

data.name: Mind Crush
data.description: Directly assault the target's spirit, bypassing any physical protections they have.

data.name: Witchsight
data.description: Open your senses up to look for the bright corporeal ley lines of those who spent their lives frequently expending their mana.  This also applies to creatures or alien beings that frequently use spells.

data.name: Seeing the Unseen
data.description: Rather than relying on your eyes, use your soul to also detect nearby beings, allowing you to see even creatures that are invisible to normal sight.
Infuse water with ethanol from the air and your own mana to create some potion starter.  Sometimes it might overreact and overflow.

data.name: Manafusion Bomb
data.description: Oversaturates potion starter with mana to create a deadly mana explosion.

data.name: Manafusion Trap
data.description: Make a manafusion trap, stabilizing manafusion bombs and giving you some of the excess mana.
data.//: In perfect world there will be another spell that create already buried mine, making very effective trap in realtime. But not today.

data.name: Spy Wasp
data.description: Sends out a partly magical, partly electronic spy drone shaped like a wasp that reveals terrain in a line in front of you.  The wasp can travel through walls.
This is a magical device that can take the shape of many tools.  When not in use it looks like a simple screwdriver.

data.name: Artificer's Toolkit
data.description: Artificers have a special pocket dimension with a magical tool that can cover a wide variety of tasks.  It is only a matter of temporarily summoning the item for use.

data.name: Nitro Boost
data.description: You overclock your flesh and bionics, charging so fast the friction can ignite the air, to wind up for a skull-cracking punch.

data.name: Jury Rig
data.description: Heals a little bit of damage on the target.

data.name: Greater Banishment
data.description: A more advanced version of Banishment, which is a ritual spell that attempts to banish a monster.  Being closely related to blood magic, the Blood Mage is much more specialized to use a spell like this.

data.name: Ixythyug the Destroyer's soul
data.description: RIP AND TEAR

data.name: Demonic Possession
data.description: You allow a demon to possess your body for a short time, giving you great combat abilities.  You still retain control, though lose your spellcasting abilities temporarily.

effect.u_message: Your body swells and warps as your size increases!

false_effect.u_message: Your body fills with demonic power!

effect.u_message: Your body shrinks and warps as your size decreases!

description.str: Grants the aura that gives the demon traits.  You're not supposed to see this.

data.name: Auroral Wave
data.description: A rippling wave of luminous energy spreads from your hands, a beautiful torrent of magnetic force and chill wind.

description.str: This is the cold damage portion of the Auroral Wave spell, it is a wider blast around the central high damage cone.

data.description: Create a sturdy shell that wraps around your body, bestowing a sturdy defense.

data.name: Burning Trail
data.description: Speak a short phrase and transform your footsteps into burning pits of flame, leaving a trail of fire behind you.  Each step will consume mana, but you will be immune to fire while the spell is in effect.

false_effect.u_message: You do not have enough mana to fuel your searing footsteps!

terrain.message: The earth is scorched clean!

description.str: The part of the Immolate spell that causes the transform.

data.name: Immolate
data.description: A purifying blast of raw elemental heat wipes the slate clean, searing the Earth back to her most original state: a barren ball of burning rock.

description.str: The immolate spell is powerful enough to push targets from its epicenter.

data.name: Hermes Reborn
data.description:
In the sea without lees
Standeth the bird of Hermes
Eating his wings variable
And maketh himself yet full stable
data.//: Well that's too edgy now, need to replace it.

description.str: Give some frost damage for Hermes Reborn spell.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.

data.description: A Crusader's magical shield, enhanced to protect the Crusader from all that stands in their way.

data.name: Holy Shield
data.description: Crusaders have the ability to summon a magically enhanced shield to their arm to protect them in armed combat.

data.name: Sword of Judgement
data.description: This blade of light will cut through any evil it makes contact with!  You can change its shape into a dagger, great sword, spear or mace.

data.name: Radiant Strike
messages: Your sword bursts with radiant light, hitting everyone nearby
<npcname>'s sword bursts with radiant light, hitting everyone nearby
data.description: Attack adjacent enemies, crit only
A large sword made of glowing, radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.

use_action.msg: Concentrating, you change your sword into a much smaller, quicker blade.

data.description: A short blade made of glowing, radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.

use_action.msg: Concentrating, you change your dagger into a much larger, more intimidating form.

data.description: A very large sword glowing with radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.

use_action.msg: Concentrating, you change your dagger into a longer, much more precise piercing form.

data.description: A very thin, nimble spear glowing with radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.

use_action.msg: Concentrating, you change your spear into a shorter, more hefty form.

data.description: A short and hefty mace glowing with radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.

use_action.msg: Concentrating, you change your spear into a shorter, more robust blade.

furniture.message: The earth is upheaved!

data.name: Quake
data.description: Cause a localized earthquake, knocking down enemies and overturning the earth.

description.str: Causes rubble to be spawned occasionally.

data.name: Rock Blast
data.description: Fire three large rocks at an enemy, causing blunt damage and knocking it back.

description.str: A single portion of the rock blast spell.
The push portion of the rock blast spell.

data.name: Flareup
data.description: You channel heat through your hands to severely burn a target you touch.

data.name: Flarewhip
data.description: You conjure a whip made of solid flame.

data.name: Force Blade
data.description: You shoot a blade of concentrated force in a straight line, cutting everything in its path.
A shield of pure force that protects you from most types of physical damage.

data.name: Force Shield
data.description: Adds a shield of pure force that protects your body and your clothing from attacks.

data.name: Samsara
data.description: You tie your ley lines to the world's, renewing your flesh as if reborn.

data.name: Dust Reborn
data.description: Create a cast of your own body and soul, hidden inside the earth's lines.  When the times come and your body is close to destruction, you can abandon it, transferring your consciousness into the cast.  But it brings with it a great price, and for your immortality, you pay with temporary bodily weakness.

data.name: Terra Armor
data.description: Cover yourself in dense, invisible energy of Earth.  Higher level increase your defense abilities.

name: Terra Armor
desc: Your body is covered in dense, ethereal shell, that protect you.
data.remove_message: Your lost your terra shell.

data.name: Ice Clave
data.description: Use the unstoppable force from a glacier to cause severe damage.

description.str: This is the blunt damage portion of the Ice Clave spell.

data.name: Frozen Winds
data.description: A gust of wind, colder than any Earthly mountaintop, spirals from your fingers, damaging and pushing anything in its path.

description.str: This is the push effect portion of the Frozen Winds spell.

data.name: Summon Clay Golem
data.description: Use a golem core as a focus to shape clay into a roughly humanoid shape and animate it for some time.

description.str: Gives back a golem's core.  You should not see this spell.

data.name: Golem Push
data.description: You channel the strength of a golem to push an enemy backward.

description.str: Handles the damage part of Graviton Polarization - if you see this, something went wrong.

data.name: Graviton Polarization
data.description: Changes and amplifies gravitational pull towards a point you choose, even through walls.  Pulls in items and deals bashing damage in its center.

description.str: Handles damage in the extreme center of the Graviton.

data.name: Gravity Leap
data.description: Decrease your weight to a minimum, and use a mana flow to jump to your enemies from a long distance.

data.name: Tactile Telekinesis
data.description: When you make contact with an object, it's way easier to manipulate its gravity.  Control gravity around yourself to change your inertia in order to make quick but heavy attacks.

name: Gravity Control
desc: Decreases mass of weapon on swing, increases the gravity on attack.
data.remove_message: You cease your control over gravity.

data.name: Subzero Talons
data.description: Your fingers stiffen as condensation freezes into claws, intensifying your naturally cold touch and protecting your hands from damage.

data.name: Cold Heart
data.description: Harshly drop the temperature inside of your enemies, slowing down their bloodstreams or even shattering organs.

description.str: Causes slowdown from the Cold Heart spell.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.

data.name: Form Everfrost
data.description: Drawing upon the cold in your own blood and the power of your magic you form a large piece of never-thawing ice.

data.name: Spear of Light
data.description: Shoot directed light from your fingertips that is so bright you can see through the skin of the target for an instant.

data.name: Battle Holograms
data.description: Created to disrupt your enemies, they look exactly like you, and act like a real person.

data.name: Illusion Transposition
data.description: Fool reality, and swap your position with any other creature in your line of sight

data.name: Railgun
data.description: Magnetize a bullet, and fire it at supersonic speeds by applying an opposite magnetic force to the bullet.  Leaves a trail of sparks

description.str: The spark portion of the Railgun spell.

data.name: Electrolaser
data.description: Creates a conductive channel from the caster's hand to the target by ionizing air molecules using a high-powered laser beam, then sends a powerful half million volt charge down the channel.

description.str: Give some electric damage for Electrolaser spell.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.
Subtract some moves from targeted_monster_ids monsters.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.

data.name: Surge
data.description: Send a wave of high-frequency alternating pulses.  It can't hurt living creatures, but is exceptional at stunning and destroying robots.  Even though it isn't an EMP.
This drastically increases the target's metabolism to dangerous levels, causing their body to tear itself apart.

data.name: Overdrive
data.description: The power of mana flows into you, heightening your speed to supernatural levels in a self-destructive way.  You are a blur amongst your enemies, felling them with blows too swift to see.
Using your mana, you began to accelerate ice particles inside a cold mist, eroding everything inside.

data.name: Ice Orbit
data.//: dirty hack till emit spell would be fixed
data.description: Small particles of ice orbit around your body, as a beacon for a giant field of frozen energy.

data.name: Ice Age
data.description: Cool down every creature in range 'till their flesh cracks, bones shatter, and armor fractures.

data.name: Shortwave
data.description: Cook nearby monsters (and yourself to an extent).

description.str: Cook nearby monsters (and yourself to an extent).

data.name: Gamma Burst
data.description: Cause cell damage to everything in a wide area.  Fast to cast, but does damage slowly.
Summon a pack of butterflies with razor-sharp wings, to cut every creature in your way.

Summons a keeper of the glades, a powerful ancient forest spirit, to defend you.  The keeper may be ridden and will unleash its fury on unnatural enemies, but is much less powerful in the cities than in the forest.

name.str: The Guardian of the Forest Apply Pet

description.str: Applies the pet effect to the summoned keeper of the glades so you can ride them.  You shouldn't see this.

data.name: Alkahest
data.description: Release a spray of mana-saturated bioactive solvent.  Your ley lines give you a resistance to this acid due to your mana signature, but others beware!

data.name: Biomechanic
data.description: Who said the human body is weak?  You just need to compress enough mana into your flesh and bones in order to show them who is the deadliest animal in the world.
data.//: thats supposed to be a magikarp power - weak on the very beginning but op in the end of the path. also it has a cool feature - you can support it indefinitely, if you have enough mana (and thats the only problem for the user - it requires really ton of mana to support it)

data.name: Burn at Both Ends
data.description: A candle burns the most brightly at both ends, and yet it burns twice as fast.

data.name: Soul Afterburner
data.description: You burn a small portion of your soul to gain a large burst of speed.  You will have to wait until your soul has healed before burning a part of it again.

data.//: The injury on false effect prevents grinding the spell to max level as soon as it is obtained.

effect.u_message: You gain a sudden burst of speed!

false_effect.u_message: Burning your soul before it healed only resulted in some damage to your body.

description.str: This is a description for a spell the player will never see.
This is a description for a spell the player will never see.
This is a description for a spell the player will never see.

name: Soul Burn
desc: A little of your soul has been burned away, leaving you in a weakened state.  The soul heals quickly, but your body regenerates more slowly while the soul is weak.

data.name: Storm Chain
data.description: You touch an unwilling subject and lightning dances from you to multiple nearby enemies.

description.str: #1 in the storm chain series of effects.
#2 in the storm chain series of effects.
#3 in the storm chain series of effects.

data.name: Galvanic
data.description: Fill your hands with high-voltage electricity, and deal additional electric damage in melee.

name: Galvanic
desc: You deal additional electric damage in melee.
data.apply_message: Electric energy is concentrated in your hands, and it's ready to go.
data.remove_message: Your hands turn back to normal condition.

data.name: Solar Beam
data.description: Fire a blast of sunlight in a wide beam, blinding everything in its path and leaving it bright enough for you to see for a few seconds.

data.name: Pocket Sun
data.description: You create a stable portal in the fabric of reality to the sun, through which you can draw on its light and temperature.

data.name: Cold Snap
data.description: With a snap of your fingers, the target takes cold damage and freezes in place.

description.str: Freezes the target monster in place.

data.name: Winter Wolf's Call
data.description: Summon your personal pack of winter wolves to freeze and maul your foes.

data.name: Final Grasp
data.description: In the end, everything succumbs to the grasp of nothingness and stasis.  This spell gives the target a foretaste of that.

description.str: Removes some moves from an enemy.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.

data.name: Horizon Vortex
data.description: Creates a chaotic energy field that disrupts enemies inside it.  It is rather random, and its effects can range from almost nothing to killing all hostiles in the area.

description.str: Causes some damage in the Horizon Vortex spell.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.

This is a sub spell for the Lava Bomb spell.

data.name: Lava Bomb
data.description: You tear up the ground beneath you to fire a lava bomb: a globe of lava surrounded by hot, solid rock.  It shatters upon impact, spraying shards of rock and lava everywhere.

data.name: Pyroclastic Flow
data.description: Pulls up the heat of the Earth, along with considerable smoke mixed with ashes.

description.str: Creates smoke in the area.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.
This is a sub-spell for Assassin Strike.  It teleports you.
This is a sub-spell for Assassin Strike.  It generates toxic smoke in an area.

data.name: Assassin Strike
data.description: You strike a poisonous blow and disappear in a puff of toxic smoke.

data.name: Life Drain
data.description: This spell takes some of a target's life; part of it comes to you in a less-potent form.

description.str: Gives you a bit of stamina.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.
Causes a small amount of pain when certain spells are used.

data.name: Knit the Rent Flesh
data.description: Cause the target's wounds to writhe, the flesh to crawl back together, and their injuries to heal.  Disturbing, and painful, but effective.

data.name: Pain Split
data.description: Evens out damage among your limbs.
data.//: This is transformation because it moves wounds around, it does not actually heal anything.

data.name: Vicious Tentacle
data.description: This spell extrudes a long and nasty whiplike tentacle of sharp bones and oozing acid from your body, which has a long reach attack and vicious damage.

data.name: Evolved Vicious Tentacle
data.description: This spell extrudes a long and nasty whiplike tentacle of sharp bones and oozing acid from your body, which has a long reach attack and vicious damage.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and start to design your own version.

data.name: Grotesque Enhancement
data.description: A spell that warps your body in foreign, unnatural ways to increase your physical abilities and strength.
data.//: duration is in moves

data.description: When cast, the mage opens his mouth and sprays acid in a wide cone to dissolve his foes into goo.  Just imagine what he'll do with the goo.

data.name: Flesh Pouch
data.description: This spell grows a large pouch out of your skin on your back, allowing you to store your gear in it.

data.name: Conjure Bonespear
data.description: This spell creates a long shaft of bone with a wicked point and blades along its length.

data.name: Evolved Conjure Bonespear
data.description: This spell creates a long shaft of bone with a wicked point and blades along its length.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
This ritual grows a small nub of flesh on you, which quickly falls off and turns into a rune attuned to Biomancers.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.

data.name: Paralytic Dart
data.description: Spits a warped needle of sinew and bone, carrying with it a sting that slows your victim.

data.name: Visceral Projection
data.description: Projects a spray of acrid blood and gore all around you, growing to ensnare your prey in a field of twitching poisonous tendrils.

description.str: Paralytic side effect of Projection.
Hits the user with side effects too.

data.name: Coagulant Weave
data.description: Turns your biological mastery inwards, medically enhancing your flesh.  Rather than strength of healing, it staves off blood loss and purges wounds before they can turn septic, at the cost of increased hunger and thirst.

description.str: This is a sub-spell of the Caustic Aura spell.

data.name: Caustic Aura
data.description: This spell suspends acid in a layer around you, corroding melee attackers when struck and enhancing your melee damage.

data.name: Improved Caustic Aura
data.description: This spell suspends acid in a layer around you, corroding melee attackers when struck and enhancing your melee damage.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.

data.name: Limbs of the Frog
data.description: Grow webbing on your hands and feet, making quick swimming a breeze.

data.name: Giant Growth
data.description: Grow to enormous size.  Your clothing and equipment will not grow with you.

effect.u_message: Your body swells and warps as your size increases!

false_effect.u_message: You are already enormous--the spell cannot make you any larger!

effect.u_message: Your body shrinks and warps as your size decreases!

data.name: Preserve Genetic Stability
data.description: The scroll said that this spell is for "Reducing negative consequences from XE037 exposure", whatever that means.  According the scroll, the spell should be allowed to run its course before reapplication.

data.name: Carrion Feast
data.description: Alter your digestive system to consume rotten food with no ill effects.  This is either a truly ancient spell or otherwise must have been the product of some university thaumaturgical research department.

data.name: Lashing Tentacles
data.description: Grow a pair of lashing tentacles from your shoulders.  While not as long as the Vicious Tentacle, they will strike anyone in melee with you.  You cannot wear rigid armor that covers the shoulders with them.

data.name: Purgation of Maladies
data.description: Vomit up any minor illnesses you might be suffering from, such as colds or the flu.  This is one of the few biomantic cure spells that is castable on other people.

description.str: This causes the actual cure effect, since a vomit effect spell doesn't apply effect_str

data.name: Corporeal Reconstitution
data.description: Possibly the most powerful of the biomantic healing spells, this causes your flesh to literally knit itself together before your eyes.

data.name: Halt Bleeding
data.description: As you can control your body, you can control your blood.

data.name: Flensing Fingers
data.description: Change each of your fingers into a myriad of tiny bone knives, allowing you to cut with surgical precision… or slice your enemies to ribbons.

data.name: Caustic Blood
data.description: Transmute your blood to magically-enhanced acid, making you immune to acid and also splashing anyone who spills your blood.

data.name: Gluttonous Consumption
data.description: Magically expand your stomach size, allowing it to consume more food without taking up any more room in your body.  Once a rarely-learned spell, it's much more useful now that you're not always sure where your next meal is coming from.

data.name: Carmine Infusion
data.description: Using water as a catalyst, restore some of your lost blood.  This spell has no effect if you're healthy and uninjured.

data.name: Morphogenic Mastery
data.description: The scroll said that this spell is for "Exerting deliberate control over morphogenic alterations", which sounds ominous.

description.str: Blast someone with magical energy just like in anime.

data.message: You unleash a levinbolt.

data.name: Acid Claw
data.description: Your claws glow with yellow acid energy, and as you swipe your claw a wave of acid sweeps forth from it.

data.name: Acid Bite
data.description: Your maw drips with acid as you make a bite attack.

data.name: Dragon's Bite
data.description: The bite damage in Acid Bite.

data.name: Black Dragon Shell
data.description: You channel your inner draconic magic to protect yourself from damage and reflect some back as acid damage.

description.str: Acid burst that punishes attackers.

data.name: Dragon Terror
data.description: With an ear piercing roar, you channel the inner power of dragons and strike fear into those who stand before you, slowing their escape from your terror.

data.name: Dragon Boost
data.description: You let out a mighty roar as you infuse yourself with the power of Dragons.

description.str: Minor health recovery spell associated with Dragon Boost.
Minor stamina recovery spell associated with Dragon Boost.

data.name: Thought Suit

data.name: Sound Bomb
data.description: Behind the cool name hides a common joke spell to spook your friends and restrain dogs.  It can be useful in some special cases.

data.name: Knowing the Day and the Hour
data.description: Probably the single greatest example of technology rendering magic obsolete, this spell allows you know exactly what time it is.

data.name: Freshen Up
data.description: Undoubtedly the single most common spell in the world before the Cataclysm, Freshen Up cleans your teeth, sweetens your breath, removes stains and sweat from your clothes, exfoliates you, and gives volume back to your hair.

data.name: Peaceful Rest
data.description: A favorite of overworked mages and dilettantes who, this spell makes it much easier to fall asleep regardless of how tired you are.

data.name: Vegetative Grasp
data.description:
This spell causes roots and vines to burst forth from the ground and grab your foes, slowing them and doing a small amount of damage as they dig in.

Larger targets will be <color_yellow>less affected</color> by the spell, and it has <color_red>no effect</color> on targets not on natural ground.

data.name: Root Strike
data.description: This spell causes roots to spear out of the ground in a cone and stab into your foes, impaling them.

data.name: Wooden Shaft
data.description: This spell creates a projectile of hardwood that shoots forth from the caster's hand at high speed to stab into an enemy.

data.name: Nature's Bow
data.description: This spell conjures a magical wooden recurve bow, as well as a quiver and a set of arrows to go with it.

description.str: This spell conjures a magical quiver as part of the nature's bow spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
This spell conjures magical arrows as part of the nature's bow spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

This spell conjures magical arrows as part of the nature's bow spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: Nature's Trance
data.description: Your connection to living things allows you to go into a magical trance.  This allows you to recover from fatigue quickly in exchange for mana.
Are you the crazy cat lady?

data.name: Cause Bear
data.description: This spell appears to be very smudged.  You're fairly sure the name should be Cause Fear, but you're also fairly sure it won't have the desired effect because the instructions are hardly legible.  No time like the Cataclysm to find out, though!

data.name: Kill Fungus
data.description: Kills fungus affected areas.

data.name: Druid Rune
data.description: A ritual in which you conjure forth roots and vines in order to make a druidic rune.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.

data.name: Purification Seed
data.description: You summon a gift of the earth which will purify water.  Rapidly degrades if not utilized.

data.name: Sacrificial Regrowth
data.description: Through giving of one's own life force, you restore withered and barren plant life nearby.  What remains will need time to regrow its full strength.

data.name: Sacrificial Healing
data.description: Channels some of the user's own life force into healing energy, for the sake of one's allies.

data.name: Tornskin
data.description: This spell, which resembles Thornskin through the sap & needles covering the page, seemed to involve thorns and bleeding wounds.  The marred words may have altered the function.

data.name: Feral Form
data.description: This spell unleashes your inner beast, growing claws & fangs to rend your foes limb from limb.

data.name: Enhanced Feral Form
data.description: This spell unleashes your inner beast, growing claws & fangs to rend your foes limb from limb.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and start to design your own version.

data.name: Summon Wolf
data.description: Call to the wilds for aid from some wolves.

data.name: Communion with Nature
data.description: You focus on the bounty of nature around you and commune with it, improving your health and mood and calming nearby wildlife.  This spell may only be cast outdoors away from civilization.

false_effect.u_message: You must be surrounded by nature to commune with nature.

data.name: Seed of Growth
data.description: Offer some of your life in a ritual to get tokens of growth in return.
data.//: The spell can only be permanent without being at maximum level because of how items with charges work

data.name: Cause Rot
data.description: A spell from a darker sect of druidry, created to forcibly begin the circle of life anew.  For without rot, you cannot have growth.  Affects a huge area, but is indiscriminate; even rusting machines into nothing but dust and slow both in casting and effect.  Once lost entirely to the passage of time, this spell was thought to be no more than a myth, the stuff of fairy tales, albeit grim ones.

description.str: The ruin terrain effect of the Cause Rot spell.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: Restoration
data.description:
Slowly heal your wounds by drawing on the power of nature.

You must be <color_yellow>outdoors and in a natural area</color> away from civilization to cast Restoration.
data.//: each 3000 (30 second) heal 1 hp. 5 hp on level 0 (2.5m), 30 hp on level 25 (15 m), ignoring proficiency modifiers

false_effect.u_message: You must be surrounded by nature to use its power to heal.

data.name: Floral Healing
data.description: Use some magic herbs to heal yourself.

data.name: Vegetative Poultice
data.description: This spell turns a mixture of bark and leaves into a powerful salve capable of stopping even grievous wounds from bleeding.

data.name: Whisper of the Leaves
data.description: This spell allows you to hear the trees' wisdom in the rustle of the leaves and the creaking of their roots, discerning the layout of the forest.

false_effect.u_message: You are already in tune with the rhythms of the forest.  Further magic cannot deepen your bond.

data.name: Harvest of the Hunter
data.description: This spell creates a grouping of odd-looking but functional arrows out of forest detritus.

data.name: Summon Tanglevine
data.description: This spell causes an animated vine to burst from the ground and attempt to seize a nearby target and hold it fast.

data.name: Beguiling the Savage Beast
data.description: Using your connection to nature, you can sway an animal to your service.  This spell even works on mutated animals.

data.name: Spear of Brambles
data.description: This spell turns a stick into a vicious spear that drips with sticky sap.
data.//: NO_HANDS so you can hold on to the stick and cast the spell and then be holding the spear

data.name: Enhanced Spear of Brambles
data.description: This spell turns a bit of bark or a twig into a vicious spear that drips with sticky sap.  You now know this spell like the back of your hand, and no longer need such massive spell components as you did previously.

data.name: Stranglethorns
data.description: Call up thick, swiftly growing brambles, either in a line to form a wall or an arc to trap an enemy.

descriptions: Summon a spray of brambles to entrap an enemy.
Summon a wall of thorns to fortify a location.

data.name: Thornskin
data.description: This spell transforms the druid's skin into a bark-like material covered in large thorns.  It provides excellent protection but slightly slows you and makes you vulnerable to fire.

data.name: Renewing the Forest
data.description:
While outdoors and not underground, the druid can create a profusion of life around themselves, causing grass to grow through pavement, bushes and flowers to sprout, and trees to grow to full height in moments.

In <color_yellow>addition to</color> mana, this spell also requires <color_red>hit points</color> to cast and <color_yellow>will fail</color> if you are too injured.

else.u_message: You do not have enough life force to donate it to renew the forest!

false_effect.u_message: You must be on the surface and not on a building's upper stories to cast Renewing the Forest!
You must be outside to cast Renewing the Forest!

data.name: Shape Wood
data.description: Using druidic magic, shape living wood into a log that you can use for other projects without harming the tree.  You must cast this spell on a living tree.

effect.failure_message: You must be near a tree to shape it.

then.u_message: The wood of the tree grows and forms as you cast the spell and when it ends, there is a log lying on the ground, entirely covered in bark but otherwise straight and ready to be used in other projects.

else.u_message: Never mind.

data.name: Water's Cooling Touch
data.description: Draw on some of the essence of water, providing protection against the summer's heat.

data.name: Aquatic Mantle
data.description: Cover yourself in a thin layer of magical seaweed, preventing you from getting wet and allowing you to breathe underwater.

data.name: Wash the Wounds Clean
data.description: Transform a bit of water into a magical disinfectant as you pour it over your wounds.
data.//: Using spawn_item with a liquid just dumps it on the floor at the moment.  Once that's fixed, this can be extended so it can be used on NPCs.

data.name: Water Strider's Walk
data.description: Enchant yourself so that the water will buoy you up and prevent you from sinking, allowing you to walk on its surface.

data.name: Traverse the Wilds
data.description: Blend in the wilds and urge them to speed your passage.  Trees bend out of the way, bushes do not hinder you, and even grass subtly moves your feet along.  The spell cannot be cast near civilization and similarly will fade if your travels take you out of the wilds.

false_effect.u_message: You must be surrounded by the wilds to traverse them.

effect.u_message: As you approach civilization, your spell fades.

data.name: Bearmantle
data.description: Adopt some of the aspect of the bear, protecting you from cold and preparing you for winter.

data.name: Goodberry
data.description: Enchant a set of berries, transforming them into magical fruit that will provide a hearty meal's worth of nutrition and a small amount of healing when eaten.  The goodberries will rot away within 24 hours if not eaten.

data.//: EoC to summon because summoned comestibles don't have timers

data.name: Fountain of the Depths

effect.failure_message: You can only call up a spring on natural earth.

else.u_message: Canceled

data.name: Awakening of the Forest Guardian
data.description:

You must be <color_yellow>standing next to a tree</color> for the spell to take effect.

false_effect.u_message: You need to be standing next to a tree to awaken it.

data.name: Stone's Endurance

data.name: Shardspray

data.name: Piercing Bolt

data.name: Shardstorm

data.name: Rockbolt

data.name: Move Earth

data.name: Clairvoyance
data.description: You close your eyes and the earth surrenders its secrets to you.

data.name: Stoneskin

data.name: Improved Stoneskin
data.description: Envelops your entire body in armor formed from living rock, encumbering yet protective.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.

data.name: Pillar of Stone
data.description: Drawing upon the surrounding earth, you form a pillar of solid rock.  Experience will make the task easier, and less disruptive to the surrounding area.

description.str: Bash effect that follows, levels reduce damage and AoE.

data.name: Petrifying Touch

data.name: Stone Slumber
