data.name: Translocator Gate
data.description: A gate for translocation.  Cast the translocation spell or use a translocator to choose this gate as a destination.

data.name: Translocation Portal
data.description: A portal that allows translocation.  You may use this portal to teleport to attuned locations or teleport to it if it is attuned.

data.name: Magic Circle
data.description: This is a rough magic circle, carved into the ground and decorated with blood, candles, and other small knick-knacks.

data.name: Magic Circle
data.description: This is a rough magic circle, carved into the ground and decorated with blood, candles, and other small knick-knacks.  It has been enhanced with silver to channel more mana.

data.name: large glowing boulder
data.description: Something about this doesn't look right.

data.name: enchanter's workbench
data.description: An ornate oak cabinet topped by a durable resin countertop resistant to most alchemical spills and burns.  It has wired in electrical and gas fittings, and has been decorated with several protection runes - mostly ornamental.

data.name: standing alembic
data.description: A large glass and copper alembic for distilling alchemical concoctions.  It consists of a copper pot with rising spires of twisted glass draining into various removable bottles.

data.name: orrery
data.description: This is a beautiful, non-scale model of the solar system.  A complex series of gears allows the relative motions of the planets to be studied at the turn of a crank.  This more modern version also has bluetooth and could have been controlled with an app, if there was any power anymore.

data.name: huge mana crystal
data.description: This is a mana crystal that juts from the ground as if it had sprouted up like a weed.  It pulses with a delicate yellow energy, occasionally bursting with flashes of pent-up light.

data.name: stone altar
data.description: This is a big stone altar.  Most commonly used in morally questionable rituals.

data.name: attunement altar
data.description: An ancient stone plinth covered in symbols that appear to be combinations and variations of the eight magic classes.  Eight depressions are on the top with the original symbols of the classes, each look as though they can hold an item.

data.name: demon forge
data.description: This is a forge made of the chitin of a huge, red spider that has a penchant for flames.  Custom made to withstand the heat from alumentum, this forge can resmelt the magical metals into their workable, ingot form.

data.name: demon forge
data.description: This is a forge made of the chitin of a huge, red spider that has a penchant for flames.  Custom made to withstand the heat from alumentum, this forge can resmelt the magical metals into their workable, ingot form.

data.name: candelabra of everlasting candles
data.description: A candelabra, strangely the candles never seem to burn down.  Smashing it doesn't seem like it'd produce any worthwhile salvage.

data.name: everburning street lamp
data.description: A street lamp, strangely the candle never seems to burn down.  Smashing it doesn't seem like it'd produce any worthwhile salvage.

data.name: everburning brazier
data.description: A raised metal dish in which to safely burn things.  This one seems to contain a flame that burns endlessly without fuel.

data.name: everfrost crystal
data.description: This massive mana crystal juts from the ground as if it had sprouted up like a weed.  It pulses with an angry white light, occasionally flickering brighter.

data.name: flat boulder
data.description: Smooth, flat boulder.  You can use it both as a table and an anvil.  It responds to your force, and you can easily move it.

bash.sound: The boulder recedes into the ground.

data.name: everburning torch candelabra
data.description: A candelabra made of a half-dozen everburning torches attached to a wooden support structure.  Plenty of light with no worries about power usage or smoke.  Plus, how can you be a real wizard unless your tower is lit by the flicking light of imperishable flames?

data.name: statue of Valzain
data.description: A massive solid gold statue of the Forge Lord himself.

data.name: monolithic statue of Valzain
data.description: A truly monolithic statue of the Forge Lord siting lazily on a golden throne.  Meeting it's gaze sends chills down your spine.

data.name: owlbear taxidermy
data.description: An aggressive looking stuffed Owlbear stands here, menacingly.

data.name: stone altar
data.description: An ancient stone altar, moss-grown and weather-worn.

data.name: standing stone
data.description: A tall standing stone.  It is covered in carvings, but they are so worn by wind and rain you can't make out what they might have been.

data.name: brambles
data.description: A thick wall of tangled brambles grows here.  Vicious thorns protrude from the stems.

data.name: Autodoc, Delta Class
data.description: A machine used for the installation and removal of bionics.  The name 'Autodoc' is something of a misnomer, as safe operation is only guaranteed with a ritual circle of technomancers.  The entire surface is carved with runes so fine that they look like spiraling circuitry from a distance.

data.name: glowing plant bulb
data.description: A small, round plant grows here, illuminating the surroundings, grown through druidic magic.

data.name: gnarled bookcase
data.description: A set of shelves looking more like they were grown than built, all of a single solid piece.  While designed for books, it does a decent job of storing anything else that'll fit.

data.name: druidic bed
data.description: A solid wooden frame in a single piece and covered in soft, spongy moss with an ordinary sheet over it.  You probably wouldn't have wanted to sleep on it before the Cataclysm, but nowadays any real bed is a luxury.

data.name: gnarled chair
data.description: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back, all seemingly grown out of a single solid piece of wood.  Despite the twisted lines, it still looks extremely comfortable.

data.name: gnarled desk
data.description: A wooden desk, all formed of a single solid piece and covered in the whorls of natural wood.  It even has a single leaf growing off a patch of bark on the side.

data.name: gnarled wardrobe
data.description: A large wooden cabinet, all grown from a single piece of wood but somehow still containing doors that open.  You could store plenty of things in here.

data.name: gnarled table
data.description: A knotted wooden table, looking more like it was grown rather than assembled.  You could sit down at it to eat like a civilized person.

data.name: gnarled wooden rack
data.description: A wooden shelving unit with angled storage surfaces designed to show off whatever is stored on it.  This one seems to be grown all from a single piece of wood, gnarled and covered in bark.  There's even a bit of moss growing on it.

data.name: gnarled sink
data.description: A water basin with a water tap and drain, but all made of wood except for the piping.  Even the taps, however that works.

data.name: gnarled counter
data.description: A plain wooden countertop, all made of a single, solid piece of wood.  Makes a decent surface for storage or crafting, even it's not completely level.
A shelter woven from wildwood weaver's webs.  It can be used to rest, and the weaver provides assistance in any tailoring task.

data.name: platonic flower
data.description: Small bush, that looks like a pair of dragon curves, with a flower in the very center.  The branches of the plant can be used as a perfect ruler.

data.name: moonflower bush
data.description:
A silver colored vine, whose luminescent flowers will only bloom during night.

Amazingly rare, it grows only in places where heroic deeds took place, or so it's believed.

data.name: kampuch
data.description: The tiny and lethal rod flowers of the Kämpuch break the underbrush like small ivory thorns.

data.name: olieribos
data.description: Dark colored leaves and bitter roots, firmly entrenched in untrodden earth.  They can be used to ward against evil, or to attract it.

data.name: glowing mushrooms
data.description: A bioluminescent mushroom shaped like a small nest.  Motes of light occasionally detach from its surface and float upwards before fading.

data.name: horn moss
data.description: A cluster of red moss, so called for the white capsules that it will grow during spring.

data.name: golden reed
data.description: Thin stalks colored deep yellow, crowned with blue feather-like leaves.

data.name: barnacle weed

data.description: A small herb with milk white flowers and pitch black roots.  Known since Ancient Greece, it was brought to the New World by European druids long ago.

data.description: This is a large cocoon-like object that looks to be the vague shape of some creature.  You don't want to know how long it stayed alive while being sucked dry by these spiders.

data.name: glassteel vault wall
data.description: A barrier made of glassteel, it's nothing complicated, and looks extremely fragile.  It is most definitely not fragile and it's probably alarmed in the event that someone does break through it.

data.description: Extremely resilient floor made from carefully placed rebar and poured alchemical concrete, capable of providing protection from the elements.  As for the matching roof, it still requires supporting walls, otherwise it may very well cave in.

data.name: Spellcraft (Beginner)
data.description: You took a few classes about magical theory before the Cataclysm and still remember most of it.

data.name: Spellcraft (Intermediate)
data.description: You were either a practicing mage or made a formal study of magical theory.  You could have designed spells in your spare time, if you had wanted.

data.name: Spellcraft (Expert)
data.description: You could have taught magical theory to mages, whether you know any spells or not.

data.name: Dabbler (Freshen Up)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Freshen Up, the most common spell in the pre-Cataclysm world.  It saved up a lot of time before work in your old life and you've certainly made a lot of use of it now that there's no more running water.

data.name: Dabbler (Crystallize Mana)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Crystallize Mana.  Sure, it ruined your social life and you slept for 12 hours a day, but you made a tidy sum of money producing mana crystals for mages who needed them.  Too bad all that money is useless now.

data.name: Dabbler (Magical Light)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Magical Light.  It was mostly a party trick, to be honest, and the weeks learning to cast a spell that any smartphone could replicate showed you how much work trying to learn real magic actually was.  But the nights are dark enough nowadays that you're glad you put in the effort.

data.name: Dabbler (Aura of Protection)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Aura of Protection.  To be honest, you originally learned it to try to replace the umbrella you kept leaving at home and were very disappointed when that didn't work.  It's saved you at least once from some strange gas in the air, though, so all that effort paid off.

data.name: Dabbler (Sound Bomb)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Sound Bomb.  You mostly used it for jokes, to play pranks on your friends and annoy the neighborhood dogs, but it's proven its worth now at the end of the world.

data.name: Dabbler (Knowing the Day and the Hour)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knowing the Day and the Hour.  Your non-mage friends were always asking you why you bothered learning what was widely considered to be the least useful spell in the world, and sometimes you weren't sure yourself.  Even now that the network is done, you're still not entirely sure how important it is to know that it's exactly 6:12 a.m. vs. just "sunrise".  But if it ever is important, you'll know it.

data.name: Dabbler (Peaceful Rest)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Peaceful Rest.  Ever since you were a child, you dreaded bedtime.  Falling asleep was an ordeal, a battle between you and the bed, and it seemed like no matter how many sheep you counted, sleep hygiene habits you practiced, or exhausted you felt, it was an hour or more until you finally fell into sleep.  You became a mage because you were tired of having 5% of your life stuck staring at the ceiling while waiting for sleep to come, and ever since the world ended, you're even more grateful you can fall asleep whenever you need to.

data.name: Dabbler (Ignus Fatuus)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Ignus Fatuus.  It was mostly just for your amusement, summoning the will-o'-the-wisps at sundown and watching them dance, but they've proven handy more than once lately by leading some monster astray while you ran for your life.

data.name: Dabbler (Summon Watcher Spirit)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Summon Watcher Spirit.  You initially learned it to keep an eye on your cat while you were doing chores around the house, but it ended up being even more valuable than you thought once the world ended.

data.name: Dabbler (Witchsight)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Witchsight.  People asked you why you would bother learning a spell that only let you know if other people were mages, but every bit of information helped.  A gun you can see, an expensive suit, the size and strength of a person or the way they carry themselves, but a mage's talent is all hidden until they a cast spell.  Unless, of course, you knew how to look, and you did.

data.name: Dabbler (Knit the Rent Flesh)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knit the Rent Flesh.  Certainly no one ever asked your reasons for studying biomancy, especially after you saw that guy get hit by a truck running a red light and managed to stop him from bleeding out before the paramedics arrived.  It was disturbing to watch, but it was undoubtedly effective.  As long as you're light on your feet, you won't have to worry about dying of your injuries now.

data.name: Dabbler (Carrion Feast)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Carrion Feast.  You had your reasons for studying it, certainly, and perhaps it is best not to speculate about them now.

data.name: Dabbler (Water's Cooling Touch)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Water's Cooling Touch.  You always hated summer, the stickiness, the heat, the sunburns, and your dislike of the weather drove you to study druidic magic to overcome it.  With your water bottle handy, you'll never have to worry about being too hot in the sun again.

data.name: Dabbler (Traverse the Wilds)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Traverse the Wilds.  Part of the joy of hiking is taking your time, of being away from the tyranny of clocks and schedules and deadlines.  But sometimes, it was nice to just see the miles fly by, to reach the summit before sunrise and take in the view without getting up at 2 a.m., to finish the entire trail and still have time to sit down and eat a leisurely dinner.  And it's not like you teleported, after all.  Regardless of the magic, you still had to walk every single step.

data.name: Dabbler (Goodberry)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  Biohacking was your passion, trying to optimize your life through diet, exercise, and sleep tricks, and you turned to druidic magic to cut out wasted time.  When the Pomodoro timer went off, you scurried to the fridge, grabbed a handful of berries and enchanted them, scarfed them down, and then got back to work.  You never had to deal with meal replacement nonsense, you just ate your berries and got things done.  Your clients are dead now and everything you worked on is ash and dust, but eating those berries has proven to be the best habit you picked up.

data.name: Dabbler (Utility Molding)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Utility Molding.  You read a pamphlet once entitled, "One Spell is All You Need!" and thought it seemed like a good idea.  And true, maybe you've never needed a mining pick before, but the ability to all up a knife or a shovel or a hammer whenever you want has come in handy countless times.

data.name: Dabbler (Tremorsense)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Tremorsense.  It kept you safe, letting you know if someone was nearby even if you were absorbed in a task or listening to music, but now that most of the people you meet want to eat you it's proven invaluable.

data.name: Dabbler (The Turning of the Earth)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, the Turning of the Earth.  Gardening was your passion and you got sick of manually digging rows in early spring or mid-summer weather.  After your studies you could just cast the spell and the earth neatly parted, waiting for seeds to be planted.  Once the canned food runs out, you're sure you'll get even more use of your powers.

data.name: Dabbler (Finger Firelighter)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Finger Firelighter.  You had a lot of great conversations with people, late at night outside clubs and restaurants, when they'd ask for a light and you'd just snap your fingers.  Lately, though, you've used it to cook food more than light cigarettes and haven't had anyone to talk to, but at least the fires at night are warm.

data.name: Dabbler (Flames of Passion)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Flames of Passion.  Alcohol is a social lubricant, and if you already had a drink in your hand, why not use it to let you loosen up and make it easier to talk to people?  You were out at parties almost every weekend and had a wide circle of friends.  Hopefully at least a few of them made it through all of this.

data.name: Dabbler (Slowfall)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Slowfall.  Some people become mages due to a dream, or a goal they want to pursue, but for you it was the memory of falling down the stairs as a child and breaking your leg.  With your magic you could jump off a roof and it was no more dangerous than jumping off a low stone wall, and that's been pretty useful for some of the situations you've found yourself in since the Cataclysm.

data.name: Dabbler (Faerie Fire)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Faerie Fire.  Maybe it wasn't a great use of your time, but it was fun at parties and one time when your cat ran off it made it very easy to find her.  Since the Cataclysm, though, your magical powers have become much more useful.

data.name: Dabbler (Sorcerer's Hand)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Sorcerer's Hand.  Alright, fine, you admit it, you learned magic because of laziness.  It seems odd to say, with all the hours after work and late at night, studying until you could make your keys twitch and fall off the table and eventually until you can grab a drink from across the room, but it's true.  You could reach nearly everything without having to get up.  Anyway, you're way more active now, and being able to grab things from across the room has come in handy more than once since the end of the world.

data.name: Dabbler (Spider Climb)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Spider Climb.  A lot of people in the rockclimbing community said you were cheating, and, to be honest, they were right.  But every time you saw one of those spectacular views from the summit, well, those complaints didn't mean that much.

data.name: Dabbler (Windrunning)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Windrunning.  It's embarrassing to admit, but you became a mage because you were always running late.  Just one spell made it much easier to catch that bus, to beat that red light across the crosswalk, to make it to work on time instead of a few minutes late.  Nowadays you have a lot more practice at running and that speed still comes in handy.

data.name: Dabbler (Fire Spark)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Fire Spark.  Most people when they wanted to light a fire thought of kelvinists, but electricity always fascinated you.  You used to love watching the storms roll in, sitting on your porch as the lightning played across the sky, and while summoning lightning bolts wouldn't have been useful for anything at all, catching fires with a spark has come in handy.

data.name: Dabbler (Air Bubble)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Air Bubble.  It was originally because of your diving trips.  You were sick of having the goggles and the respirator between you and the sea, and if one simple spell would make it so you didn't have to worry about that again, you were willing to put in the time to learn it.  When you had to swim across that river to escape the horde a while ago, it definitely proved its worth.

data.name: Dabbler (Lamp)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Lamp.  Sure, phones had lights, but they weren't nearly as bright as a magical one was, and it was pretty nice to just recite the words and light up an entire room like a high-powered flashlight.  Now that the power's out, it's even more useful.

data.name: Dabbler (Knock)
data.description: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knock.  You originally learned it because you always forgot your keys and after the third time you were locked out of your apartment, to turned to magic to solve the problem.  Of course, once you did have to use magic to get back in you realized that anyone else could have done the same thing, so in the end it just ruined your peace of mind.  At least now you can be sure there's no one home at the places you're entering.

data.name: Elf (Species)
data.description: You are one of the Firstborn, called "alfar" or "sidhe" or, more recently, "elves" by the humans.  Your people had integrated into human society before the Cataclysm, doing jobs involving animals and nature since modern industry was never to your liking.  Had technological development continued, you might have been forced to make some unpleasant compromises, but not as unpleasant as you have during the end of the world.

data.name: Dwarf (Species)
data.description: You are a Child of the Stone, called "dwarf" by the humans.  The legends tell that long ago, your people were born of stone and mined your way up to the surface world and its light, where you found the other sapient species of Earth.  While the scale of the human world was always a bit of a problem, you fit in well due to your people's long tradition of craftsdwarfship and hard work.  Now that society has collapsed, maybe you can turn that same drive to rebuilding it.

data.name: Goblin (Species)
data.description: You are a goblin.  Before the Cataclysm your people were always a little out of place: the houses weren't designed for you, the shops weren't open when you were awake, and your appearance sometimes gave human or elven children nightmares that you were going to steal them or reminded dwarves of the ancient wars your peoples fought.  As it turned out, you weren't what any of them should have been worrying about.

data.name: Lizardfolk (Species)
data.description: You are one of the Scaled Ones, called "lizardfolk" by the warmbloods.  For generations, your tribe served a dragon as its eyes and ears in the outside world, until civilization encroached far enough that even all the dragon's might could not hold it back.  You were sent out to integrate into the modern world, but you were only there a few years before human science ended their world.  Now, you have to survive in the mess they've created.

data.name: Ravenfolk (Species)
data.description: You are one of the Kor'uru, called "ravenfolk" by those who can't make the appropriate clacking sound due to their lack of beak.  While your people could not fly without the aid of magic, you were always drawn to explore the world, and had traveled to nearly every country and continent even before modern society made such travel easy.  You were well-integrated into society at all levels…and that made you just as vulnerable as everyone else when it fell.

data.name: owlbear gastrolith
data.description: This strangely shaped rock was once a part of an owlbear's complex digestive system, creating a link between owl throat and bear stomach.  It is possible that it could serve a similar purpose in alchemy, helping to bind together two disparate halves.
data.//: In terms of alchemy the gastrolith could serve to combie different effects, such as safely mixing together potions, or it could be used as an element of change, such as for shapechanging potions.

data.name: stone shell
data.description: The broken fragment of an owlbear egg.  With luck it might still contain some of its former power, though if nothing else it's still a bit sharp.
data.//: Potion recipes that require a full owlbear egg could also instead require larger amounts of stone shell.  Since 1 egg gives 3 shells, you could perhaps have 1 egg be equivalent to 5 or more shells when making potions.

data.description: This bracelet has runes engraved on it.  You sense a faint air of mysticism when you look at it.  It would be useful for imbuing mana into material.
This bracelet has runes engraved on it.  You sense a faint air of mysticism when you look at it.  It would be useful for imbuing mana into material.
A wooden band with copper trimmings to be worn on the head.  Touching your temples with it on makes you feel very calm.
A wooden band with silver trimmings to be worn on the head.  Touching your temples with it on makes you feel very calm.
Strong alcohol, infused with mana and concentrated into a liquid that can stabilize spells into liquid form.  You can still drink it, if you want.
Pure ethanol saturated with magical energy.  The sheer power concentrated within causes the surface of the potion to ripple continuously.
An organ located above the kidneys responsible for secretion of adrenaline, cortisol, and aldosterone.  This one is huge, whether by nature or mutation.

data.name: glow dust
data.description: The powdered remains of a will-o-wisps's physical form.  It seems to still possess an otherworldly glow.

data.name: magical reading light
data.description: Powered by the magic of glow powder and lesser mana potions, this extremely expensive little light will provide just enough light to read by for at least a decade.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.

use_action.msg: You close the nightlight's cover.

data.description: Powered by the magic of glow powder and lesser mana potions, this extremely expensive little light will provide just enough light to read by for at least a decade.  The cover is closed.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.

use_action.msg: You open the nightlight's cover.

data.name: bulette plate
data.description: The great plates from behind a bulette's head have always been prized for use in shield and armor making.

data.name: bulette pearl
data.description: As a bulette burrows through the earth its gills collect minute amounts of precious metals and gems which slowly aggregate into lustrous gemstones prized for their beauty and power.
This is the magical essence from a dragon, distilled into a concentrated form.
A long sucking apparatus harvested from stirge corpse.  Makes a poor melee weapon.
Demon chitin turned into a paste like substance referred to as flux.  Used to create new; and fill in, repairing existing demon chitin items.
A piece of demon spider exoskeleton.  It is light and very durable, and probably has some magical properties.
Pieces of demon spider exoskeleton, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.

data.name: demon chitin plate
data.description: A large piece of demon spider exoskeleton, painstakingly cut from the corpse of an adult demon spider.  A plate of this size can be used to create armor plating.

data.name: demon spider fang
data.description: A fang from a demon spider.  It seems to still drip with poison; you might be able to use this in some alchemical recipe?

Alumentum is magically processed coal or charcoal.  It burns as hot as magnesium, and for a significantly longer period of time.  One of the very few magical materials that is still produced in any quantity today due to its usefulness.

data.name: mana dust
data.description: Crystalized mana in powdered form.  It faintly pulses with arcane energy.

data.name: mana pearl
data.description: A gemstone created by alchemy.  You can feel it attract surrounding mana.
Wood that has been infused with mana.

Mana bombs are powerful explosive devices developed by a little-known alchemist group for use against enemy spellcasters.  These bombs are fueled by pure arcane energy and can kill instantly.  The exact workings are unclear, but they appear to use some kind of massive mana burn.

name.str_pl: copies of The Basics of Caster Levels

data.description: This book goes into details about different ways to boost one's caster level above what one would normally achieve.  Domination schools can be boosted by various items detailed inside, while harmony schools can be boosted by circumstances.  Regardless, the book cautions that this boost can not exceed 1 + ( your highest caster level in that school / 5 ).  For animist, they get a boost if they stand in blood.  More blood means a higher maximum boost.  Stormshapers gets a boost while being outside during precipitation.  More precipitation means a higher maximum boost.  Earthshapers get a boost by being underground, and by standing on dirt, sand, clay or the like.  Apparently, standing in pits is also very effective.  Druids gets a boost by standing on grass, fern, bushes, and the like.  Hugging a young tree gives among the highest possible boosts for druids.

This book is written in a runic language unfamiliar to you.  Fortunately, there are several very detailed pictures that demonstrate the process of forging a sword from an ingot of silvery metal.  You get the impression that this is some sort of textbook for blacksmiths.

data.description: This is a mass-market paperback copy of Charles Darwin's famous book where he laid out his theory of evolution and the way that magic influences the course of speciation.  The book was extremely controversial when it came out for positing a recent common ancestor for humans and dwarves and for claiming that elves as a distinct species only date back to 3 million years before present.

name.str: Running on Empty: A Social History of those Born Without Magic
name.str_pl: copies of Running on Empty: A Social History of those Born Without Magic

data.description: A history of the treatment of the "Empty", people born with the inability to master even the simplest of spells.  From persecution to favored positions (since rulers could be sure the Empty had no magical means of plotting against them), this book chronicles their treatment across the ages.

name.str: Prisons and Magic: The History of Past and Present Antimagic Restraints
name.str_pl: copies of Prisons and Magic: The History of Past and Present Antimagic Restraints

data.description: A detailed overview of the means used by ancient societies to keep imprisoned magic users inside prisons.  From the chains and gag to the mana-leech shackle, this book covers the myriad of ways prisons dealt with teleportation, invisibility, intangibility and every other magic that could be used for an evasion.

This annual publication covers the latest advances in bionic technomancy, the implantation of metal into flesh.  There are some pretty promising new developments in here that will now never see the light of day.
You can't buy these, so you need to save them until the last boss!  Actually, don't even use them there!

Old recipe, used to increase the user's endurance.  The diluted version was used by different armies for fast and long forced marches.

Once wound up, it will boost your magus caster level by 2 for as long as the energy lasts.

data.description: This intricate contraption consists of fine gears, screw drivers, belts, pulleys, springs and other clockwork parts moving in a mesmerizing dance. An elegantly drawn magus rune in the center is being spun and rotated in a neverending complex dance of arcane energy. data.name: owlbear egg
data.description: This egg laid by an owlbear seems almost indistinguishable from a large rock until you touch it and can feel the warm glow of potential life energy from within.  It's hard to believe that an owlbear could grow so quickly from something so small.  Perhaps you could carefully crack it open to get at the liquid golden goodness inside.
data.//: Alchemically speaking, I see this egg as having the elements of Growth, Stone, and Egg.  Growth would make things grow faster, the simplest example being a magical liquid fertilizer.  Stone would be a defensive element, used in creating something like a potion of stoneskin.  Egg would be interesting though.  What if instead of being imbibed there were potions that instead functioned similarly to the sourdough items, or the blob vehicle parts, in that they take a gestation period and then you could activate them and have a new item pop out.  Creatures sure but especially biomancers could have temporarily-lived tools, weapons, and armor.

data.description: A large egg laid by an aenor.  You could feed a lot of people with this.

data.name: broken stone golem
data.description: A broken stone golem, not that much different from a big boulder.  Could be smashed for stone.

data.name: broken iron golem
data.description: A broken iron golem, with all iron you would possibly ever need.  Could be smashed for iron.
A broken forge born, with all orichalcum you would possibly ever need.  Could be smashed for orichalcum.

data.name: broken stone golem
data.description: A broken earthshaper's golem, almost the same as it's natural stone counterpart.  Could be smashed for stone.

data.name: broken stone golem
data.description: A broken earthshaper's golem, almost the same as it's natural stone counterpart.  Could be smashed for stone.

This is a bag that can contain more than it should.  The bag magically reduces the weight of its contents and expands less than the amount of stuff you put into it.  It takes a few words and hand-waving to take an item out.
This dimensional bag has reached the limits of human innovation with a combination of manufacturing and magical secrets.
A box that uses gravity magic to preserve food.  It makes the box much heavier, but anything in it lasts far longer and you can store more.
Each of these mithril coins has a profile of Valzain, and strangely each of these coins is defaced in some way.

use_action.description: Further deface the coin

effect_on_conditions.//: We must start our search from a road, otherwise the route reveal will fail. For whatever reason.

effect.u_message: You scratch your nails against the coin like so many before you, and feel Valzain's tears.  He longingly cries for somewhere that is not here, and now you know where.

false_effect.u_message: You rub the scratches on the coin, but leave no mark.  Oh, would-be traveller, how can you wear upon his visage like the wagon wheels upon the roads?

description.str: A generic wildwood doodad used

data.name: Awakened Water
data.//: Dilluted mana components mixed with water.  Enacted by a druid's rune.

data.description: A nutrient-rich elixir for wildwood entities.  No longer fit for consumption.
A gourd sealed with a druid's rune.  You may harvest the liquid inside when it is done brewing.

use_action.msg: The rune cracks as you open the gourd and collect the liquid.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The liquid isn't done brewing yet.

data.description: This weaver is immature, it needs to be fed with awakened water to grow.  It attentively observes its surroundings.

use_action.msg: The %s matures.  Another pair of legs sharpen into blades for cutting fabric.  It still has some room to grow.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The weaver does not have enough liquid.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The weaver isn't done growing yet.

data.description: This weaver is fully grown.  There's no light behind its eyes, yet.

use_action.msg: The %s awakens.  It gazes at you with its many eyes, ready to serve you.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The weaver does not have enough liquid.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The weaver isn't done growing yet.

data.description: You never thought you'd see the day when a wildwood entity would be so playful and docile.  This weaver is ready to serve you, and can be used to repair clothing or create a shelter.
A tiny broken weaver.  Its legs bent and broken, it can no longer be used to repair clothing or create a shelter.
A small ball made of wildwood.  A narrative relief of a stag beetle dancing wraps the ball.  A soft chittering noise can be heard from it.
data.//: Considering writing code to check for u_has_item_named so that the ball can be dynamic based on a final selector ingredient.
data.//1: Then the EOC would check for what the ball is named and do effects based on that.

use_action.msg: The %s surges in size.  It shudders and rolls around as the relief begins to move on its own.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The beetle does not have enough liquid to grow.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The beetle isn't done growing yet.

data.description: A large ball made of wildwood.  A narrative relief of a dancing stag beetle wraps the ball.  A soft chittering noise can be heard from it as the relief flows across the surface.
data.//: Add final selector for a beetle vehicle that's drag only.  Intended to be used with a tow chain, and have a small compartment for cargo.

data.description: A small druid rune wrapped in a leaf.  It appears to be made of some kind of resin, and is very sticky.
A simple carved staff, made of wood.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells.  Wielding it slightly increases your mana regeneration
A beautifully carved staff, made of enchanted wood.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells, but it is not a sturdy melee weapon.  Wielding it increases your mana regeneration.

A beautifully carved staff, made of enchanted wood and mithril.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells, but it is not a sturdy melee weapon.  Wielding it greatly increases your mana regeneration.

A sinister looking staff, made of wood and with a red orb of crystallized mana at the handle.  The orb and its rune faintly glow with magic when you cast spells.  Wielding it slightly increases your mana regeneration and allows you to cast the bleed spell.

data.name: wizard hat
data.description: A blue pointed hat with stars stitched into it.  Wearing it increases your maximum mana.

data.name: fireball hammer
data.description: Use with caution!  Flammable!  Explosive!
This cloak seems to absorb light except for the pinpricks of stars that move across its surface.
This bag conjures a magical throwing knife on activation.  Only refills when worn.  It also boosts your throwing abilities.
data.//: the bag itself gives +3 to throwing instead of knifes because of stupid code oogie woogie, that make effects (and enchantments, it seems) being apply in the very first move after the giving. ie if you give +3 to throwing for a knife, spawn it, and then throw it, it won't be applied

data.description: A pair of silver cufflinks with a wolf's head engraved into them.  Each cufflink has a bright ruby eye and pearl teeth.  They appear to be growling.  There is an inscription, 'When the moon shines.  I become alive.'

description.str: A leather belt.  Useful for making your pair of pants fit.

data.description: The mythical belt of Thor, god of thunder.  Or at least so it appears.  It doubles the wearer's base strength.
A sturdy workman's belt that fits around your waist, covered in easy to access pouches.  Like all dimensional spaces, they hold more than they should with a fair weight reduction.
A heavy-duty workman's belt that fits around your waist, covered in easy to access pouches.  Like all dimensional spaces, they hold far more than they should with a substantial weight reduction.
A wide girdle that fits around your waist, you can sheath or holster any weapon into it in the blink of an eye, and it seemingly stores them somewhere else.
A custom-built leather utility belt that instantly creates any tool that you reach for.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
A braided but flexible belt seemingly made of metal.  You can activate it to transform it into a whip and flay your enemies.

use_action.msg: You grab the belt and it uncoils to become a flexible metal whip in your hand!

data.description: A long braided flexible steel bullwhip that narrows into a sharp blade at the end.  Easily capable of slicing and dicing anything that comes at you.  It transforms back into a belt.

use_action.msg: You loop the whip in your hand and it coils back into a belt form in an instant.

data.description: Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, they look like they've seen a lot of use and will likely see a lot more.  They make your movement a lot less work.
Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, they look like they've seen a lot of use and will likely see a lot more.  They make your movement a lot less work.

Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, these boots can be activated once a day to escape from nasty situations, teleporting you a good distance in a random direction.

Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, seeming a bit more flexible and breathable than typical for their materials.  The enchantment they bear helps guide their wearer in their motions, to make movement around and over obstacles much more fluid and efficient.
Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of leather with small engraved runes seemingly filled with rubber.  When worn, you are immune to damage from electricity.

One of the traditional items of the ancient elven warrior societies, these soft leather boots are worked with silver inlays in the shape of vines and leaves.  They allow the wearer to walk in complete silence and move faster when in the wilderness.

description.str: A bracelet, completely covered with a large amount of runes from both sides.

data.description: A bracelet, completely covered with a large amount of runes from both sides.  Wizards love to name it "Ultima Ratio", describing its colossal might.  Require almost a whole week to restore its charge.

A bracelet, completely covered with a large amount of runes from both sides.  You don't really know how it works, but after use enemies literally freeze in the middle of their movement.  Require almost 7 days to restore its charge.

Known as "a worse version of petrification bracelet", this tool casts a spell that temporarily breaks the whole movement system of a creature, disabling its movement for a short time.  Require almost a week to restore its charge.

It feels like the world around you just stops.  That's not true, that's just a combination of really fast speed and some mana tricks you can't understand.  Requires a whole week to restore its charge.

description.str: A platinum bracelet covered in runes.  If it was active, it would keep its wearer from casting spells.  Now it's just another useless trinket as you do not know the spells it requires to be activated again.
A platinum bracelet covered in runes.  It cannot be removed without the appropriate spell and it constantly drains the wearer's mana, preventing them from casting any spell until they get rid of it.

data.description: A full assembly of medieval arm protection.
A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate shield engraved on the top, silver accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a light aura to reduce damage you take.
A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate shield engraved on the top, gold accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a strong aura to reduce damage you take.

A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate bundle of lightning bolts engraved on the top, silver accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a light aura to reduce electrical damage you take, as well as being able to release a Jolt spell 3 times a day.

A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate bundle of lightning bolts engraved on the top, gold accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a strong aura to reduce electrical damage you take, as well as being able to release a Lightning Bolt spell 3 times a day.

A set of leather bracers worked with images of arrows in flight and scenes of hunting parties.  Bows you wield will be more accurate and do more damage while you wear these, and you can shoot your arrows farther as well.

A pair of light leather bracers with inlays of mithril looking like vines with tiny, leaf-shaped leaves branching off of the vines.  It slightly increases your attack speed at all times, and you may activate it to greatly increase your attack speed for a short time.

A magical cloak that shimmers like fresh water under a warm sun.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form that is excellent for swimming, but ill-suited for combat.  You should probably stand in water before you put it on.

data.name: Wildshape Cloak: Bear
data.description: A magical cloak that smells of the forest.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form that is strong and resilient in melee combat.  However, you feel as if you would lose a part of yourself.

data.name: Wildshape Cloak: Deer
data.description: A magical cloak that feels soft to the touch.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form well-suited to escaping difficult situations.  However, it is not suited for combat.

One of the traditional items of the ancient elven warrior societies, this cloth cloak woven with still-living leaves makes its wearer much harder to spot in forests or dense vegetation.  Infamous for their use during the Vietnam War by elves on both sides of the conflict.

A loose silvery iridescent blouse in a style most often associated with pirates and renfaires.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.  This particular one has piratical flairs and glitters with enchantment.

A well-made pair of old-fashioned pants, made of silvery iridescent material.  Comfortable, but lacks pockets.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.  This particular one has piratical flairs and glitters with enchantment.

data.name: parabolan wool blouse
data.description: A loose silvery iridescent blouse in a style most often associated with pirates and renfaires.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.

A well-made pair of old-fashioned pants, made of silvery iridescent material.  Comfortable, but lacks pockets.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.

A padded greatcoat assembled by quilting rarely available iridescent wool that was intended as standalone armor, this is half the thickness of a historical gambeson due to the quality of its material.  Famed for its resistance to arrows in olden times, one might wonder how effective it might be against modern projectiles.

data.description: A long white coat with several large pockets, with a pentagram on the lapel and a few orichalcum threads sewn into the seams.  Perfect for the stylish-but-effective academic mage.

A long white coat with several large pockets, with a pentagram on the lapel and orichalcum and mithril threads sewn into the seams.  A director of thaumaturgical research would have worn this or something like this before the Cataclysm.

data.//: Combination of the doubled best stats of the homemade & solvent trap suppressors w/ +1 enchantment & volume reduction to half
data.description: Rather than using purely wipe media, an additional localized silence spell in this tube quiets gunshots going through to hearing-safe levels.

A small visible-light laser using light shown through a mana crystal that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.  You can rotate the attachment rail to fit under the barrel.

use_action.msg: You rotate the laser sight.

data.description: A small visible-light laser using light shown through a mana crystal that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.  You can rotate the attachment rail to fit on the rail.

use_action.msg: You rotate the laser sight.

data.name: mana dot sight
data.description: Adds a blue dot optic made from crystallized mana to the top of your gun, replacing the iron sights.  Increases accuracy and weight.

description.str: A generic magic mask.

data.description: A mask with no facial features at all, just eye and mouth holes, upon activation it makes everything ignore your presence for a while.
A decidedly steampunk-looking half mask that covers the eye area of the face, it has large lenses that correct and greatly enhance the vision of the wearer.

data.//: Effectively a durable knife spear +1 with IMPALE tech.  based off Wicked Bonespear.  Lorewise, it would make sense for novice Biomancers to be developing their skills in spears so they can adequately use the Bonespear once they're proficient enough to summon one.  Should be weaker than other school weapons DPSwise due to reach.
data.description: A grotesque bone spearhead on a stout wooden pole.  There is a Biomancer rune embedded at the base of the head.

data.//: Effectively a durable knife spear +2 and a barb launcher that shoots sharpened bone, will have less dps because it has reach and is capable of morphing into a gun
data.description: A grotesque bone spearhead on a hardened flesh pole.  There is a Biomancer rune embedded in the middle.  You feel this spear squirming in your hand as if alive.

use_action.msg: You feel the spear rapidly contracting and squirming for ranged combat

data.//: Combat stats based off crowbar +1, techniques off Halligan bar(closest non-magical substitute), weight based on 16oz clawhammer head, small wrench and crowbar with a small benefit from being magic
data.description: This staff incorporates a sturdy crescent wrench on top of a prybar and a hammer on the other in a convenient package.  There is a Technomancer rune embedded in the hammerhead.

data.//: Pretty much the same as the other, but now with a cool touchscreen that casts mirror image and does some minor things
data.description: This staff incorporates a sturdy crescent wrench on top of a prybar and a hammer on the other in a convenient package.  There are electronic components in the staff connected to a touchscreen embedded in the staff, you only had time to cram one spell in the prototype software.  There is a Technomancer rune embedded in the hammerhead.

data.//: The classical vision of the wizard gets a classic weapon.  DPS Stats are between the regular and ironshod versions.  Stats are slightly worse than the QS+1 due to the glass weight slowing attack speed.
data.description: A quarterstaff with runes carved into it and two glass jars, heat-tempered and infused with mana for durability, to act as mana receptacles.  There are two Magi runes embedded at the tips.

data.//: It will be based on the Q +2 weapon but slightly worse, slightly better than the magus staff, but its greatest strength will be its regen mana capabilities, better than magi staff minor but worse than the lesser one.
data.description: A quarterstaff with runes carved into it and two mana pearls at the tip, enchanted with mana for durability.  It fills you with an invigorating sensation.  There are two Magi runes carved into the wood.

data.//: Flame-bladed sword covers half of Kelvinist's heat-cold theme.  Combat stats equivalent to cutlass +1 with BRUTAL technique.
data.description: A sword with an undulating blade, reminiscent of a flame.  There is a Kelvinist rune embedded in the pommel.

data.//: Stats based on scimitar +2, a weapon that will cast freezing touch when it hits, has wide strike
data.description: This curved sword, reminiscent of a scimitar, has a handle with an embedded crystal from which a cold wind emanates.  There are Kelvinist runes embedded in the blade.

data.//: Based off battle axe +1.  Metals chosen for being two most conductive metals + balancing reasons
data.description: A forged copper axe with silver trimmings and a wooden handle.  There is a Stormshaper rune embedded in the eye.

data.//: There isn't an equivalent, so the damage has been multiplied by 1.2 to cutting and bashing
data.description: A forged copper hammer-axe with silver trimmings and a wooden handle.  There is a Stormshaper rune embedded in the eye and a Nordic rune reminiscent of Thor, the thunder god, in the hammer side.

data.//: Tool qualities equivalent to steak knife, combat equiv.  to copper knife + 1 w/ RAPID and BLOCK1, size/weight off combat knife +1
data.description: A steel ritual knife used by Animists to draw blood for summoning.  Their school rune is embedded in the crossguard.

data.//: Tool qualities equivalent to combat knife with some saw capability, to represent sharpness, combat equiv.  to combat knife + 2 w/ RAPID and BLOCK1 with no to hit, size/weight off combat knife +1
data.description: A steel ritual knife used by Animists to draw blood for summoning.  The knife has seen so much bloodshed that the rune at the crossguard seemingly is constantly drenched in blood and gives you preternatural resistance to pain.
This versatile weapon uses Technomancy-enhanced springs to keep the staff tips retracted while in baton configuration.  Activate to extend.

use_action.msg: You snap open your springstaff into staff mode.

data.description: This versatile weapon uses Technomancy-enhanced springs to keep the staff tips from retracting while in staff configuration.  Activate to extend.

use_action.msg: You collapse your springstaff into baton mode.

data.//: Pretty similar to the war scythe, but with less weight, more cutting damage and capable of casting a strong offensive spell.
data.description: This is a long and crooked tool used to reap souls, with a skull engraved in its blade.  Magically treated to reduce weight and enhance sharpness, this enchanted weapon is even capable of delivering a strong rupture attack.  Let the harvest begin.

data.name: heat cube
data.description: A smooth steel cube the size of your fist.  Several buttons on the sides activate the powers of the cube.

use_action.msg: You push the torch button and the cube emits a large flame from the top, one that does radiate heat, but won't burn anything.

data.description: The heat cube in the torch configuration, where it emits warmth and a bright flame that does not burn.

use_action.msg: The torch flame is extinguished.

data.description: A small gold skeleton key.  You can activate it to unlock locked things.
This is a high quality engraved wooden torch.  On command, the tip bursts into flame and produces a fair amount of light.  It will burn forever.

use_action.msg: You light the torch.
The torch is extinguished.
You open the flask and discover it full of sweet, sweet, whiskey!

data.description: A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.

use_action.msg: You check the teapot and discover it full of sweet tea!  Sadly, it's cold.

data.name: enchanted tailor's kit
data.description: This is a high quality, engraved steel kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, some small scissors, even a small heating element for melting and joining plastic.  Use a tailor's kit to customize your clothing and armor.  This uses your tailoring skill.  It also contains one of those magic spiders that constantly, if slowly, makes new thread.
This is a small glass box that contains a spider that diligently works day and night to produce silk thread that it stores in a reservoir you can open and retrieve it from.
A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load a bolt-action rifle.

data.//: Equivalent to composite bow for dispersion/reload/weight/range/encumb/bash, with two mod slots added equivalent to other weapons getting techniques
data.description: A bow made of multiple materials to maximize energy efficiency.  There are two Druid runes embedded at the tips.

A magically-enhanced update to the Phillips & Rodgers' M47 Medusa, a  multi-caliber revolver aimed at survivalists.  While Technomancy improves the reliability with smaller cartridges, it is not as accurate as dedicated caliber revolvers due to freebore.

name.str: Pistolet modèle Gardes de la Marine
name.str_pl: several Pistolet modèle Gardes de la Marine

data.description: These beautifully-made enchanted flintlock pistols were specially made for young noble scions in the Gardes de la Marine.  They still exist today as unspeakably-rare heirlooms that remain combat-worthy due to their magical nature.

data.name: gunblade
data.description: Constructed similarly to a falcata, this forward-sloping blade has a short-barrel pump shotgun attached to the blade's spine for finishing blows or a first strike.
A modernized version of the Mosin-Nagant 1891/30 by Cannith Industries, chambered in 7.62x51 NATO.  The barrel is enchanted to give bullets a minor freezing property.

Once a flesh spear, now a grotesque pipe like object with an barrel made from bone and coated in flesh.  There is an biomancer rune embedded in the tooth like trigger.  Uses sharpened bone as an ammo.

use_action.msg: You feel the spear rapidly contracting and squirming for close combat

data.description: A sharp bone, you wonder why someone had the trouble to make this.

One of the traditional items of the ancient elven warrior societies, this bow is enchanted to fire further, hit harder, and last longer than any normal wooden bow of its design could.  Before the Cataclysm they were still made in small quantities for ceremonial purposes but no longer saw battlefield use, since the special forces of Tokoyo, Hy-Brasil, Alfheim, and the other elven nations long ago switched to using firearms.
data.//: based on a light composite bow.  The actual enchantments are 50% increased range and higher damage and durability, the relic_data is just to make it purple.

An ornate silver ring engraved with daggers that conjures three mundane throwing knives on activation.

A thin gold band ring, depicting a bicephalous eel coiled on itself.  Allows you to dodge two extra attacks per turn.

A silver ring that makes you a good bit stronger when you wear it.

A crimsonite ring with a dappled pattern that protects you from fire.
A platinum ring that allows you fly for a short time each day, and prevents fall damage while worn.

data.//: Extremely valuable in the apocalypse.
data.description: A golden ring that greatly reduces your need to eat, drink, or sleep while it is worn.  It will do nothing for feelings of hunger, and it requires a full day of being worn for the magic to take effect.

data.name: longsword token
data.description: A large silver coin that, when activated by uttering the word on the back, turns into the item pictured on the front, in this case a longsword.

use_action.msg: You say the command word engraved on the token, and it rapidly grows and morphs into a shiny pristine longsword!

data.description: A magical flexible stonelike substance for protection and attack.

data.name: finger firelighter
data.description: This is a small flame you can hold in your hand.  With a thought, you can cause it to light something on fire, or you can throw it to ignite something flammable.

data.name: stable spark
data.description: Small electric spark, that does not disappear under your force.  With a thought, you can cause it to light something on fire, or you can throw it to ignite something flammable.

data.name: magic lamp
data.description: A magical light source that will light up a small area.

data.name: magic light
data.description: A small magical light that you can read by.
A lightweight but tough shield crafted entirely of magical ice.
A magical slick icy coating on your feet.  While quite fast on flat floors, they make it difficult to move on rough terrain.
A crackling magical warhammer full of lightning to smite your foes with, and of course, to smash things to bits!
Encases your arm and hand in a sheath of crackling magical lightning, you can punch and defend yourself with it in melee combat.

data.name: vicious tentacle whip
data.description: A long, writhing, tentacle covered in sharp bonelike blades and spikey protrusions.

data.name: flarewhip
data.description: A long whip made of blue-hot magical flames.  The heat is horrendous when touching an enemy.
A large pouch of tough flesh on your back, filled with tiny tentacles that grasp and hold anything you place inside.  It shifts and adjusts itself to minimize encumbrance.
This is a wicked spear/halberd hybrid entirely created of bone.
A magically conjured ornate recurve bow of solid flexible wood.  A matching conjured wooden arrow appears when you draw the string back for firing.
A magically conjured quiver, marvelously light and easy to wear despite the arrows it holds.
A magically conjured quiver, marvelously light and easy to wear despite the arrows it holds.  This is an enhanced version, created by your increased mastery of the spell.
A magically conjured arrow made of twisted wood.
A arrow that looks more like it was grown than carved.  Despite that, it flies straight and true.  It explodes into a mass of entangling vegetation when it hits its target.

use_action.msg: You squeeze the seed in your palm, and it begins to turn to a fine dust.

data.description: A magical seed that can be squeezed to release purifying dust, which can then be used to purify up to a gallon of water.
This handful of fine dust glows with a growing intensity.
A magical powder that can be scattered on growing crops to make them grow faster.
A thin layer of magical ice, covering the entire body.  It doesn't provide much armor, instead dealing significant damage to enemies that try to attack you.
A thin layer of shifting, almost fluid living rock, covering the entire body.

desc: This burn really hurts!

data.description: Ouch, this really smarts!  It'll go away soon, maybe?
An all-encompassing, invisible layer of magical aura that protects you from the environment.

data.name: feral aura
data.//: Needs to remain an item instead of an effect until enchantment mutations from effects are fixed.
data.description: The manifestation of your rage.  It won't disappear until you calm down.

data.name: enhanced feral aura
data.//: Needs to remain an item instead of an effect until enchantment mutations from effects are fixed.
data.description: The manifestation of your rage.  It won't disappear until you calm down.
This wooden sword is ablaze!  It seems to be safe-ish to hold, but will burn up soon.
A pulsating club made of bone, stained with an ever-moving blood coating eager to absorb the living.
A leather sling, quivering with energy when in your palm to the point of almost tearing.  A pebble appears when you begin spinning it.

data.name: werewolf aura
data.description: You have become the werewolf.  Boys becoming men, men becoming wolves.

data.name: Black Dragon Shell
data.description: An aura of black and green draconic energy, swirling around your body protecting you and punishing those who strike you.
Claws made from ice, able to freeze on contact while mauling foes.  You, however, feel only a slight chill on your hands.
A summoned magic armor.  It gets shinier and sturdier with each spell level and is affected by your intelligence.
A three-liter container made out of transparent force.  Can be used to store liquids.
This is a summoned mana sword, between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  It glows shiny, and its edge is sharper the more spell level and intelligence you have.
A sturdy shell that wraps your body, granting a sturdy defense.
A small, capsule-shaped field containing a stable portal to the sun.  You can feel solar energy radiating from it, and it saturates your body.

use_action.msg: You cover the pocket sun, and now the gap doesn't emit light.

data.description: A small, capsule-shaped field containing a stable portal to the sun.  It is currently covered.

use_action.msg: You remove the cover on the pocket sun, and now the gap emits light again.

data.description: A small ethereal pocket located under your left arm.  You can store your potions here, but it seems it has no real limitations.
A thin and flat knife made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A thin and flat knife made for throwing, wrapped in ethereal flames.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A thin and flat knife made for throwing, emanating frigid cold.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A thin and flat knife with wide edge made for throwing, seems unnaturally sharp.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A thin and flat knife made for throwing, made of porous substance and covered in dark ooze.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
A transparent blade that seems to radiate intent to be thrown.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
Shaped with your own magic, this tool has the same abilities as the common hammer.

use_action.msg: Your hammer transforms into a pickaxe!

use_action.msg: Your ax transforms into a knife!

data.description: Shaped with your own magic, this tool has the same abilities as the common shovel.

data.description: Now you can breath under water, like a fish.
These two tiny shields on your temples should protect your mind from outside influences
The tiny shields all over your body should protect your mind from outside influences and your body from being moved by outside magic
Some free-floating elastic potential energy.
A mixture of bark, moss, and leaves, glowing softly with verdant energy.
A magically-summoned aetherspeaker, capable of communicating long-distance with other aetherspeakers or conventional radios.  With a command word, it may instead scan for radio signals.
An aetherspeaker tuned to listen for radio signals from the surrounding area.  With a command word, it may change frequency or switch to communicating with other aetherspeakers or radios.
A smoothly-curved conglomeration of mana, humming softly as it provides power.

data.description: Your hands can spark with electricity powerful enough to heat metal to searing temperatures and weld it together.  You can also zap the undead with it.
A twisted wooden spear whose branches twine together into a vicious point sticky with sap.

Your fingers are a series of knives made of bone and flesh.  Enemies beware.

data.name: Aquatic Mantle

data.description: A large, hollow sphere of ice.  Food placed inside will not rot.

data.name: Rime-Frozen Heart
data.description: You don't feel anything.

data.name: bearmantle
data.description: Think as the bear.  Move as the bear.  Sleep as the bear.
A bone from some creature or other, inhabited by benevolent spirits.
This lens has been etched with small symbols and infused with mana.  Holding it up to your eye allows you to see further than any mundane binoculars allow.
A set of magical berries.  They look absolutely delicious.

data.//: Will not unbreak your limbs, but heals you.

data.description: Blood of a dragon, it radiates warmth and looking at it you see moving patterns form and disappear in it as if looking at an actual fire.
Blood that is filled to the brim with arcane energy.  It releases a faint blue glow.
A tall, homemade candelabra that holds multiple everburning torches.  You could set it up somewhere to kindle the torches and provide light.

This is a high quality engraved wooden torch, placed into a wood and metal sconce and ready to be attached to a wall.  It will burn forever with a smokeless light.  Now you can light your wizard's ritual room in the traditional fashion.

This is a beautiful, non-scale model of the solar system.  A complex series of gears allows the relative motions of the planets to be studied at the turn of a crank.  You could set this up somewhere to decorate.
A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back, all seemingly grown out of a single solid piece of wood.  Despite the twisted lines, it still looks extremely comfortable.
A smallish patch of iridescent felt; could be disassembled for parabolan wool fiber.
Parabolan wool yarn; could be used to knit iridescent wool clothing.

This strange plant feels slightly oily and smells odd.  The smell seems to change slowly, from loamy earth to a rich vegetal smell to something acrid that burns your nose to an herbal scent, with no discernable pattern.  You're not sure what this is.
data.//: As the id indicates, this is a triffid spellbook, encoding information using scents and chemical triggers.  There's essentially zero chance of the survivor figuring out how to read it.

data.//2: there will be some thoughts about how this alchemy stuff works. the relation are pretty stretchy, because I don't want to make bazillion of plants for each purpose, so don't mind if 'light' related plant will occur in 'darkness' flask effect
data.//: same as barnacle weed, 'duration' and 'sustaining', but not so long and more powerful, for effective and non standard effects like night vision
data.description: A fractal corolla winds inward in mathematical harmony, reflecting beauty in its ideal form.

data.//: exotic, rare component for high level potions
data.description: A handful of moonflowers glitter like tiny stars and faintly smell of morning dew.  Properly harvested, they will never wilt or wither.

data.//: magical poisons, 'death' and 'bio' related
data.description: A small rod of curled white petals, delicately shielding toxic pollen that will lead to an agonizing, if mercifully quick death.  Infamously used by romantic assassins, when an artistic death is deemed more important than practicality.
Dark colored leaves and bitter roots, firmly tied together in a small sheaf.  It's not toxic, but many people have died trying to taste it, due to the airway obstruction.
data.//: armor' and 'summon' related
'light' related, partially 'speed'
data.description: Slim stripes cut from a bioluminescent mushroom, still surrounded by a faint glowing aura.

data.//: 'healing' related
data.description: Pure white moss capsules, shaped like a goat's horn.  The fine spores contained within are a powerful magical reagent, and can be consumed to recover small amounts of health.

data.//: another high level component, 'mana' related
data.description: Stalks cut from a golden reed.  They have a strong, spiced aroma.

data.//: 'duration' and 'sustaining'
data.description: Heavy wooden shells surrounding a diminutive white fruit.

data.//: 'range', 'area', 'aoe'
data.description: Knife sharp thorns from a dragonail bush.  Eating them raw would be a dangerous challenge.

data.//: breaks magic enchantments (whatever that means), used to make magic armor, maybe 'breaks' related (like increasing the damage/armor penetration abilities)
data.description: The black root of a moly plant, extracted from the ground through great effort.  Rumored to grant protection to those who consume it.

data.//: stat bonuses
data.description: A small flower cut from a fern, it has a faint honeyed aroma.  Believed to bring good luck to whoever finds it.

data.//: low and middle level spell component, same as mana crystals, weak 'mana' related
data.description: Large chunks of funnelcap meat, still leaking fine amounts of clear sap.

data.//: 'teleportation' related
data.description: A red puffball flower cut from a sojourner's palm.  When wind wafts between its petals, you can hear the sounds of faraway places.

data.//: alchemy bases material, maybe its possible to make a moonshine using it
data.description: A pink whisk shaped flower with a powerful alcoholic smell.
A set of goblin teeth, small but needle-sharp.
A set of lizardfolk teeth, made for biting chunks of out their prey.
You have a majestic crown of antlers.
Your scales have grown to cover your hands and elongate the tips in to jagged claws that can be serviceable as cutting and piercing weapons in unarmed combat.
Your index fingers have become talons.  They make for wicked natural daggers.  Unfortunately, they get in the way of everything including gloves.

All of your fingers have developed into huge scaled talons.  They prevent wearing gloves, but you can use them to powerful effect in melee combat and you appear to have uncovered some secrets about black dragons.
Thin but as tough as titanium, your draconic black scale can even withstand bullets from small firearms
The damage done and light emitted by this sword increase with intelligence.
This magical armor improves with your intelligence and the spell's level.
A magical hammer whose damage increases with the spell.
A coating of lighting on your hand and lower arm.
Icy talons to freeze your enemies.
Unleashing the rage within.
Unleashing the rage within.

data.//: relic_data is set when the item is created and then never changes, so each luck-bone should have random minor effects.  All deliberately picked so they can't be seen on the character sheet
data.description: The spirits within are giving you their blessing.
Looking through your enchanted lens allows you to see farther than ever.
Some crystallized mana.  This can be reloaded into rechargeable mana crystals, but can never be unloaded.
This is a small mana crystal specifically designed to be attached to wand tips.
Mjölnir, the legendary hammer of Thor.  It is rumored to be able to level mountains with a single blow.  You feel the power of Asgard coursing through the hammer.
Gungnir, the spear of Odin.  It is rumored to be the perfect spear, perfectly hitting any target regardless of the wielder's strength or skill.  It feels like Odin's protecting you.
Gram, the sword of Sigurd.  It is rumored to be the sword that slayed the legendary dragon, Fafnir.  Once said to have cleaved Regin's anvil in half, the edge is impeccable.
Laevateinn, the staff of Loki.  Said to have been plucked from the gates of Hel by Loki.  Imbued with a mysterious magic, the magic of the trickster god himself.

A variant of the combat knife that is made of orichalcum instead of steel.  Sharper and easier to maintain than steel while just as dense, this knife also has a thinner blade, which shaves off some weight.

A variant of the longsword that is made of orichalcum instead of steel.  Sharper and easier to maintain than steel while just as dense, this longsword also has a thinner blade, which shaves off some weight.
A fire axe made with orichalcum instead of steel.  This makes it possible to chop through harder materials, and in the very well-funded fire stations is preferred.

Wolfsbane pikes are generally antiques brought over from Europe.  Forged during the days when the Black Forest went from France to Transylvania, these spears targeted the Loup Garou that were weak against fire.

This is a classic medieval sword, the size being in-between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords.  Thanks to the mysterious silvery metal it was forged from, it is stronger than tempered steel while weighing substantially less.
A lump of raw orichalcum.  Needs to be reformed into an ingot to be useful.
