data.description: You now depend on the proximity to the earth to sleep well.  Should you sleep or torpor aboveground or not surrounded by earth, you will suffer penalties for the next day.

name.str: Vampiric weakness: rebuked by holy ground

data.description: Your flesh will burn should you ever enter a sanctified area.  Only places that are holy will burn you, so holy places filled with vampires or unholy humans are safe for you to enter.
data.//: Unsafe: churches, cathedrals, synagogues, rural churches, eventual other holy places.
data.//2: Safe: Vampire-filled holy places, the New England Community Church, anywhere not unsafe.

name.str: Vampiric weakness: melted by vast water

data.description: Your flesh will melt should you ever try to cross a large body of water or get too close to them.  Only rivers, lakes and oceans have enough water to trigger this weakness, but it will take effect even if floating or water-walking.
data.//: Unsafe: rivers, lakes, oceans.
data.//2: Safe: anywhere else.

data.description: Animals cannot tolerate your wicked presence.  Expect any animal you encounter to either flee or attack you on sight.
Fire damages you far more than it should.  You take massive damage from fire and flames, mundane and magical.

name.str: Vampiric weakness: cold as a corpse

data.description: You now lack any body heat.  You feel colder at all times, and being cold will slow you down.

You now need to drink some fresh, warm blood from a living being once in a while or suffer growing penalties.  You better find someone willing to share their blood, as blood from fresh corpses won't satisfy this need.
Your ability to process varied types of blood is now hampered.  Blood that isn't regular human blood will only sate your thirst half as much.
Your thirst for blood will occasionally magnify, causing painful cravings.  You can calm these cravings as or before they happen by consuming blood.

name.str: Vampiric weakness: barred from mortal joys

data.description: Blood is the only thing that can bring a smile to your lips.  Nothing else gives you any lasting joy or pleasure.  It is impossible for you to be truly happy unless you recently consumed blood.

data.//: Required for vampire blood to have any consumption benefit.  Regular vampires instinctively feel threatened by you and their renfields try to protect them, so they react accordingly.
data.//2: The traits unlocked by this have no category, as they aren't given by the regular mutation system.
data.description: Through the consumption of self-cannibalizing vampire blood, you gained the ability to consume vampire blood to gain vampiric abilities undreamt of by other vampires.
Your vestigial circulatory system is now better at holding stolen blood.  You can hold five more liters inside you.
Your ability to see in the dark has expanded.  You no longer need to spend blood to maintain your gleaming eyes.
You can now attract the blood within a corpse's veins, extracting it all in a second through a small cut.  In addition, you can create temporary blood containers out of some of your stolen blood.
In comparison to you, regular vampires are the same as mortals.  You can now detect nearby vampires, your new prey, even through walls.

Your digestive system has warped to repurpose some vestigial parts, making you much better at drinking blood.  Drinking reasonable amounts of blood won't ever stretch your stomach, and you drink blood much faster now.
Your supernatural senses have expanded.  You can now see anything close to some nocturnal creatures, even if they lack sight.

data.//: The main draw of BLOOD_FUN is fae blood being a net morale positive.  The main draw of this upgrade is getting stat boosts from the high morale.
data.description: Becoming more vampire than vampires are has affected your new palate, making the consumption of blood feel even better than before.  You now enjoy drinking blood so much that enough of it will bolster your resolve for a while.
Your lack of movement noise is now encompassing any noise you could do in combat.  All such noises you would've made by attacking in melee are nullified.

data.//: Behaves as the anathema's threshold, letting the EOC give the stronger traits.  The enabler is a threshold to limit mixing regular mutations and this path.
data.//2: A few mentors knew that this was possible, but they kept the secret to not threaten the plan.
data.description: You drank enough vampire blood to gain access to power the mentors never thought possible.  There is no more limit to how powerful of a vampire you can be.
Your new power allows you to store even more stolen blood inside your body.  You can hold another ten liters inside you.

data.description: Darkness is your new friend, and like a good friend it helps you through hard times.  Passively heal your wounds and reduce your pain while away from the sun.

The powers of vampires come through their sustenance of blood, and you now know how to use this at your advantage.  You can increase your need for blood to boost your vampiric potency until you decide to stop the effect.  If you do not have enough blood, it will have no effect until you drink more blood.
data.activation_msg: Your power increases as your blood burns away.

data.description: Increases blood potency and drain while the player-visible version is active and has enough blood.  You should never see this.

Being protected against mundane afflictions only is something your flesh has stopped tolerating.  Your condition now protects you from any illness, parasite and poison, no matter how dangerous they are.
You are much more attuned to your other forms, and they are now easier to activate than ever.  The cost to activate them is halved.
Your instinctive mastery of your mist form has expanded.  You now recover from triggering Last Breath's Mist twice as quickly.
Vampires, mortals, they are all the same for you now.  Drinking vampire blood now gives all the benefits of drinking regular blood, in addition to growing your power.
Your own blood now reveals its secrets to you.  Every week, you will gain a new gift of the blood.  It will only give you what researching your blood gifts could give you.

name.str: Maximal Mastery of the Mortal Mind

data.description: Your mind-control abilities are much simpler to use now, halving their cost.

name.str: Anathema's Weakness: Slain by the Sun

data.description: Vampires burn under the sun, and becoming more of a vampire made you burn far more than any other vampire would.  While under the sun, you will take constant damage no matter how covered you are.

Your constant consumption of vampire blood has permanently destabilized your mind, and it will only grow worse with each new vampire drained.  Each time you drink vampire blood, you have a growing chance to gain a new mental affliction.

Drinking all this vampire blood has left your body yearning for more.  Going too long without drinking vampire blood will progressively increase your thirst for blood with each passing day until you starve or drink vampire blood.

Through a complicated ritual utilizing a saint's relic, you have transubstantiated your own blood with the holy blood of the saints.  It'll prevent you from becoming infected with vampirism while you live, effects postmortem unknown.
You aren't where you seem to be.
You are no longer limited to the five senses common to most humans in your hunt for the unnatural.
Boann bestowed upon you the right to summon a few daffodil warriors once a day.
You were born with an allergy to iron and, to a lesser extent, steel.  Wearing or touching anything made of iron or steel will cause you pain and discomfort.
The Fair Folk can sense the stolen power within you and their vengeance will be terrible.

data.//: General principle for spells below is--spells that involving growing or nurturing plants in the long-term are intelligence-based, other spells are perception-based.  Briarwall (long-term) is thus Intelligence, whereas Hungry Thirsty Roots is Perception because the roots die within minutes.
data.name: Commune with Nature
data.description: You concentrate on nature around you and commune with it, improving your health and calming the nearby wildlife.  This spell may only be cast outdoors in natural surroundings.

data.name: Cultivate Goblin Fruit
data.description: You may spin a bit of fae magic into a plant, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast outdoors in natural surroundings.

data.name: Treesinging
data.description: Using your voice and your magic, bring forth living wood from a tree to provide resources without harming the forest.
data.message: You close your eyes and sing to the trees.

data.name: Verdant Infusion
data.description: You draw on your own connection to nature and infuse some of its power into one of your allies, healing them for a small amount and increasing their overall health.

data.name: Roots Crack the Foundation
data.description: Roots can grow through even concrete given time.  With this spell, you can compress that time into a single instant to shatter walls or rip doors off their hinges.

data.name: Call the Children of the Roots
data.description: A lesser wood spirit is summoned to support you.

While in the wild, weave together some leaves and grasses and magick to form a container that will keep its contents from rotting for a length of time.  The container will only last a few weeks at most.

description.str: The actual spell that summons the container.  It's a bug if you have it directly.

data.name: Viridescent Vessel
data.description:
Trees require water but will still drown if submerged.  This spell allows the Arvore to create a floral boat with the help of a nearby tree, letting them travel safely across water.

You must be standing <color_yellow>next to a tree</color> and <color_yellow>near the water</color> for the spell to be effective.

description.str: The actual spell to summon the boat.  If you have it, it's a bug.

data.name: Briarwall

data.name: Nurturing the Green

data.name: Spreading the Viridian Mantle
data.description: Rather than fostering the growth of a single plant, you can cause a wave of growth all around you, affecting an entire field and bringing it towards ripeness.

data.message: The soil churns as thick vines burst forth and shoots toward the sky.

data.name: Den of Brambles
data.description: When outside on diggable ground, create a small structure of wood near the Arvore, offering shelter against the elements.
Your command over plants allows you to cause grass to grow in profusion from the soil, making the terrain very difficult for enemies to traverse.

name.//~: The name is a reference to the poem "Goblin Market" by Christina Rossetti.

data.description: Your command over plants allows you to call forth roots from the earth to clutch and grasp at your enemies.

data.name: Perennial Rebirth
data.description: Bind your soul to the heart of the forest, rebirthing yourself if you should die.  You may only perform this in thick forests or at an arvore altar, you may be reborn no more than once in a lunar month.

data.name: Overgrowth
data.description: While outdoors and not underground, the Arvore can create a profusion of life around themselves, causing grass to grow through pavement, bushes and flowers to sprout, and trees to grow to full height in moments.

data.name: Fallen Trees Decay to Soil
data.description:
Even the mightiest tree returns to soil in the end.  The Arvore may channel this natural process into an area around themselves, infecting everyone within with the energies of rot.

<color_yellow>This spell is indiscriminate</color> and <color_red>should not be used near allies</color>.

data.name: Traverse the Wilds
data.description: Roots grow together and so forests are connected.  The Arvore may use this connection to quickly transport themselves tree to tree, stepping into an adjacent tree and then stepping out of another one within the spell's range.

description.str: Roots grow together and so forests are connected.  The Arvore may use this connection to quickly transport themselves tree to tree, stepping into an adjacent tree and then stepping out of another one within the spell's range.

data.name: From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined
data.description: All forests are connected at their hearts.  You can use this connection to travel from the depths of a forest to the depths of another forest, if you properly attune to your destination.

data.name: Root to Root Attunement
data.description: Attune to a location for later traveling.  You must attune within the depths of a forest.

description.str: The actual Root to Root attunement spell.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.name: Verdant Imprisonment
data.description: The ultimate expression of nature's power, you can turn your target into a tree that might have stood for a century or more.  It works best on an already-weakened target, and does not work at all on non-organic targets.

description.str: This is the banishment that the target casts on themselves.

data.name: Embrace of the Verdant Mother
data.description:
While outdoors and not underground, the Arvore can unleash the power of nature against their enemies.  The walking dead and most creatures not native to the world suffer the Earthmother's wrath, while animals and humans are healed.  Triffids, being plants, are healed as well.

Note that this power is <color_yellow>indiscriminate</color>: if the Arvore has somehow bound a Nether creature to their service, it will be damaged, and hostile humans will be healed.
Your skin has turned the color of spring growth.  Your skin is now a viridian green.  This has no gameplay effects.
Your skin has turned into a type of plant matter, which in addition to any armoring slows your loss of fluids.
The skin on your body has grown into a barklike state.  This provides significantly more armor but reduces flexibility.

data.//: This needs its own ID to be only a type SKIN mutation
data.description: It's subtle, but your skin has definitely taken on a sickly yellow-green hue.
A viridian moss has grown on your skin, forming whorls and eldritch patterns, providing some protection from the cold and the wet.  It also provides a small amount of armor against acid or fire.
You are in tune with the forest and the triffids will allow you safe passage in their lands, so long as you do not harm them.

The trees recognize you as one of their own and allow you to pass easily beneath their boughs.  The grass moves under your feet to speed your passage, and shrubs bend out of the way.  When walking on grass, trees, or other natural foliage, your movement speed is increased.

data.//: This only causes growth in existing plants.  Growing new plants from nothing should be advanced mutations/spells.

data.description: Arvore with this ability have a seed pocket on their body that over time fills with a set of from this region of the world.  Each time new seeds appear they will all be of the same type, but the types will vary at random.
data.//: This is currently character creation only, ideally there will be ways to get this later in game.

name.str: From Root to Root the Forest Is Joined

data.description: Upon gaining this ability, the Arvore gains the ability to travel great distances, even dozens of miles, in moments, as long as they start and end their journey within the depths of a forest.
Upon gaining this ability, the Arvore gains the ability to cause rapid plant growth in a radius around themselves.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to bind their soul to the heart of the forest, rebirthing themselves when on the verge of death.
You have bound your soul to the forest, and death will merely be a momentary inconvenience.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to infuse their companions with the vitality of the forest.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to cause grass to rapidly grow on fertile terrain, slowing their enemies.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to summon a thick climbing vine from diggable ground.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to damage plant and fungal entities, including others of their own kind.
Upon gaining this ability the Arvore gains the ability to grow a goblin fruit when in natural areas away from civilization.
The Arvore are closely tied with the forests and may commune with the trees to learn the layout of the land.  Activate this ability to enter the communion.
Drawing out the power inherent in growing wood makes weapons composed of it more deadly in your hands.  You do increased damage when wielding a weapon primarily made of wood.
With a brief effort of will, the Arvore may infuse their blood with a poison that harms any who bite them.
data.activation_msg: Your skin itches.

data.description: The Arvore may release clouds of pollen that ruin the coordination of their enemies when breathed in.
data.activation_msg: The air fills with clouds of pollen.

data.description: Like a tree, you are fueled by the sun.  When standing in the sunlight, you will absorb its energy as nutrients and heal slightly faster.
data.//: No messages so you aren't constantly spammed while you're walking in and out of buildings.  Being a fae spirit, the arvore doesn't need uncovered arms or head or anything--simply being in the sun is enough.

data.description: Like a tree, you are fueled by the sun.  When standing in the sunlight, you will absorb its energy as nutrients, heal slightly faster, and your mana regenerates much quicker.
data.//: No messages so you aren't constantly spammed while you're walking in and out of buildings.  Being a fae spirit, the arvore doesn't need uncovered arms or head or anything--simply being in the sun is enough.

data.description: Your energy changes with the seasons: in spring and summer, you're more awake and need less sleep, and the reverse is true in autumn and winter.

Like a tree, you draw nourishment from the sun and the soil.  When standing in the sunlight and on natural terrain, you absorb its energy as food.  You still need to drink water and you will still get hungry.
Filled with the energy of life, pain does not affect you as strongly.
At will, you can extend a cluster of grasping vines to grab one target and drag them in.  They have a range equal to 1/2 your Dexterity.
data.activation_msg: Vines lash out toward your target.

data.description: At will, you can transform your hands into jagged wooden claws.  They are potent weapons but make anything other than combat more difficult.
data.activation_msg: Your fingers itch as jagged wood rapidly covers them.

data.description: Your hands are transformed into jagged wooden claws.  You can use them to attack, but performing mundane tasks will be harder.
Plants lose their leaves in winter, but that does not kill them, they simply sleep until the spring comes.  The cold bothers you less now.
Pine trees keep their leaves even in the coldest winter.  The cold bothers you now not at all.
By the places of the sun and the moon, you can always tell exactly what time it is, as long as you're not underground.
The wilderness welcomes you as one of its own, and you have an easier time surviving there and making things from its bounty.  +1.5 Survival skill.
Like green wood, you can bend your limbs easily.  You gain a +4 bonus to Dexterity.
Like the seedling poking through the soil, you have great strength hidden within you.  +1 Strength.
Like the young tree reaching for the sun, your limbs are filled with power.  +3 Strength.
Like forest giants that have stood for a hundred years, you are unshakeable.  +5 Strength.
When one tree in a grove is attacked by insects, soon all trees will produce the deterrent.  +3 Perception.
The forest recognizes your kinship and will hide you beneath its boughs.  When in a forest or in thick foliage, enemies will have a harder time spotting you.
data.//: Ideally there'd be some way to detect what sort of terrain was nearby and you'd need a critical mass of foliage, but the below will work for now.

data.description: Upon gaining this ability the Arvore's eyes begin reflecting the seasons: a bright yellow-green in spring; verdant green in summer; red, yellow, or orange in autumn, and dark brown in winter.  Glare no longer impacts them.
The Arvore's ears are longer and pointed, more "leaf-shaped."  While they cannot hear any better, like the trees in the deep forest, they are unphased by loud sounds.

data.//: Visibility here because the Arvore's skin flushes a different color when the blood isn't red.
data.description: The Arvore's blood is now composed of sap and vegetable matter.  This does not benefit or harm them in any ways, but humans will be discomfited by it.
The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds.  They will bleed more slowly than normal.

The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds and has potent defensive properties.  They will bleed more slowly than normal and are immune to parasites and infection.

The Arvore's blood is a sticky sap that oozes rather than gushes from their wounds and aggressively fights back against invading organisms.  They will bleed much more slowly than normal, are immune to parasites and infection, and cannot be transformed by the Mycus.

At will, the Arvore can grow long vines from their shoulders and back.  They can be used to climb or to lash at enemies, and can also be detached to serve as a rope if necessary.  Activate to toggle vines on and off.
data.activation_msg: Lashing vines grow from your shoulders.

data.description: In the whispers of the leaves and the movement of the grasses, the forest warns you of nearby creatures.  While the forest can distinguish between a bird and a zombie, some fine distinctions are still lost to it.

In the whispers of the leaves and the movement of the grasses, the forest warns you of nearby creatures.  While the forest can distinguish between a bird and a zombie, some fine distinctions are still lost to it.  Also, you can see further when you're standing in a forest.
Your hair now has flowers and small vines and leaves growing in it.  It's pleasant to look at but has no further game effect.
The flowers in your hair produce a pleasant smell, obvious without being overpowering.  You no longer smell anything like a human and other beings will react to you appropriately.

Every rose has its thorn and so do you.  With a moment's concentration, you can exude thorns through your skin that have a chance of damaging attackers while increasing the damage of your unarmed attacks.  However, you cannot wear rigid armor over your thorns.
data.activation_msg: Stiff wooden thorns push out from your skin.

data.description: You are exuding thorns through your skin that have a chance of damaging attackers while increasing the damage of your unarmed attacks.  However, you cannot wear rigid armor over your thorns.

The flowers in your hair produce an intoxicating smell.  You no longer smell anything like a human and other beings will react to you appropriately.  You can enhance this scent to an overpowering level, beguiling humans and making them more suggestible at the cost of greatly increasing the range at which others can smell you.
data.activation_msg: A sweet scent fills the air.

description.str: The active version of Enchanting Aroma.  Should not be player visible.

data.description: When in wild areas, you can draw on the revitalizing power of the land to heal yourself.  When in natural areas, your limbs will heal much faster.

You may transform into a tree, extending roots and spreading leaves out to the sun.  You will heal faster, gain more benefit from sleep, and almost all monsters will ignore you, but you will only be dimly aware of the outside world and will be nearly unable to move.
data.activation_msg: Your legs fuse together and your arms stretch toward the sky as you put down roots and transform into a towering tree.

data.description: You are a tree.  You will heal much more quickly and resting is more beneficial.  You are unable to see, hear, or move, but have a dim awareness of nearby movement.

data.name: One of Us
data.description: Insinuate yourself into a feral human's mind, tricking them into thinking you are an ally.

data.name: Calling the Lost and the Damned
data.description: Feral humans come to your aid.

data.name: Everything Will Be Fine
data.description: Sometimes, it is best to focus on the positive.  This spell increases the Homullus's mood when cast.

data.name: A Face in the Crowd
data.description: Though the teeming masses of humanity are gone, the Homullus can evoke their anonymizing essence with magick, rendering them invisible to any humans affected by the spell.

data.name: Sense the Night Hunters
data.description: Weaving this glamour will allow you to sense the presence of nearby vampires.
data.message: You mutter a charm under your breath and feel for those who subsist on stolen blood.

name.str: A Face in the Crowd Self

description.str: Puts an effect on you so anyone affected by A Face in the Crowd knows to ignore you.  It's a bug if you have this directly.

data.name: The Average Joe
data.description: Weave a cloak of glamour around a target, making it more difficult for enemies to spot them.  This is not invisibility, and getting to close to a hostile target will allow them to see through the magick.

data.name: Dynamo
data.description: Fueled by the power charging your leylines, touch a target to restore some of the power in a vehicle or power grid.

data.name: The Scholar's Regard
data.description: Unlike plants or animals, humans study subjects unrelated to survival.  This spell focuses the Homullus's mind, allowing easier learning.

data.name: Discover Goblin Fruit
data.description: With the aid of a bit of fae magick, you may find a goblin fruit abandoned among the ruins.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast in the remnants of civilization.

data.name: All Roads Lead to Rome
data.description: Humanity crisscrossed the Earth with roads, first small tracks, then earthen projects, and finally mighty asphalt webs upon which billions of people traveled every day.  The Homullus can stand on the remnants of that web and return to any remaining locus of civilization that they have attuned to.

data.name: All Roads Lead to Rome Attunement
data.description: Attune to a location for later traveling.  You must attune at one of the remaining bastions of civilization or concentrations of humanity.

name.str: All Roads Lead to Rome Attunement Real

description.str: The actual All Roads Lead to Rome attunement spell.  It's a bug if you have it.

data.description: Your skin has turned pearlescent white, similar to antique dolls.  This has no gameplay effects.
Your skin has smoothed and all your prior blemishes have faded away.  This somewhat reduces wet effects and leads to a more durable yet harder to heal body.
Your skin has become latex like.  While it provides additional protection and attractiveness it also heals at a much slower rate.
Upon gaining this ability the Homullus's eyes begin change to look like doll's eyes, always staring at the world.  Glare no longer impacts them.
'Men were deceivers ever,' as the quotation runs.  To be human is to be a liar.  You are much more successful at lying to people now.
From the dreams of mortals, you can spin remnants of fantasy into material substance.  When you sleep near mortals, you have a chance to awaken with some dreamdross nearby.
data.//: Ideally this would detect even non-allied NPCs nearby instead of just a location where NPCs are likely to be

data.description: With this ability, the Homullus can reach out to a feral's fractured mind and twist it, convincing them to function as an ally.
The Dollkin has resistance to attacks on its ability to act on it's choices.
Your powers enhance your mundane senses and allow you to detect human beings.
This and other abilities native to Dollkin suggest that if vampires did create cities to concentrate their prey, something evolved afterwards to complicate the hunting grounds.
The world crawls with the hungry dead and those who may as well be dead while they still live.  This allows the Homullus to call one of the latter to their side.
A habit of lying is hard to break, even when, or especially when, talking to oneself.  This trait grants the Homullus a spell that allows them to smooth out any negative moods they experience.

You don't currently produce scent.

data.name: Cybernetic Integration
data.description: Your flesh and bones can instinctively shift to allow manually installing cybernetics.  You no longer need external aid to install CBMs.

data.name: Cybernetic Adaptation
data.description: Your leylines have begun adapting to electronic interference.  Halves the mana penalty caused by stored bionic power.

data.name: Complete Cybernetic Adaptation
data.description: Your leylines have fully adapted to electronic interference.  You no longer suffer any mana penalty for stored bionic power.

data.name: Internalized Charge
data.description: You are capable of storing power directly in your flesh.  You gain 50 kJ of bionic power storage per Homullus trait you have.

data.name: Reinforced Armor
data.description: Humans are flimsy creatures compared to even natural animals, yet by crafting armor they obtain durability that unthinking creatures will never reach.  You draw on this legacy, increasing the strength of armor you wear by 20%

data.name: Fortified Armor
data.description: You embody the tales of ancient knights, increasing the strength of armor you wear by 40%.

data.name: Equipment Hardening
data.description: You conceptually harden your tools and armor, reducing the chance that they are damaged.

data.name: Extreme Equipment Hardening
data.description: You conceptually harden your tools and armor, immensely reducing the chance that they are damaged.

data.name: Echoes of the Streets
data.description: Though much of humanity has died, their echoes remain in the places they once called home.  The Homullus can draw on those echoes to restore their bionic power.

data.name: The Pulse of the Invisible
data.description: Though much of humanity has died, their echoes remain in the places they once called home.  The Homullus can draw on those echoes to restore their bionic power and mana.
You are at home in the artificial environments constructed by humanity.  You move slightly faster within.
Early humans chased prey for miles before it dropped dead from exhaustion, and the Homullus is heir to that legacy.  You have 33% more stamina.

By standing together, humanity was able to overcome all threats, and it was only when they turned on each other that the Cataclysm grew out of control.  The Homullus regains Stamina 5% faster per ally within 30 meters (10% faster per ally if they have the Homullus trait).

name.str: The Top of the Food Chain

data.description: Humanity are omnivores in the most literal sense.  You can eat anything not human without any moral qualms.  However, the food that pre-Cataclysm humanity would slowly poison themselves with is anathema to you, and you will eat only good-tasting food unless you are starving.

Before the Cataclysm there were cities all across the world.  From above the Arctic Circle to directly on the equator, humanity built their dwellings.  You are more comfortable with temperature extremes.
Though they had no claws or fangs or armored skin, humanity mastered the world through their tools.  When near civilization, your crafting speed is increased.
Though they had no claws or fangs or armored skin, humanity mastered the world through their tools.  When near civilization, your crafting speed and ability are increased.
Though they had no claws or fangs or armored skin, humanity mastered the world through their tools.  When near civilization, your crafting speed and ability are greatly increased.
data.//: This should also reduce Construction times once there's some way to do so.

data.description: With their tools, humanity built weapons, grew food, made homes, and tamed the wilderness.  The Homullus has internalized that essence into themselves, allowing them to use their bare hands to accomplish many tasks that would otherwise require tools.
While some other animals use simple tools, complex machinery is humanity's legacy alone.  The Homullus can log into a computer or hack electronics with but a touch.

data.name: Mimicry of Biology
data.description: As a spirit of humanity, you lack the natural biology required for mutagens to function.  However, your powers have grown far enough to allow you to use even the most abstract of human tools, allowing you to consume mutagens to change your body.  Unlike humans, however, there are thresholds you will never be able to reach, and should you choose this route, further development of your native spirit powers will be closed off to you.

data.name: Homullus Biology

data.description: You have chosen the path of human mutation and further Homullus mutation is closed off to you.  You should not see this in-game.
Early humans chased prey for miles before it dropped dead from exhaustion, and the Homullus is heir to that legacy.  You have 33% more stamina and you can run for much longer before tiring.

One person may die, but their compatriots will carry their torch.  You too will have your legacy maintained if you die, but in a way far less metaphorical.  When you die, you will reincarnate within any nearby human, immediately shifting their form to match your own.  You will not be able to do this more than once per month.
data.//: An ability that allows the Homullus to be reborn instantly upon death in a nearby feral monster or npc.  If one is not nearby the power will fail.

data.description: You may transform yourself into a doll in truth, ignoring the needs of the flesh and making most monsters less likely to attack you.  However, your stiff limbs will inhibit your movement.

You are a doll in truth.  You do not need to eat or drink, and monsters will mostly ignore you, but you do not heal at all and crafting, as well as movement over any ground not almost-perfectly flat, is very difficult due to your stiff limbs.
Anger relations are here in a separate mutation so that they're removed on attacking a target or moving too quickly.

data.description: You may spin a bit of fae magic into the earth, bringing forth a goblin fruit.  Goblin fruit have a variety of effects, never predictable but always at least somewhat beneficial.  This spell may only be cast on earth or stone.
Your skin has turned the color of manganese stained soil.  Your skin is now a purplish black.  This has no gameplay effects.
Your skin has toughened and formed pebble-like growths in some places, acting as natural armor.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

Your skin has developed into strong granite-like covering that retains some flexibility and has grown to cover most of your body, acting as natural armor.  While difficult to penetrate, it also limits your flexibility.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

Upon gaining this ability the Ierde's eyes begin reflecting their mood: a pale white streaked with rose when happy; pale green or grey when calm, and pure obsidian black when angry.  Glare no longer impacts them and they are not bothered by light levels when sleeping.
The Ierde's ears are longer and pointed, like the peak of a high mountain.  They can hear slightly better and are unphased by loud sounds.
The Ierde's stony skin makes their fists hit like hammers.  Though their attacks are slower, the Ierde does more bashing damage with punches and can use their hands to replace some simple tools.

Just as their body is now one with the stone, the Ierde can infuse the strength of the earth into their equipment, rendering it more resilient.  While on natural earth or stone or underground, the Ierde's equipment is twice as difficult to damage.
Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to, while underground, rest and recover energy as though sleeping.  Activate to begin the vigil.

name.str: The Soil Knows Those Who Tread Upon It

data.description: Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to sense the movements of nearby creatures, as long as they maintains contact with natural earth or stone, or are underground.

The Ierde's ability to sense small movements is heightened to such a degree that with small movements of their fingers, they can sense the exact shape and position of objects nearby.  They can craft in darkness, as long as "The Soil Knows Those Who Tread Upon It" is active.
With a brief moment to stabilize themselves, the Ierde strikes a wall, door, or other terrain feature with the force of a falling boulder, doing many times their normal damage.
Upon gaining this ability the Ierde gains the ability to stomp on the ground and cause a minor local earthquake.

Upon gaining this ability the Ierde may reshape the earth, raising or lowering earth or stone or turning the one into the other.

data.description: Your skin has turned the rolling grey of the clouds.  Your skin is now an ever-shifting color of clouds shifting from stormy to rainy to barely there.  This has no gameplay effects.

data.name: Unknowing Changeling, Noble (Species)
data.description: You grew up thinking you were human, just another person among billions, but you were born Under the Hill and swapped for a human baby shortly after birth.  Your parents were the nobility of the Fair Folk, the great lords and ladies who traveled in spider-silk carriages on roads built of moonbeams and danced the unending nights away before leading fantastic armies in battle the next morning. data.//: Tier 1 traits begin here
data.description: Your sense of smell is heightened even in human form, allowing you to smell nearby enemies.  In war or wolf form, this range is extended.

descriptions.text: You smell the scent of a human.
You smell the dull smell of a mutated bug.

data.description: As a hunter, you know that catching a scent is the first step to getting the prey's neck between your jaws, so it's best to avoid that first step.  While active, you have no scent at all.
data.activation_msg: You suppress your scent.

data.description: Moonlight illuminates those under its light, and you can focus that light onto a single target.  The target will glow with a soft silvery light, which grows brighter when out under the moon.

A werewolf is a hunter and the natural world knows that, even in human form.  However, it is possible to cloak your predator's mien and masquerade as a simple animal, drawing less negative attention.  While active, this trait provides the effects of Animal Kinship.
data.activation_msg: You submerge your aura into the natural world.

data.description: No barrier can stop the hunter truly devoted to seeking their quarry.  You can temporarily enhance your strength for the purposes of smashing through barriers.
You can chase after your prey wherever they travel.  While in wolf form, you can scramble up one-story walls to reach the roof, and you can fall a single story without taking any damage.

data.//: Tier 2 traits begin here
data.description: The People have long fought the things from Outside and developed a keen sense when one of them is near.  When active, you can sense nearby creatures of the Nether or beings from Under the Hill.
data.activation_msg: You open your senses to the presence of your prey.

description.str: The active trait for Sense the Outsider.  This should not be player-visible.

descriptions.text: You sense a creature of Faerie.
You sense one of the blood-drinkers or their minions.

data.description: You can cause just enough change in a machine to confuse the rigid requirements of its programming, stunning it.

data.name: Go for the Throat
data.description: A successful hunter targets the vulnerable belly, or throat, or ears, they do not simply bite the first thing that comes into their reach.  When unarmed or in war or wolf form, you have a higher chance to hit your enemies' weakpoints.
You can make mighty leaps from a standing start that would normally be impossible.  While in wolf form, you can jump <color_green>even further</color>.
Blend your coat in with the surrounding environment, making it harder for enemies to spot you.  This gift is most effective in wolf form, but still has minor effects in human or war form.

data.//: Tier 3 traits begin here
data.description: Transforming fully is very useful but the real mark of mastery is changing only a part of your body.  This is most useful in human form, but can be used in other forms as well, such as transforming your hands back into human ones for easier manipulation.
While in war form, transform your claws into silver, causing them to do additional damage to creatures of the Nether.
The active trait for Argent Claws.  It should not be visible.

data.name: Thrill of the Hunt
data.description: The wolf must hunt.  When you kill an otherworldly target, such as a triffid, a Nether monster, or one of the Fair Folk, you regain some mana.

data.name: Primal Strength
data.description: A werewolf in their war form is a nightmare of claws and teeth and corded muscles, but in drawing on the might of the ancient hunters you have surpassed even that.  You gain an additional strength bonus while in war form, and may activate this trait to receive that bonus while in human or wolf form as well.
data.activation_msg: You feel a tension in your muscles.

data.name: Red-Handed Rage
data.description: You can enter a focused battle frenzy, suffering less pain and attacking faster while unarmed.  In addition, while in war form you enable two more claw techniques: a powerful knockback that downs your enemy, and a slash that hits multiple targets around you.
data.activation_msg: The edges of your vision turn red.

data.//: Tier 4 traits begin here
data.description: The moon cycles from new to full and back to new, and it always returns no matter how many cycles pass.  You can draw on that eternal renewal and enhance your natural regeneration to a truly monstrous level, healing grievous wounds in seconds and regrowing lost limbs in less than a minute.
data.activation_msg: Your natural regeneration kicks into overdrive.

data.description: You can cause just enough change in a machine to confuse the rigid requirements of its programming, stunning it.

data.name: Lucent Armor
data.description: Regeneration and battle rage are potent weapons but sometimes the People need more protection.  You can summon up tangible moonlight that will protect you from the fists, claws, and fangs of your enemies.
data.activation_msg: A soft silvery glow springs forth around you.

data.//: Tier 5 traits begin here
data.description: While in wolf form, you can call on the spirit of the primal wolves of the mythic past and transform into an atavistic creature of nightmare, two meters high at the shoulder, with fur as thick as armor and teeth that can rend steel.  This form also regenerates the same as the war form does.

description.str: You are a gigantic atavistic wolf.  This provides the actual effects of primal form.  Should not be player-visible.

data.description: The world is falling apart but that is no reason to cease the hunt.  You can close a tear in reality, if you can get close enough to it.
While in war form, transform your claws into silver, causing them to do additional damage to creatures of the Nether.
data.activation_msg: You concentrate for a moment and sublimate your body into spirit.

data.description: Even death cannot always stop the Hunt.  You may summon the spirits of werewolves long dead back to join you in the Hunt.

data.//: Lilin powers should deal with darkness, disease, night, the moon, and owls.  They specifically should not have powers that make them physically tougher, such as armor- or hp-increasing powers, or powers that do large amounts of direct damage.
data.//2: The push and pull of Lilin powers is that they have active powers that require them to spend ruach, and passive powers that scale based on how much ruach they have (some active powers also do this)
data.description: You have ascended in power and can rival the mighty night-creatures of old.  The night is your home, now, out of the light of the sun.
data.//3: An umbrella cannot protect you because this is a mystical weakness.

data.//: Lilin are spiritual vampires--rather than feed on blood, they feed on the essence of their targets.  This allows them to gain some similar powers to vampires, but often in a more subtle fashion
data.description:
You are one of the lilin, a hunter in the night, driven to feed on the spiritual essence (some might say the soul) of your prey.  Probably you were born that way, but maybe it happened to due to a malediction, or some artifact you found in a place best forgotten.  Regardless, it is your gift and your curse now, and you must use your powers to survive.

You may activate this trait to spend some ruach toward increasing your power.  You must be outside under the moonlight to have a chance of gaining new lilin powers.
data.activation_msg: You dedicate some ruach to increasing your power.

data.description: With but a touch, you can drain the vitality and spiritual essence from your targets.
You no longer need to touch your targets to drain their ruach; you can do it at a short distance through their breath.

name.//~: Ruach is the Hebrew word for 'breath,' but it can also mean 'spirit'

data.description: You no longer need to touch your targets to drain their ruach; you can do it at a great distance through their breath.

data.description: Call up thick clouds of fog, allowing you to hide from your enemies.  This power <color_green>lasts longer</color> when closer to the new moon.
With a baleful gaze and a heart full of malice, curse a single target with misfortune.
Let out a piercing cry, disorienting both enemies and allies nearby.
You can transform yourself into an owl and take wing on the night air.  You won't be able to drain ruach while you are in this form.

name.//~: This is a reference to Samuel 2:9

data.description: When shrouded in shadows, you make as little noise as one.  Your movement is fully silent at night unless you're out of ruach.

name.//~: This is a reference to Genesis 1:5

data.description: You were born to walk the night, and have a much easier time sleeping during the day.

name.//~: This is a reference to Psalms 121:4

data.description: While sleep is restful, the ruach you gain fills you with more energy than even a good night's rest.  You may spend ruach to alleviate your sleepiness.

name.//~: This is a reference to Proverbs 5:3

data.description: Your presence is intoxicating, and humans have a hard time resisting your charms.  You gain a bonus to your persuasion chance as long as you aren't empty of ruach.

name.//~: This is a reference to Exodus 20:16

data.description: You have a much easier time spinning lies and making people believe them.  You gain a bonus to your lying chance as long as you aren't empty of ruach.

name.//~: This is a reference to Jeremiah 10:14

data.description: You can temporarily beguile a single human, fey, or avian target, causing them to stand senseless or wander in a daze.  Any damage will bring the target out of their trance.

data.//: For now life extenders such as this one grant MEND_ALL.  When the new wound system will be implemented, their function will be to always allow you to fully heal from your wounds (no scars, etc).

name.//~: This is a reference to Romans 6:23

data.description: Your body has now stopped aging, massively extending your longevity.  You can still be killed but as long as your body can heal, all your wounds will eventually fully heal no matter how severe they are.

name.//~: This is a reference to Psalms 72:5

data.description: With eternal youth comes the strength to endure past anything one could face.  Your speed won't be lower than its default as long as you have some ruach in you.
You may unleash a foul miasma on your enemies, sickening them.
You may greatly enhance the power of the miasma from Unleash the Night-Wind, doing serious damage and crippling your target.
You may cut a single target off from light, completely blinding them.  You may only do this at night, and only indoors or out in the wilderness.

You can use your powers to spin a web of illusion around yourself, increasing your attractiveness to a supernatural degree.  While the harsh light of the sun destroys the illusion, you need merely to move back into the shadows to restore it.

You can use your powers to spin a web of illusion around yourself, increasing your attractiveness to a supernatural degree.  While the harsh light of the sun destroys the illusion, you need merely to move back into the shadows to restore it.  You have grown so powerful that this illusion requires almost no effort and can be <color_green>maintained for weeks</color> at a time.
Like the monstrous children of angels and humans, your prowess surpasses mortal limits.  Activate this trait to empower yourself.

description.str: Adds a Strength Bonus to Might of the Nephilim.  Should not be player-visible.

name.//~: This is a reference to Proverbs 30:15

data.description: You can drain essence from your targets with your unarmed attacks.  Not well enough to absorb their ruach, should they have any, but enough to cause additional damage at night.  This damage is strongest during the half to full moon and weakest during the new moon.  It functions only slightly during the day.
data.//: Use a more appropriate damage type once enchantments support custom damage types. Also, a light level check wound be better than is_day/is_outside

description.str: Adds a Dexterity/Dodge Bonus to Might of the Nephilim.  Should not be player-visible.

data.description: With an expenditure of ruach you can drastically enhance your speed for a short period of time.
You can leap away from attacks like shadows dancing in candlelight.  You gain Uncanny Dodge while under the effects of Reaping the Whirlwind.

name.str: And All the People Saw the Sounds

description.str: Adds a Perception Bonus to Might of the Nephilim.  Should not be player-visible.

data.description: Your eyes have adapted to the darkness of the night, allowing you to see further through the shadows.  This is most effective out under the moon but still has an effect indoors.
The owl is a symbol of wisdom in culture after culture, and you are the heir to that wisdom.  You find it easier to learn things, and even easier the more ruach you're holding on to.
Attuned to darkness and disease, you can easily spot the cracks in your enemies' defenses.  You have an easier chance to hit enemy weakpoints, increasing as your ruach rises.

name.//~: This is a reference to Psalms 91:6
name.str: The Pestilence that Stalks in Darkness

data.description: You are at home in the darkness and it clings to you to cover your movements.  In a half- or smaller moon, and when out of the daylight, it is harder for your enemies to spots you.
data.//: A light level check would be better than is_day/is_outside

name.//~: This is a reference to Psalm 147:17

data.description: As a hunter in the night, you are well-conditioned to the cold after the sun goes down.  You are resistant to chill temperatures, and more so the more ruach you have.

name.//~: This is a reference to Proverbs 25:16

data.description: When filled with ruach, no other food or drink compares.  The more ruach you have, the less mundane hunger or thirst troubles you.
Your stolen ruach speeds your healing in proportion to how much of it you have.
Sometimes, you cannot passively wait for your ruach to heal your wounds, you need it to happen immediately.  You may activate this trait to greatly speed your healing at a continual cost of ruach.
Your powers have expanded and you are now capable of holding more ruach.
Your powers have expanded and you are now capable of holding even more ruach.
Your powers have expanded and you are now capable of holding an enormous amount of ruach.

name.//~: This is a reference to Proverbs 23:5

data.description: You've learned how to more efficiently use your ruach, greedily keeping some behind for yourself when you activate your powers.  Powers that cost ruach have their initial and periodic costs reduced by 15%.  This does not reduce the continual ruach cost of staying alive.

name.//~: This is a reference to Jeremiah 5:27
name.str: Like a Cage Full of Birds

data.description: You jealously parcel out your ruach, only spending exactly as much as you need and no more.  Powers that cost ruach have their initial and periodic costs reduced by 15%, with an additional reduction that grows based on your total amount of ruach, to a maximum reduction of 33%.  This does not reduce the continual ruach cost of staying alive.

name.//~: This is a reference to Psalms 139:12
name.str: The Night Shines Like the Day

data.description: You have adapted so well to the night that it doesn't hinder your actions at all.  You can read and craft in any light levels.

name.//~: This is a reference to Psalms 139:12
name.str: The Darkness is not Dark to You

data.description: Your eyes have fully adapted to the darkness, allowing you to see as well in the dark as humans see in the light.

name.//~: This is a reference to Jeremiah 31:35
name.str: The Moon Shall Shine at Night

data.description: You are closely attuned to the moon, and some of your powers grow stronger with it.  Any ability you have that is amplified the fuller the moon is will not be weakened as much by an incomplete but non-new moon.
data.//: prerequisites are having at least one power amplified by the moon.  As this is written, only one such power exists.

data.description: Your owl form is half spirit and half flesh.  You have a high chance to dodge any attacks against you, and may pass straight through walls as long as it is night.
You are at home in the night, and your prowess is heightened while the moon is up as long as you have any ruach within you.
You can combine your forms, transforming into a large owl-human hybrid with wings, rending talons, and a deadly beak.  You won't be able to drain ruach while you are in this form.

data.name: XE843 'Gracken' (Species)
data.description: Species XE843 is how the Xedra scientists identified your people before they learned your people could speak to them after enough time around them to develop a way to communicate.  They had little idea that communication is your people's survival trait, coming from a much harsher environment than the humans are…were blessed with, you can make allies with almost any thinking being.  You informed the Xedra people of your race's name 'Gracken' but you didn't tell them that most of your people they found were larval forms and lacking access to the shadow materials needed would never grow up into an adult form.  Now the humans' world is as deadly or moreso than your home and the way back is mostly closed.  Time to try and find a route home that wouldn't be a death sentence, or see what this world has to offer.

data.//: Gracken are creatures from the shadow dimension.  They create their own cbm like enhancements that each take up specific trait slots so each build can be unique.
data.description: A traveler from another dimension.  A dimension of shadows with few bright lights.  Once your species matures, they gain the ability to create new alterations to their body from ingredients harvested from their kills, shadowstuff and magickal essence.
You have become a fully mature Gracken and have gained the ability to reform your body in ways previously blocked to you in your immature state.
Bright yellow eyes shine out from the shadowy crevices of your face.
data.//: This is the baseline Gracken eyes mutation. TODO: Jsonify nightvision so you can ditch the NIGHTVISION trait.

data.description: Gracken are about the same size as humans, though they look like shadow demons.
data.//: This is the baseline Gracken size mutation.

data.description: Your legs are human sized but appear to be made of swirling shadows.
data.//: This is the baseline Gracken leg mutation.

data.description: Your legs have decreased in length providing you with a lower center of gravity and a slight improvement to agility.
data.//: This is the first stage short legs mutation.

data.description: Your legs have lengthened.  You can cross flat terrain more easily.
data.//: This is the first stage long legs mutation.

data.description: Your feet are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.
data.//: This is the baseline Gracken leg mutation.

data.description: Your arms are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.
data.//: This is the baseline Gracken arms mutation.

data.description: Your arms have begun bulking up and become stronger.  +1 Strength
data.//: This is the first stage strong arms mutation.

data.description: Your arms have lengthened.  You can push a target away from you.
data.//: This is the first stage long arms mutation.

data.description: Your hands are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.
data.//: This is the baseline Gracken hands mutation.

data.description: Your hands are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.  At the end of each finger you sport a razor sharp nail.  It increases your damage when unarmed.
data.//: This is the first stage unarmed melee hands mutation.

data.description: Your hands are humanoid but appear to be made of swirling shadows.  You sport an extra digit on every finger that improves your ability to get into tight situations.
data.//: This is the first stage crafting hands mutation.

data.description: Your skin is the color of shadows moving in the twilight.
data.//: This is the baseline Gracken skin mutation.

data.description: Your dietary needs are so minimized that you could travel months or years without eating.  There are consequences to this.  One is an inability to process normal food.  Another is a pretty constant state of weariness, but this is the best way to handle interdimensional travel until you are able to develop an organ to consume local foods.  The ambient energies here are much weaker than what you normally encounter out in the Nether between universes, you need exposure to nuclear radiation to gain calories on this planet, for now.
data.//: This is the baseline Gracken stomach mutation.

data.description: You eat a wide variety of foods native to this world that would be appropriate for the dominant species.
data.//: This is one path of Gracken stomach mutations.

data.description: You eat an exclusively meat-based diet as befits an apex predator of this planet.
data.//: This is one path of Gracken stomach mutations.

data.description: You eat a herbivorous diet.  The benefit of this is you never have to kill for your food.  Unless the plants were trying to kill you first.
data.//: This is one path of Gracken stomach mutations.

data.description: You have a gland that grows a small amount of the material needed to make biological improvements to yourself.  You must gather dreamdross and components from monsters you wish to gain the abilities of and combine them with this shadowstuff into new organs and abilities.
Your system has adapted to radiation.  While irradiated, you will convert the radiation into calories.

data.dynamic_line: The last fifteen years or so before the Cataclysm were weirder than the years before that don't you remember?  Well anyway before the end of things, I used to travel across New England as a wandering musician earning my keep as I could.  There were good times and there were hard times; and once when things were at their hardest I was starving and cold and playing my guitar on the shore of the lake.  A swan boat glides up to the shore quiet as a mouse, a tall elegantly dressed man stepped out of the boat and asked me to come play for them at the 'bonum collis'.  Being more hungry than I was scared, I went with him.

So I get the boat and it moves smooth as silk across the lake, no sound or vibration but the waves against the hull.  I never see anyone or anything guiding the boat or making it move.  Anyway we arrived at an island in the lake and as we approached I can hear laughter and music.  Once we landed, they had me sign a contract which I'd figured would just be an NDA not to talk about the rich peoples party island.  Turns out I signed a contract to play music every night for three months for the price of room and board.

responses.text: I can't believe this story.  Goodbye.

data.dynamic_line: Long story short, I played for them every night like the contract said, it was a good bit better than starving to death.  I saw and heard some of the craziest things while I was there and other humans came and made deals and went.  They told me that this particular 'sith' had strict rules about how to treat people and that I was quite lucky to be here.  It didn't feel like they considered themselves 'people'.  Anyway when my contract was up they said they'd quite enjoyed my time with them and gave me some gifts to help me get along once I'd left their island.  When society broke down I thought about heading there to see if they were still there.  I chickened out when I realized how far it was compared to my evacuation point.  Course, here I am among the unwanted masses, maybe you'll find them there if you decide to go look.

data.description: This is where the island I agreed to a strange deal is.  I wonder if they're still there.

[You skim through the book, searching for useful information.  Most pages are filled with trivial notes and long rants, but there's a few that attract your attention.]

I've been a vampire hunter since as far as I can remember.  I spent my entire life killing all the vampires I could find but I recently realized that doing so was futile with my current power.  I need more power.  No matter how many vampires I kill, there's always more.
I became a vampire so I could kill them all, but even that wasn't enough.  I've followed the mentor's instructions until they had nothing more to tell me but that wasn't enough.
I need to find a way to reach power undreamt of.  To protect everyone from the vampire threat, I must become the strongest vampire ever seen.

After so long spent experimenting on vampire blood, I found a way to push vampirism beyond its absolute limits.
By taking vampire blood, a drop of my own blood, some blood no human nor vampire could ever want to drink and an assortment of poisons and toxins, it is possible to apply the process of an ancient poison-making method to vampire blood, forcing it to devour itself to become stronger.
When the process was over and I drank the remaining blood, I could now drink vampire blood to become more of a vampire than they are, with all the power this brings.

After drinking enough vampire blood, I gained new abilities.  I could store more blood inside me, my vampiric abilities all became stronger, I could feed from vampire blood, my wounds closed at incredible speeds in the dark and more.  At the point I now am, every time I drink vampire blood my vampiric abilities grow stronger.

In addition to manifesting more of the vampires' classical weaknesses, some time after beginning to consume vampires for power I started to burn away under the sun even while fully covered.
Only being indoors or underground protected me if I didn't block the sun with shadows.
I did felt a passing impulse to drink more vampire blood and the first few doses made me think my mind would unravel, but that passed.  It might be that this path gives a single weakness not seen in other vampires to those far enough on it, but testing this would require creating vampires and I won't ever tolerate this.

There are other hunters, but they are traitors to the cause.  All of them.
How can they attack me?  How can some of them team up with vampires to attack me?
It is worse than I thought.  I am the last true hunter.  The duty of purging the world of vampires is mine and mine alone now.  I still let my past allies decide between running away or dying, but so many refuse to flee.
They force my hand over and over, I hope they will remember that.
[You skim through the book, searching for the components your mentor told you about, until you find the section with the components and their rituals]

To produce one unit of stormwrought blood, you need twenty-five liters of blood.  Any blood a vampire can feed from will do, but you must not mix different blood types or else the ritual will fail.

This ritual needs to be done within five meters of a tear in reality, or the blood will fail to attune to its energies.

When the ritual will be completed, a storm charged with the same energies will begin.  Stay in it until the blood is simmering and it'll be ready to be used.  Do not worry if it doesn't fully charge the first time for these storms are frequently seen these days.

To extract the two liters of Fae essence the ritual requires, you will need to have one lump of steel and one lump of cast iron on your person or nearby enough to be included in the ritual, Fae parts and a container for the liquid essence.

Iron, and to a lesser extend steel, are anathema to the Fae, a fact that the following ritual takes advantage of to separate the essence from the butchered corpse by temporarily amplifying their Fae-bane properties, pushing the essence out of the remains.

Any Fae part will do, as long as their level of relative physics is higher than nothing.

To create a dream-drainer mosquito's heart, you'll need to gather some doses of lotus blossom, a handful of wyld candies, a small pile of dreamdross and a liter of Fae blood to create the dream-draining catalyst.

Once it is completed, find a mosquito and activate the catalyst while no farther than five meters away from it.  It must be a mosquito, anything else won't work.  The mosquito will then gorge itself on the catalyst and will suddenly transform into a dream-eating nightmare.

Once the dream-drainer mosquito appears, kill it and the heart will be yours.

Be careful, as this mosquito wields powers akin to those of the Eaters of Dreams such as the ability to heal its wounds and throw piercing projectiles at you.

To obtain a moonstruck pearl, you will need the skull of a March Lord, a bunch of glass shards, a handful of faewild dust, ten kilograms of Fae meat, enough bones to make a makeshift skeleton for that meat, some silver and the heart of a mythic monster.  The skull must be one of a March lord, for only they are resilient enough to contain the tremendous energies you will soon harness.

Once the revenant's effigy is completed, place it outdoors and wait until the full moon shines brightly in the sky.  Only then will you take it in your arms and utter the last few words of the ritual before the Luna-Attuned Revenant rises and reappears near you.

This revenant is a powerful foe, directly fueled by the moon itself and blessed with the ability to always see its foes.  Its attacks are very destructive and hard to dodge but you can severely weaken it by luring it anywhere the moon cannot reach it.  If you do this be warned that it will violently lash out at anything standing between itself and the moon.

Fortunately, the revenant cannot regenerate and its flesh lacks any kind of protection other than needing to be extremely heavily damaged to cause it to decohere and die, granting you the moonstruck pearl.

Remember to quickly kill it, for the sun's rays will instantly slay the revenant, preventing you from obtaining the pearl.  Also keep in mind that the revenant will attempt to take revenge on you for its current state and is likely to priorize attacking you over its own wellbeing.

To reach the space where the aforementioned shard can be found, you will need a few chunks of sulfur, a bottle of strong alcohol, red meat from an animal, meat from a mutant, meat from a human and meat from a Fae.  With all these components, the ritual will be possible to accomplish.

However, do not initiate the ritual if you aren't in the condition to fight through hordes of foes, as it is what awaits you once you have completed the ritual.  You will be swallowed instantly by a nightmarish being known as the Abyssal Hunger and end up somewhere within it, where things akin to the cells of a body will attack you.

As you progress through the layers of its body, resistance will increase as you get closer to what constitutes its brain.  Within it, shards can be found.  Extract one, and you will return in our world at the exact place where you left it.

Try to stay away from the red globules, they're incredibly powerful but almost fully blind.  The green globules will try to drag you closer to the red ones so be ready to kill all of them as quickly as you can.  Preparing ways to do so is a good idea, and so is bringing a source of light and preparing for a half-hour where the only thing you will do is fighting for your life.

dynamic_line: Before things ended did you see any of the interviews with some of the remaining Wampanoag?  They kept saying things about other races coming back to this planet.  That's crazy, right?
A few nights after I got here, I saw lights in the woods off in the distance.  I don't know why, but I ran back into the house turned off all the lights and closed the blinds.  It was just so eerie!

responses.text: We're always gonna be friends, right?  Even with the apocalypse… changing us?
What do you miss most about the internet?
Now that we've got no responsibilities, is there anything you'd like to see or do?
What do you think the rest of the world is like these days?
Do you miss any food from the old days?

dynamic_line: There could be anything out there.  Remember towards the end before the apocalypse?  I remember tons of weird stuff I heard on the radio.  Like, I heard out past Bunyan there were strange trees and species showing up in the deep woods, stuff no one had ever seen before.  The Border Patrol was going in about 'species previously thought extinct' or something like that.  Didn't make sense to me.  Why the heck was the *Border Patrol* talking about *closing off forests*?  Weird stuff.  I guess that means I don't have a clue what's out there now.
I still can't decide if our leaders thought Canada was a threat or what?  Why else did they militarize the border patrol up here just as bad it had been on the southern border for decades?

I remember talking to a friend coming back from Vegas a few years back and he mentioned Border Patrol had those big armored Bear Cub vehicles with a roadblock going into one of the canyons outside of Vegas.  Hundreds of miles from any border.  Weird stuff man, I wonder if it's all connected?

data.dynamic_line: My opinion?  Sure, my friend, hit me up, what's eating you?

responses.text: Check this out, I found an address of some kind of central refugee management facility.  Should we check it out?  Maybe they'll have answers?
You thinking what I'm thinking about this mystery dropoff for Smokes?

data.dynamic_line: What does this story remind me of?  Is it, Rip van Winkle?  Didn't he join some party and come home a dozen years later?

responses.text: Maybe we should avoid drinking anything there?

data.dynamic_line: Is Lewis Carrol hiding behind a bush over there?  Because if not, this sounds insane and insanely dangerous.  But no one else has even given us a hint about a way off this world of the dead.  Can we really pass this by?

responses.text: It's you and me buddy, to infinity and beyond!
