name.str: Cyrus Whateley's Notes on Repurposing mi-go victims

data.description: A folio of notes written by a madman.  They seem to suggest ways to re-animate the dead and create various affronts to the natural order.

name.str_pl: copies of Dr. Moreau and You

data.description: In what many considered a stunning example of poor taste and others considered overt speciesism this text on the creation of Uplifted Animals references a story about sapient animals killing their creator.  Otherwise a dry text about genetic modification.

A pocket-sized book filled to the margins with cramped handwriting and notes on the biology of Mi-Go and other musings.  It's hard to understand and quite gruesome in some places and written in a shorthand or cipher in others.

name.str_pl: copies of useful recipes for resistance

data.description: Recipes for Resistance is a collection of tales, strategies and recipes for working against corporate rule.  Very simple language is used in the recipes but it drags out the explanations.

name.str: Working in Boreal Conditions and Beyond
name.str_pl: copies of Working in Boreal Conditions and Beyond

data.description: A corporate manual for conditions of inhospitable cold.  It includes instructions for building devices and substances that will aid in survival in extreme weather or even the lack thereof.

name.str_pl: copies of Unusual Ammunitions of the Corporations

data.description: A lab book dedicated to reverse engineering various ammunitions found throughout the solar system.  Written in a format to allow barely trained technicians to *safely* replicate these rounds.

name.str_pl: copies of Applications of Salus IV Lichen

data.description: A sheaf of notes detailing some species of lichen.  Most of the information is useless to you except for the fact that the majority of Salus IV lifeform's metabolism rely on a macronutrient that acts like a neurotoxin for humans.  One useful note is a detailed procedure to neutralize said neurotoxin.

name.str_pl: copies of TsKBEM Exoskeleton user manuals

data.description:
A somewhat hefty manual in Russian with accompanying English text which goes in-depth into the proper usage and maintenance of TsKBEM brand Exoskeletons.

While it mainly pertains to the old TsKBEM exoskeletons, the knowledge within could still help out with modular exoskeletons in general.

This annual publication covers the various ways in which people use technology to improve their bodies.  There are a few in-depth and thoroughly illustrated articles on prosthetics, though they tend to use too much jargon.
A large casing from a spent 25mm cartridge.
An empty plastic hull from a 5x50mm flechette round.

description.str: A generic techno doodad used to cast spells.

data.description: A small metallic sphere with a recessed bottom up top.  When activated it will allow you to swap positions with an existing hologram.
A small metallic sphere with a recessed bottom up top.  When activated it will allow you to select a hologram, which will explode in a blinding flash, stunning anything nearby.
A small metallic sphere with a recessed bottom up top.  When activated it will a holographic decoy in a location of your choosing.
A small metallic sphere with a recessed bottom up top.  When activated it will create several holographic decoys around you.

A complex antennae assembly worn around the upper torso that allows its user to home and teleport towards previously configured teleport pads.  Although relatively functional, it's much inferior to the translocation systems of old, and a successful teleport requires standing perfectly still for several minutes.

An arcane device from the late Hyperspace Era, vaguely resembling a wrist computer made from malleable glass.  It can be activated to quickly deploy a translocator buoy or to teleport to previously activated buoys.
Installed on your back is a set of retractable solar panels.  When in direct sunlight, they will automatically deploy and slowly recharge your power level.
A miniaturized fusion reactor.  It has modest output, but will run continuously for over two hundred years thanks to its internal nuclear fuel reservoir.
A small, folding tube that attaches to your right arm.  Once implanted, it can serve as a portable, integrated tool for firing 40mm grenades and canisters.
A carbon nanotube wire covertly installed in your right arm.  When activated, it extends to its full length and can be used to strike enemies both at close and long range.

A Mercurial Genomics brand biofactory that replaces the user's blood with a synthetic substitute.  Primarily designed to boost combat performance, its common among the corporation's own security forces.  The biofactory can't be removed once integrated with a host.

An implanted miniaturized computer isolated from the rest of your systems by military-grade firewalls.  An accompanying jack allows you to interface with external computer systems with minimal risk.  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.
A high voltage battery port compatible with the power cartridges normally used in military weaponry.  Intended to supplement internally installed power generation and storage.

A radical nanite treatment that allows its host's circulatory system to function as a secondary nervous system, greatly increasing their mental acuity and allowing them to survive trauma that would otherwise be fatal.  A cybernetic enhancement of this category is a rare find and could be easily traded for significant favors and resources.
A microcomputer installed into the left hemisphere of your brain to increase the speed that it processes language.  When installed, it provides a passive boost to reading speed.

Pre-Discontinuity bionic module that was implanted into elite drop troops who could jump from their insertion vehicle during the radar disruption of reentry.  While active, the field will prevent damage to your body from severe impacts, at the cost of impaired movement.

A battered and used Compact Bionics Module that upgrades the user's power capacity by 50 units.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  The user will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.

A set of tiny bionic nerve stimulators that install into the reward center of your brain.  When run with bionic power, it periodically releases a hit of dopamine and other reward chemicals, inducing a state of euphoria and suppressing fear.
Cybernetic stimulators installed across your nervous system boost your reflexes whenever you are hit in melee, granting you an extra action.  This bionic must be active to function.

An improved ulnar sheath equipped with thermal inductors allows for the super heating of all types of implanted bladed weaponry.  While this bionic is active, any deployed bionic blades will deal additional fire damage to targets.

Paired capacitor banks maintain implanted bladed weaponry under constant electrical charge.  While this bionic is active, any deployed bionic blades will deal additional electric damage with a chance of the damage arcing to other nearby targets.
An implanted AI executes the optimal followup for each of your melee strikes, allowing you to chain them with unnatural speed and grace.  This bionic must be active to function.
A brain implant that grants instinctual knowledge about the operation of flying machines.
A bomb installed where your spine meets your brain stem.  It's on a timer from installation and you don't have the codes to reset the timer.

name.str: Chemical Enhancement Rig and computer CBM

data.description: An implanted AI module and medication dispenser calculates the optimal chemical mix to keep you on your toes and ready for combat.  This bionic must be active to function and while it functions your body is at a heightened performance but if it turns off it will take you several days to get back to normal.  There are a significant number of baseline bonuses granted by this setup but people around will notice your junkie behavior.  This bionic must be active to function.
Should never be found outside of the chemical enhancement rig, but probably can be uninstalled, there is no point to doing that.
Should never be found outside of the chemical enhancement rig, but probably can be uninstalled, there is no point to doing that.
Should never be found outside of the chemical enhancement rig, but probably can be uninstalled, there is no point to doing that.

A single shot 10mm gun which implants into the forehead.  It has the shortest time from thought to shot of all bionic guns which makes it popular among street punks for whom every millisecond counts, but this poorly conceived bionic removes a distressing amount of grey matter to make room for it and gives you a concussion every time you fire it.

An experimental teleportation system carefully weaved into bone marrow and coiled alongside the skeletal system.  It allows its user to safely and readily teleport towards a previously activated telepad.
A system designed to prevent instantaneous frostbite in workers exposed to things like hard vacuum and liquid nitrogen.

Imagine a computer inside your body playing pong against the universe.  The paddles are made of energy fields and how it causes this to happen are trade secrets.  -From the owners manual of HawkingCorps GravyField Mark I.  Activating the field will reduce incoming bashing and cut damage by 5 points.

Powerful and covert, the Mark V Shield is a military-grade shielding system developed for use within UICA's special service branches.  Although much more effective than anything that could be conceived with current technology, it remains a pale imitation of the Hyperspace Age systems it was reverse-engineered from.  A.

Activating the shield will create an energy barrier capable of withstanding a modest amount of melee and ranged damage.

A powerful shielding system salvaged from a pre-Discontinuity robotic warframe, crudely adapted for compatibility with biological hosts.  Powerful enough to completely stop most rifle cartridges.  Activating the field will reduce incoming ballistic and piercing damage by 40 points.
A clump of moist squishy lichen.  You get the impression that it might not be the safest thing to eat considering how it makes your hand tingle.
A clump of squishy lichen, while it isn't as wet as it used to be, your hands no longer tingle holding it.
Freshly butchered meat from a frozen human carcass, not the most appetizing.
A freshly cooked slice of human meat, it has severe frostburn.

data.name: frostbitten human stomach
data.description: A shriveled gray stomach, it hasn't seen use in a very long time.
A stretched bumpy piece of bone, unpleasant to hold.
Light green fat, smelling absolutely rancid.  You could eat it, but it wouldn't be worth it.
A smooth light green block of cleaned and rendered human fat.  While it'll remain edible for a very long time, it won't be the most appetizing.
A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a human corpse.  It is stained blue from frostbite.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.
Freshly butchered meat from an alien corpse.  You could eat it raw or cooked, but this is a completely alien biosphere.
This is a chunk of freshly cooked alien meat.  It could be either filling and nutritious, or poisonous and lethal.
This is a tiny scrap of dubiously edible alien meat.  It's not much, but it might be better than starving.

data.name: alien stomach
data.description: A balloon-like organ you can only guess is a stomach.  It is surprisingly durable.

data.name: large alien stomach
data.description: A balloon-like organ of a large alien you can only guess is a stomach.  It is surprisingly durable.
A red sponge-like organ rests in your hands.  It leaks out a strange liquid, and spoils very quickly.  You hazard a guess this is a lung.
The organ no longer leaks out a strange liquid, and has faded to a light blue color.  It looks chewy, and has an unpleasant smell.
A porous hard organ.  Hazarding a guess from all the large blood vessels going in and out, this is the liver.  It smells rancid.
After some time cooking, the pores of the organ have shrunk, and it's much, much softer - almost yogurt-like in its consistency.  It still smells awful.
A brain butchered from an alien organism.  It looks somewhat similar to its earthly analogues, barring its light-blue coloration and gland riddled frontal lobe.
Fried and scrambled, this doesn't look the most appetizing, but it's edible (you hope).
You are guessing here, but this is likely the kidney of the animal.  The ammonia smell was the biggest hint.
Thoroughly cooked and prepared, this alien organ has acquired the filthy ammonia smell of a poorly mopped spaceship deck.  Even if it were safe to eat, you are not sure you'd want to.
You got this chunk of meat from the throat of the animal; it looks different?
Well, it's definitely not muscle, you can tell now.  It oozes a purple liquid out onto your hand as you hold it.
Obviously bones.  Could be used to make some stuff, like needles.
Freshly butchered fat from an alien.  You could eat it cooked or raw, but it is more safely used for crafting non edible-products.
A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered alien animal fat.  It'll last for a very long time, but you are unsure of its edibility.  Can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
data.//: *May* have been commercially traded.

data.description: An unidentifiable pile of organs; you have no idea how you'd prepare them.
Bits of alien fat and skin that have been fried until they are crispy and delicious (at least, you hope they are).
Green scraps of rancid fat and skin, and while they have been fried to a crisp, they still don't smell any better.
A carefully folded raw skin harvested from an alien animal.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.
A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing alien animal.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

All sorts of organic substances rendered into a nutritious goop that can be used as a growth medium in grub aquaculture.  Urban myth claims that its original formula was just bottled industrial runoff.  Whatever the case, mealgrubs thrive within it.

Mealgrubs are a staple aquacultural product, treasured for their ability to process nearly any organic substance into safe for consumption animal protein.  As the result of very heavy-handed gene-modding these are proprietary organisms, and strictly speaking, it's illegal to grow them without a license.

Growth medium seeded with mealgrub eggs.  Once placed in a growing vat, they should be ready for harvesting in around 76 hours.  The immature grub's metabolism can produce toxic by-products so caution is advisable.

Thousands of mature mealworms, squirming in the viscous remains of their growth medium.  They are ready for harvest, and in fact require speedy cleaning and processing, as the harvest can quickly rot in this stage.

A handful of edible and heavily genemoded grubs, each only slightly thinner than your thumb.  Engineered in the wake of the XXII century to feed an overpopulated Earth and its fledgling colonies these are a sturdy, easily grown and scalable crop.

Removed from their growth solution they'll quickly die and desiccate, as these already have.  They could be safely eaten with no further processing, for a nutritious if somewhat striking meal.

data.name: nutriment
data.description: A crumbly white biscuit half the size of your thumb, packed with vitamins and calories.  Provides a whole meal's nutrition in portable form, but it's a little hard to keep down, thanks to the rancid taste and chalky texture.
Nutriment that has been dissolved in water to dilute its taste.  Unnervingly resembles spoiled milk.

use_action.activation_message: You take a swig, it tastes like it was distilled in a hyperspace engine.

data.description: Spite Soda, the only soda native to the Salus system.  'Stay Frosty, Drink Spite'.  Visitors to the Salus system who have drank Spite Soda have described it as the taste of transhumanist dialectical materialism.
When Thistle Industries successfully trademarked the chemical formula of water, you thought the world had gone irreparably insane, but things have only gotten worse since.
Smoothly blended edibles, neatly shaped into cubes for maximum enjoyment.
Foodplace™ easy-storage Food-to-go™ the choice Food™ for the contemporary Foodman™.
Rings of caramelized yellow colorant, tasting not exactly like apple.
Smooth crackers colored grayish-green.  Used to be perfectly edible seaweed, or so the wrapper claims.

Soy or pureed rat?  Better not to know.
(But its probably both.)
Yellow chunks float on creamy liquid, like flotsam on a filthy summer pond.  Branding implies at least 26 other flavors, but you have neither seen or heard about any of them.

Sealed emergency rations invariably found within an escape pod's inventory.  This particular pack should provide around a day's worth of nutrition.  Required by regulation but rarely ever used, the design of these "meals" prioritizes a long shelf life and a very low bulk-cost.  Which lends them their disgusting taste of greased sawdust.
A dark and soapy beverage, pre-brewed and loaded with synthetic caffeine.
Time and the elements have reverted this heavily processed meal to its original form.  Eating it isn't even worth thinking about.
Rub this on your skin when you are expecting exposure to extreme cold temperatures.  Cannot protect from instant frostbite.  Smells like the inside of a sheep.

This product was advertised before the Cataclysm for extreme cold environment protection.  You remember a demonstration involving a woman coating her hand in this and plunging it in liquid nitrogen for a second.  You're pretty sure that was staged.

A yellow stick of milkfat and milk solids, made from cow's milk and the power of the atom.  All radiation levels are confirmed to be in line with background exposure and any cancers later in life have nothing to do with this butter or any products made with this butter.  By consuming this butter you indemnify and hold harmless the Rivtech Corporation, its parent company and subsidiaries and any agents, directors or officers of the Rivtech Corporation from any losses or damages that may occur as a result of consuming this butter in any form or fashion.

variants.description: A cut of vat grown lean meat, genetically similar to beef.  Conspicuously uniform in both looks and texture.
Transparent thin hexagonal cuts of dried meat.  Conspicuously uniform in both looks and texture.
Pink flesh from a non-existent species of fish, grown in a vat.  Of particularly high quality, it makes for a decent meal even when raw.
A large white fillet of meat from the thorax of an alien insect.  It has a slightly sweet taste, and is very nutritious.  Used interchangeably with fish in many recipes.

data.description: Thin and long strips of white, almost sickly pale meat, clearly belonging to some sort of alien creature.  It has a very strong taste, and is quite chewy.

Ramen's adaptability to dried and preserved ingredients make it a staple in the culinary landscapes of frontier outposts and shipping crews alike.  Any spaceport worth visiting has a local ramen tradition of its own, and here the dish is slightly acidic, with a sweet aftertaste produced by the break-down of alien proteins.
Streetfood from the Salus spaceport.  White strips of meat, grilled and served with a heavy dressing of sour sauce.  Who knows where it came from, but it tastes pretty good.
A thick mass of flesh superficially resembling a mammalian heart.  It's the size of your fist and covered in dimpled grooves.

A chalk white blood analogue for emergency medical use.  Far more efficient at oxygenation than natural blood, it can also be used as a general performance enhancer.  Once injected, it will be metabolized or otherwise expunged from the body in around 8 hours.
data.//: Should add a Mercurial version with stronger performance enhancing effects later on.  As a quest/alliance reward?

data.description: A very strong, synthetic narcotic built from alien biochemistry and used to treat intense pain while in the field.  You'll need to inject it, and it's very addictive, so be careful.

Mercurial brand medical gel; a thick, translucent substance that can be applied to wounds to seal them and promote rapid healing.  Perhaps the most useful medical invention ever devised, it's a staple of any first aid kit.
A small, disposable injector filled with a cocktail of stimulants and painkillers.  Will kick you from death's door into awareness, but it's not a long-term solution.

use_action.activation_message: You shove the stimpack against your chest.

data.description: Thin wafers of kelp, the essential greens of frontier cuisine.  These were probably grown in some farm ship or another.
Most ramen served in the frontier is already vegan through the use of synthetic meat and other meat substitutes.  This variant simply doesn't pretend to include any meat at all.  Slightly spicy.
Streetfood from the Salus spaceport.  A large square of fried dough topped with red sauce.
Kibble made for humans.  A heavy dressing of spices makes it impossible to discern the original flavors it might have had.

This is a metal box containing survival supplies, often found within ships and their escape pods.  Its cyan highlights indicate that it's a simpler Type II kit, and that it would only be helpful in a planet whose atmosphere and gravity are within two deviations from Earth's.
A survival kit box clearly repurposed from a ship's escape pod.  It contains a variety of supplies to help you survive planetside.
A standard orbital cargo transfer container.  Its faceted corners are adorned with the livery of company you don't recognize.

A small radioactive source is used to safely(?) heat the contents of this vacuum flask.  Its not powerful enough to melt already frozen liquids.

 Frontier rated only.

Marketing has adorned the package of this individual ration with white and red livery, a deliberate callback to the space corporations of old.  Despite best efforts, the food within is no more natural than usual, but is at least palatable.
A plastic and aluminum foil bag for long term food storage.
The corpse of a long-dead colonist.  Near perfectly preserved by the merciless cold.
The irreparably broken remains of a Sentinel-lx.  Could be gutted for valuable parts.
This bloodhound won't be chasing anyone anymore.  Could be gutted for parts.
This bloodhound won't be chasing anyone anymore.  Could be gutted for parts.
A broken Seneschal, now limp and unmoving.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.

data.name: broken Likvidator
data.description: A broken Likvidator, now limp and unmoving.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.
A broken Famulus, now silent and mangled.  If it wasn't for the obvious rivets and welding, it would look completely human.  Could be stripped down for parts.

data.name: broken Udarnik
data.description: A broken Udarnik, now wrecked and immobile.  Could be stripped down for parts.

data.name: broken Udarnik
data.description: A broken Udarnik, now wrecked and immobile.  Could be stripped down for parts.

data.name: broken Brandspojt
data.description: A broken Brandspojt, now cold and inert.  Could be stripped down for parts.

data.name: broken rat snatcher
data.description: A broken rat snatcher, now harmless and inert.  Could be stripped down or re-crafted.

data.name: broken grab-bot
data.description: A broken grabber robot, now limp and nonthreatening.  Could be stripped down or re-crafted.

data.name: broken pest hunter
data.description: A broken pest hunter, now harmless and inert.  Could be gutted for parts or re-crafted.

data.name: broken Imaginifer
data.description: A broken military humaniform, shattered and inert.  While it looks nowhere near human, you still feel uneasy - as if it is studying you with its eyes.  Could be stripped for parts.

data.name: broken Suppressor
data.description: A broken Suppressor, shattered and inert.  Could be stripped for parts.

data.name: broken floating heater
data.description: A broken floating heater, now cold and motionless.  Could be stripped down or re-crafted.

data.name: broken disarmed advanced robot
data.description: A broken advanced robot.  Its internal weapons have been removed.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.

data.name: broken advanced robot
data.description: A broken advanced robot.  This one is armed with an integrated laser-emitter.  Could be stripped for parts.

data.name: broken Irradiant
data.description: The irreparably broken remains of an Irradiant weapons platform.  Its mounted plasma cannon self-destructed when the robot was rendered inoperable, but its remains could still be disassembled for some valuable parts.
The broken shell of an Isohypsa drone coordinator.  Most of its sensors and AI units are charred beyond any repair.
A broken Kabura-ya drone.  Could be disassembled for a meager amount of parts.

data.name: broken advanced robot
data.description: A broken advanced robot.  This one is armed with an integrated EMP projector.  Could be stripped for parts.

data.name: broken disarmed military bot
data.description: A broken defense robot.  Its internal weapons have been removed.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.

data.name: broken disarmed defense bot
data.description: A broken defense robot.  Its internal weapons have been removed.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.

data.name: broken surgical droid
data.description: A broken surgical robot, now crumpled and inert.  Could be stripped down for parts.
A broken eyebot.  Much less threatening now that it won't be calling for backup.  Could be gutted for parts.
A spent shock-mine, inert and harmless.  Cannot be recharged, but some of its components could be recycled.
A broken zenit security drone.  Could be disassembled for robotic components and heavy armor.
A broken police bot.  Much less threatening now that it's quiet and still.  Could be gutted for parts.
A broken riot control bot.  Much less threatening now that it's out of gas.  Could be gutted for parts.
A small techno doodad.
A collection of the building blocks of polymers.  With this and a whole lot of know-how, you can create proteins and other building blocks of life.
For the mixing of biomaterials that might otherwise be antithetical to one another.
Lab-grown or bioprinted muscle fibers; much denser and with higher performance ratios than baseline human muscles.
Materials capable of taking environmental chemicals and utilizing them for self-repair; be careful you don't make gray goo.
Uncontaminated pure cellular matter that, with the right instructions, can become just about anything.
Small circuits blue and gold, transmitting signals through light.
A resplendent golden grid inlaid on dark blue substrate.
A monolithic circuit shaped as a glowing cube of crystal.
In your hands lies a self-contained digital universe.  Its programs glowing like stars fixed on computational shells infinitely layered.
It has given you an answer, but you are yet to ask anything.
An intricately spun and carefully engineered sheet of iridescent fibers.
A small battery component with a very high energy density.
A capacitor made from exotic compounds, capable of storing a high amount of electric charge.
Ultracapacitors assembled into a finely tuned energy storage array.
Superconductive wire warped upon itself manipulates the electromagnetic spectrum to store vast amounts of power.
A complex grid pins space-time to the surface of the multiversal hyper-torus, allowing the energies within to leak into our sliver of existence.

An excellent heat conductor and electrical insulator.  Conductive thermoplastics were introduced to the civilian market nearly two centuries ago, and have tightly integrated themselves into the modern society since then.

Capable of withstanding extreme temperature gradients, fulleroclathrate supercritical coolants are the lifeblood of high-energy systems, from cutting-edge aerospace engines to experimental small arms tech.  Liquid at room conditions, it has to be used in a pressurized closed-loop system at 450 psi or greater.

Sections of dark, translucent, monocrystalline carbon fins, functionally identical to diamond.  Microscopic etches on the inside allows the flow of high-pressure coolant.  Crystalline carbon lattices exhibit far superior thermal conductivity and deformation resistance than any other conventional metals.

This delicate bundle of silvery, iridescent cables is capable of transporting heat energy between its connections instantly without ever heating up by itself.  Even the slightest damage to the casing will annihilate the ground-state quantum uniformity of the fermionic superfluid matrix - Handle with care!

A nondescript square piece of metal about the size of a computer chip.  One side is cold to the touch, while the other is uncomfortably hot.  Hermetically sealed and devoid of any identifying feature, this peculiar device gives off an unexplainable, sinister aura.

data.//: This item drops from disassembly instead of afs_heat_2 because that is a liquid. Intended as a QOL detail in case player forgot/didn't know to bring watertight containers when disassembling a relevant object. DO NOT use in crafting recipes, use afs_heat_2 instead.
data.description: Rusty fluid reservoirs and decomposing high-pressure tubing containing still usable supercritical coolant.  You could disassemble it to separate the liquid coolant from the rest of the scrap.
A sturdy, industrially crafted electromagnet.
A powerful super conductive electromagnet, that must be kept at very low temperatures to operate.
A powerful electromagnet made from a room temperature superconductor.
Black metallic fluid, harmonically flowing from one fractal shape to the next.
Miscellaneous scrap pieces made from a composite alloy.
Malleable carbide cast by forges on high earth orbit.
A meta material fabricated by precisely layering different elements at an atomic scale.

Great forges within the Earth's core wrought hydrogen into flaming metal and poured it within lattices of super conductive lanthanum.  Locked in magnetic equilibrium, it was left to cool into a dark unbreakable metal.
Matter condensed from the liminal spaces between dimensions.
A thin strand of wire and a clamp, meant to be spliced into the smaller nerves of the human body.
A small array of metallic needles allows complex communication between machine and human mind.
A complexly etched rod of metal interfaces with the corpus callosum of the patient, granting increased control of bionic functions.
Photonic axons process thought at speeds far surpassing primitive, chemical-driven communication.
A membrane of artificial neurons envelops the cerebral cortex, melding machine and human intellect into a gestalt much greater than its individual parts.
Lenses, mirrors, emitters and other optical elements that once belonged to a weapon, industrial cutter or laser research setup.
A diminute sphere of crystal and metal, magnetically affixed to the centroid of its containing chamber.

data.name: heat retention xtreme cream
data.description: The last word in cold snap protection designed to give short term protection in the event of a suit breach in vacuum.

data.name: inactive Frankenstein
data.description: This stitched together abomination in human form lies still and waiting for you to give it the spark of life.  In all likelihood you are the monster.

data.name: atomic butter churn on a stand
data.description: The Rivtech Atomic Butter Churn in deployed state.  It hums menacingly.  Ready to add raw milk and salt.  It will churn till the earth is a cinder.

data.name: diamond press on a stand
data.description: Matrioshka Fabritechnics Diamond Press deployed and ready to crush some things on a molecular level.  DO NOT INSERT ANY PART OF YOUR ANATOMY.

data.name: Mercurial Genetech
data.description: A single-use genetic treatment that can grant or remove the contained trait.  Can be used in gene editing machinery, which Mercurial normally offers free of charge in a bid to popularize augmentation in the general public.

data.name: Mercurial Genetech
data.description: A reusable genetic treatment that can grant or remove the contained trait as many times as needed.

data.//: Used in more accesible locations where Genetech can be found such as on shelves in Genetech-vaults. Weighted so that the most useful traits will spawn at a greatly reduced rate. Highly valuable or military grade traits should not end up in here.

data.name: Kabura-ya antipersonnel device
data.description: A tiny plastic explosive meant to be installed in a Kabura-ya drone.  Explodes 3 turns after activation.

use_action.msg: You activate the device.

data.name: demolition charge
data.description: A powerful explosive with a highly focused blast radius, often used for mining or demolition work.  It's configured to work alongside a radio detonator, and will explode immediately after activation.

use_action.msg: You activate the demolition charge.

data.name: active demolition charge
data.description: A powerful explosive with a highly focused blast radius, often used for mining or demolition work.  It's currently active.

use_action.message: You've already activated the %s, try throwing it instead.

data.description: A high explosive grenade that deals most of its damage through a powerful shockwave.  Reduced shrapnel makes it much safer to use in open spaces.

data.name: electroshock grenade
data.description: This is an electronic weapon that will emit a short-ranged electric field.  When activated, you'll have five turns before it starts doing so; throwing it before that would be a good idea.

data.name: armed electroshock grenade
data.description: This electroshock grenade is currently creating a dangerous electric field.

This is a military-grade cryo hand grenade.  Once it explodes it spreads exotic highly-radioactive shrapnel.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the grenade.

data.description: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Once it explodes it spreads exotic highly-thermodynamic shrapnel.  Better throw it!

data.name: neurotoxin grenade

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the grenade.

data.name: oxygen bomb
data.description: A favorite tool of mutineers everywhere, this is a standard issue oxygen candle deliberately tampered to explode upon activation.  Its fuse is dangerously short, so you won't want to waste any time.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the bomb.

data.name: active oxygen bomb
data.description: This bomb's fuse is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!

data.name: unstable fusion reactor
data.description: A pressurized plasma reactor that is on the verge of a catastrophic explosion.

Commonly carried by shipping crews that can afford it, Seyfert Armistice's 84K pistol doesn't particularly shine or show anything special but it keeps you safe on long journeys in the vast dark of Orion's Arm.

variants.description: Across the Orion Arm, there exist pistols that possess subtle elegance, unmatched precision, or even just straightforward lethality.  This one simply shoots bullets.

Commonly carried by shipping crews that can afford it, Seyfert Armistice's 84K pistol doesn't particularly shine or show anything special but it keeps you safe on long journeys in the vast dark of Orion's Arm.

description.str: Dependable, reliable, classic.  The MarSec. 4 is the combat pistol made for those who can differentiate real quality from glued-on tech.

data.description: A finely sculpted white and silver pistol entrusted to Wraitheon's corporate elite.  It employs advanced targeting and precision guiding capabilities to deliver devastating bursts of guided 10mm microjet darts.  Firing is as expensive as it looks.

variants.description: A Silvergram smart pistol given a far less conspicuous "military carbon" black finish.  Its performance and smart targeting capacities are otherwise identical.

A finely sculpted white and silver pistol entrusted to Wraitheon's corporate elite.  It employs advanced targeting and precision guiding capabilities to deliver devastating bursts of guided 10mm microjet darts.  Firing is as expensive as it looks.

data.description: Manufactured by Gibson Armory, the S86 is a light-weight grenade launcher designed to take care of moderately armored opponents.  While the S86 firepower is nothing to truly gawk at, it still packs quite a punch both for the target and user and is usually mounted as it is impossible to fire with average strength.

A powerful, single shot 25mm rifle, heavy under the weight of several recoil dampening mechanisms.  Designed by the now defunct Goa Firearms, it was originally conceived as a luxury rifle for sport hunting alien megafauna.

The much feared 2519 smart sniper platform leverages advanced ballistic targeting and guidance computers to deliver heavy munitions with unerring precision.  Its undisputed lethality makes it a rare sight outside of the company's max security divisions.
A crude grenade launcher that's been either ripped from a broken robot or built using a hacked template.  The remnants of a loading rack allow it to hold three 40mm grenades at once.
A slick, miniature derringer designed as a backup weapon for covert operations and close-range assassination.  It will fire up to four 5x50mm penetrators simultaneously, to devastating effect.

This light carbine fires 5x50mm armor-piercing flechette cartridges.  Classified as a special purpose individual weapon, this advanced firearm was developed by Rivtech for the US military shortly before the end of the world.  Designed to be fired in bursts, it excels in close combat.

This lightweight machine pistol fires 5x50mm armor-piercing flechette cartridges.  Classified as an individual defense weapon, this advanced firearm was developed by Rivtech for the US military shortly before the end of the world.  Designed to be fired in bursts, it excels in close combat.

A massive, unwieldy revolver, using combined magnetic and chemical propulsion to fire 7.50mm rounds at energies that rival a sniping platform.  It additionally features a secondary barrel for a single 00 shot shell.

The T72 remains a relic of the early hyperspace era, meant to be used by and against the posthuman.  Its perhaps most notable for its use by fictional rebel figures than for any sort of actual combat effectiveness.

A lightweight, bolt-action gun that is barely more than a 7.50mm barrel mounted within a flimsy metal assembly.  Cheaply made and outdated in all respects, it's only useful in the most extenuating of circumstances.

A light machine gun manufactured by Accipiter Firearms and distributed by Wraitheon.  The Hawk-00's high rate of fire makes it ideally suited to lay down suppressive fire; but also makes it exceedingly hard to control while unmounted.

An eminently sturdy and reliable bullpup rifle issued by UICA's military during early reclamation expeditions.  Although it's been out of service for nearly two decades, many a private military and contractor has found a use for the SR-P9, and it remains common long past its initial introduction into service.

Compact and powerful, the SR-77 serves as the current main firearm of UICA assault teams, having replaced the SR-P9 in the very last decade of the reclamation wars.  Designed for combat withing the tight confines of spacecraft and habitats, the SR-77 is a bullpup carbine with a top-mounted magazine and a high rate of fire.  Performance in open terrain is subpar.

variants.description: Compact and powerful, the SR-77 serves as the current main firearm of UICA assault teams, having replaced the SR-P9 in the very last decade of the reclamation wars.  Designed for combat withing the tight confines of spacecraft and habitats, the SR-77 is a bullpup carbine with a top-mounted magazine and a high rate of fire.  Performance in open terrain is subpar.

A rare version of the m90-UASTA PDW built to its original private market specifications, featuring an ergonomic bullpup design and a large magazine capacity underneath a sleek white and chromed finish.  Actual combat performance is slightly improved over the more common military model, due to the use of higher-quality materials within the barrel and ETC ignition system.

data.description:
The legendary apex of smartgun technology, believed to be an urban legend by most.  Bleeding-edge targeting systems allow it to track up 10 distinct targets simultaneously, with every trigger pull delivering a burst of two 7.5mm microjet darts to each target with a precision that is best described as supernatural.  One needs only to point the weapon in the general direction of the enemy, and the Vahagn will do the rest.

Prohibitive cost and complexity kept this weapon from ever seeing the light of day, and only a handful of prototypes are believed to exist within the black market.  Finding one here can only mean that corporate forces beyond the ordinary have made Salus IV their battleground.

data.//: Bear in mind that most revolvers don't reach $1K.  Expensive.
data.description: Considered overkill by some, the Rivtech M99 remains an exceedingly powerful addition to the arsenal of any gunslinger.

description.str: This is a pseudo item for monster attacks.  If you see this, it's a bug.

data.description: A stubby industrial tool used to shoot expanding foam.  Using it as a weapon might require some creative thinking.
A severed robotic hand from a Wraitheon Sentinel.  The powerful electro-laser stun gun embed on its wrist is still functional, and can be used when connected to an UPS.
A powerful tri-barreled laser weapon, still mounted to the robotic hand of the Wraitheon drone it originally belonged to.  Can still be fired when connected to an UPS.

This is an x-ray laser stripped from a TX-5LR Cerberus laser turret that has been modified to use UPS power for firing.  Single shot then requires reloading.  Nicknamed the 'Tin Can Killer' for its ability to destroy power armor.
This is a cheap laser rifle made from common components.  Weak, but can be powered with rechargeable batteries.

A common pulse-laser pistol cleared for civilian use.  Recoilless, energy-efficient, and easy to use, the av-22 is often carried as a defense weapon by those who lack the practice required to effectively use ballistic weaponry.  Due to its low power, it must be fired in sequence mode to stand a chance against hardened foes.

A laser pistol of tremendous power, equally as likely to melt its targets as it is to melt itself.  Powerful enough to punch through heavy military armor, it'll win most shootouts so long as you can end them in three shots or less.

A silver, elegantly-wrought laser pistol that fires armor-piercing bolts of golden light.  A now-irreplaceable historical artifact built by the engineering AIs of the late Hyperspace Era, it is as precious as it is deadly.

Straight from the bureaus of the old Soviet Union the PLC-75 is the crude and brutal answer to the constraints posed by the design of heavy laser ordnance.  Its use of antiquated flashtube pumped laser technology makes it unwieldy and wholly incompatible with modern equipment, whether this offers any advantage to downrange targets remains a matter of contentious dispute.

Crown jewel of Shikishma armories, and possible product of unsanctioned data scavenging, the A-82 is the undisputed market leader when it comes to man portable laser weaponry.  Sustained fire is likely to cause secondary explosions as target layers are vaporized.

An incredibly ancient and outdated laser pistol design with origins traceable to Earth's early Space Age.  One of the few 'open-hardware' guns, its leaked and widely-circulated design specifications allow this weapon to retain some popularity within backwater worlds.

This 'energy weapon' appears to be haphazardly jury-rigged from commercially available electronics.  It has a radar dish placed where a barrel would be, and the frame of a weapon is covered in a mesh of wiring.  Despite its appearance, this weapon can temporarily stun robots if you manage to hit their sensors.

Based on an old TsKBEM design, this is a rail launcher used in mining exploration.  The rod is fired into a rock face and a seismic mapper on the launcher displays ore veins.  Not being designed for combat, it is difficult to use without the augmented strength of an exosuit and the reloading process is quite slow.  The barrel is covered in warning labels indemnifying the manufacturer of any injuries caused by misuse.

This light coilgun fires 3x35mm armor-piercing flechette.  Classified as a support crew weapon that can be stashed in hidden lockers throughout the floors of a ship.  Designed to be fired in short bursts, if the flechettes pierce a ship's hull they leave tiny holes that are easily repaired.

An automatic coilgun made entirely of lightweight ceramics, with no moving pieces and if loaded with splinter rounds almost entirely invisible on most security scanners.  No one is sure who manufactures this assassin's tool, but they randomly come onto the back room markets frequented by the unsavory.

description.str: A plasma gun.

data.description: A heavy plasma railgun that easily defeats most forms of conventional armor and flash-incinerates anything  behind it.  Its large size and liability to overheat make it unsuitable for infantry use, but it is a common sight on military vehicles and in the hands of power-armored troops, especially when heavy armor is expected.

A short and stubby 2 gram plasma railgun occasionally used by espatiers as a hull breaching tool.  Like larger plasma weapons, it propels toroids of plasma that detonate on contact, but its reduced size heavily hampers its range and damage output.  Fired within an atmosphere, its very low range makes it dangerous to shooter and target alike.

A common modification for directed plasma torches that involves the installation of oversize capacitor banks and judiciously bypassed safety mechanisms, allowing them to function as a deadly if decidedly short-ranged weapons.  In most cases, the resulting "gun" can still perform its original metalworking functions, albeit at a much lower efficiency.

Unlike purposefully made plasma weapons, the propelled plasma bottle won't cause a considerable explosion upon contact, allowing for relatively safe operation within enclosed spaces.

Exhaust from a salvaged starship engine is channeled through a series of magnetic coils and focused into a searing fan of plasma, creating a crude but effective short range weapon that can easily melt through most forms of armor.  Its makeshift nature and lack of proper cooling systems make it prone to overheating and catastrophic failure.
Bionic one-shot subdermal 10mm pistol integrated with your head.

A single-shot, break-action, electrically propelled, steel rail launcher handcrafted from scrap.  The hypervelocity metal stake that it fires is accelerated to the point of spontaneous combustion by a Lorentz force generated by electromagnetic induction, powered by a standard UPS.

A widely popular combat shotgun featuring minor iterative refinements to a base design nearly three centuries old.  Whether the design is outdated or unsurpassable remains a matter of personal opinion.

variants.description: A crude but otherwise serviceable pump-action shotgun built from a hacked or scavenged template.  Frequently seen in the hands of frontier pirates, settlers or salvors.  Not that such groups are much different from one another.

The standard issue combat shotgun of UICA marine and colonial forces.  Shot shells have poor performance against modern combat armor, so the M2101 is more often used during policing and peacekeeping operations.

A widely popular combat shotgun featuring minor iterative refinements to a base design nearly three centuries old.  Whether the design is outdated or unsurpassable remains a matter of personal opinion.

data.description: An advanced shotgun that combines chemical and electromagnetic propulsion systems to accelerate and focus a cloud of steel flechettes.  Resulting in a longer effective range and greater penetration than whats conventionally possible.  Most often deployed during low-intensity corporate conflicts.

A massive TSKBEM-design shotgun intended for exosuit forces, the Raketa aka 'Rocket' is a magazine-fed bullpup shotgun featuring twin barrels.  This design remains popular for extra-atmospheric operations as the 12ga rounds are less likely to pierce a ship or station's delicate hull.
A massive TSKBEM-designed 'sidearm' intended for exosuits and uplifts, the Drotik aka 'Dart' is a large revolver firing 12ga shells.
The single round 00 bore barrel built at the center of the T72 revolver.  Can function as a backup in case the power pack of the main weapon is depleted.

Within the solid barrel of the Raaz PROTON, an electrical anomaly is carefully duplicated through magnetic stimulation and projected outwards.  Freed from containment, the anomaly will temporarily settle in the physical world and quickly emit its stored electrical charge before dissipating.

A powerful anti-drone defense weapon, the W3310 Archangel is capable of firing a chain of electrical discharges that can arc between multiple targets.  Most effective against groups of lightly armored foes, use within closed spaces is not recommended due to the risk of self-inflicted injury.
data.//: High energy drain due to the damage dealt by the chain effect.

data.description: Wraitheon Armories' premier electrolaser personal defense weapon.  The W3100 Volt adjustable power settings make it adaptable to most conflict situations, lethal or otherwise, and make it a favorite among well-off security forces and law enforcement corps.

description.str: How shocking!

data.description: Custom firmware for the electrical ignition system of caseless firearms.  Tweaks the ignition timing to maximize pressure in the chamber, increasing muzzle velocity and armor penetration at the cost of increased wear on the weapon.

Custom firmware for the electrical ignition system of caseless firearms.  Tweaks the ignition timing to ensure that fired bullets remain subsonic, reducing noise at the cost of range and armor penetration.

Custom firmware for the electrical ignition system of caseless firearms.  Increases the potency of the heat ignition system, causing bullets to melt and be subsequently fired as globules of superheated metal.  The projectiles will set targets on fire, at the cost of direct damage, range, and weapon durability.

A set of high-tech electronics and optics.  This converts a laser pistol into a less-lethal electrolaser capable of stunning targets, at the cost of decreased damage output and increased power consumption.
A set of electronics to optimize emitter workcycle and increase overall energy efficiency.  Decreases power consumption.
A capacitor with a higher energy density increases range and damage, at the cost of doubling power consumption.

data.//: Yes lead isn't magnetic, no I don't care.
data.description: A choke that uses a powerful cross-shaped electromagnet to pull the shot cloud together, greatly reducing the spread of shot.  Prevents the use of slugs.

data.//: Flechettes should be made a distinct ammo type, but that would break other vanilla shotguns. Change should happen when aftershock becomes total conversion.
data.description: A tuned set of electromagnets that accelerate projectiles to a much higher velocity than normal, increasing range and damage.  The required modifications are invasive and cannot be removed once installed.
The iron sights of this weapon are infamously terrible, making aiming much harder than it needs to be.

An advanced ballistic computer calculates projectile trajectories, hit-probabilities, and enemy movements, before outputting the information into an AR holo display.  It greatly increases both accuracy and aiming speed.
An integrated ballistic computer completely replaces the sights of this weapon.  Aiming depends on a small glass screen on which targets are automatically highlighted.
This is your personal ID card.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this grants you access to the barracks locker room.
This is an ID card you found.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this grants you access to the barracks locker room.
This is an ID card you found.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this grants you access to the workshop's exosuit storage bay.
A slim card that is used to initialize a STEED, which will then imprint the rider's biometric data and follow them unerringly.
A master keycard for all TSKBEM prefab industrial infrastructure built before the year 2152.  Invaluable to anyone seeking to salvage the industrial ruins of Orion.

Issued only to the highest echelons of Mercurial corporate security, these cards provide unfettered access to all enforcer prefab facilites built before the year 2152.  A lucrative find for any salvor on Salus IV.

A master keycard for nearly all Mercurial corporate facilities and infrastructure built before the year 2152.  Invaluable on Salus IV, this card will grant you entry to all but the most secure Mercurial facilities.

This is a horrifying monstrosity.  Using this item is cannibalism in all but taste and involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its revolving laser cannons.

use_action.friendly_msg: The brain blaster swivels towards you.  Hi new friend!
use_action.hostile_msg: The brain blaster swivels towards you.  You feel a buzzing in the air.

data.description: This is an inactive Beagle Mini-Tank UGV.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 rounds and 40mm cartridge grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the robot) and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tank drone will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.
data.//: cheating a bit with the volume due to lack of proper vehicle storage options

use_action.friendly_msg: The tank drone rolls out and begins acquiring targets.
use_action.hostile_msg: The tank drone swivels its turret and aims directly at you.  Don your brown pants!
use_action.//: Milspec, clearly designed with little concern for collateral damage. What did you expect of a robo-tank?

data.description: This is an inactive chicken walker.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 rounds and 40mm cartridge grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the robot) and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tank drone will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.
data.//: cheating a bit with the volume due to lack of proper vehicle storage options

use_action.friendly_msg: The chicken bot rolls out and begins acquiring targets.
use_action.hostile_msg: The chicken bot swivels its turret and aims directly at you.  Don your brown pants!
use_action.//: Milspec, clearly designed with little concern for collateral damage.  What did you expect of a chicken walker?

data.description: This is an inactive Honda Regnal.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, wondering how it fuels its flamethrower and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tribot will then identify you as an ally, roam around or follow you, and impale hostiles with its spiked cable weapons.

use_action.friendly_msg: The tribot rises to its feet and scans the area for contaminants.
use_action.hostile_msg: The tribot glowers down at you and ignites its flamethrower.  Turns out you hate the smell of napalm.
use_action.//: No observed open deployment, likely a prototype or secret project

data.description: A broken tribot.  Now that its legs lie broken and immobile, the world seems a little less threatening.  Could be gutted for parts.
A broken Scavbot Skorpion.  Now that its legs lie broken and immobile, the world seems a little less threatening.  Could be gutted for parts.
A broken tank drone.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.
A broken chicken walker.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.
data.//: Former volume: 1100 L. Adjusted to 1000L so it can actually be placed. TODO(?): Re-add old volume with some sort of flag

data.description: Crouched and dead still, this armored luxurious robot resembles an ancient knight immersed in deep prayer.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the robot will identify you as a friendly, and will protect you from nearby foes.

An inactive Kabura-ya hunter drone, folded for ease of storage.  If deployed, it will seek and fly to the closest enemy before detonating.  Unlike most robots, its activation depends on a successful throw, and not on your computer skill.

use_action.friendly_msg: The Kabura-ya emits a short IFF chirp as you throw it.
use_action.hostile_msg: The Kabura-ya emits an warning whine after your botched throw!

data.description: This is an inactive bloodhound drone.  If successfully deployed, it will fly towards enemy targets and highlight them with a powerful spotlight.

use_action.friendly_msg: The bloodhound drone flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the bloodhound drone; it's hostile!

data.description: This is an inactive laser turret.  Using this item involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its replaceable laser cannons.  It requires ammunition tubes to fire.

data.name: inactive bee-bot
data.description: A salvaged utility robot converted into an ambulatory bee hive that periodically removes and delivers segments of fresh honey comb.  It protects the insect colony with a mechanical crossbow mounted to its chassis.  Activate this item, with wooden bolts in your inventory, to load and deploy the robot.

data.name: inactive shock-mine
data.description: A less-than-lethal mine that emits a powerful electrical shock when triggered.  Activate this item to deploy the mine, which will have a lifetime of 10 hours after activation.

data.name: inactive hack
data.description: This is an inactive manhack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  They are covered with whirring blades and attack by throwing themselves against their target.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the manhack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

data.name: inactive floating lantern
data.description: An inactive floating lantern, a fist-sized robot that flies through the air and illuminates its surroundings with bright LEDs.  The lantern is non aggressive and has no means of attack.  Activate this item to deploy the salvaged robot.

use_action.friendly_msg: The floating lantern flies from your hand and lights up the area!

data.name: inactive military robot
data.description: An unpowered military robot fitted with an integrated 7.62 firearm and electric prod.  Activate this item, with ammo in your inventory, to load and deploy the robot.

data.name: inactive rat snatcher
data.description: A small hexapod drone designed to hold small pests, folded into a small cube for easy storage.  It's capable of hunting all sorts of small mammals with remarkable efficiency, but shouldn't be expected to handle anything much bigger than a rat.

data.name: inactive grab-bot
data.description: A salvaged skitterbot repurposed to grab onto and immobilize enemies.  Activate this item to deploy the robot.

data.name: inactive pest hunter
data.description: A salvaged skitterbot refitted with an 8mm integrated firearm.  Activate this item, with ammo in your inventory, to load and deploy the robot.

data.name: inactive floating heater
data.description: A salvaged eyebot repurposed into a floating space heater.  It emits a constant jet of warm air to heat an enclosed space.  It is non-aggressive and has no weapons systems.  Activate this item to deploy the robot.

This is an inactive laser turret.  Using this item involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its revolving laser cannons.  It requires sunlight in order to fire.

This is an inactive laser turret.  Using this item involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its revolving laser cannons.  It requires sunlight in order to fire.
An inactive eyebot.  Using this item involves turning it on and launching the UAV.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the eyebot will then keep watch for intruders.

use_action.friendly_msg: The eyebot hums and takes to the sky.
use_action.hostile_msg: The eyebot beeps disapprovingly and focuses its camera on your face.  Say cheese!
use_action.//: Like most surveillance tech these likely have poor security. Secure the wifi!

data.description: An inactive police robot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the police bot will then identify you as law enforcement, roam around or follow you, and attempt to detain lawbreakers.

use_action.friendly_msg: The police bot rolls into action, ready to pursue criminals.
use_action.hostile_msg: A siren howls and lights flash as the police bot prepares to arrest you!
use_action.//: Wheeled and must be easy-to-use for police deployment

data.description: An inactive riot control bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the robot will bring order and peace to the horde.

use_action.friendly_msg: The riot control bot rolls into action.
use_action.hostile_msg: The riot control bot gasses you and approaches with a pair of handcuffs!
use_action.//: Pretty easy but you want to be careful with the gas

PrepNet had been heavily involved in avoiding taxes by using untraceable internet currencies.  These however are physical coins with random numbers sequences embossed on them and RFID chips inside.
data.//: The coins would be worthless but the PrepNet Phyle still retains some manufacturing capacity

data.description: A steel canister containing carbon, iron, titanium, copper, and other elements in specifically engineered atomic-scale configurations.  Feedstock for most modern industrial processes, a nanofabricator can assemble them into usable items.
Truly putting the 'distress' in 'distress beacon,' this one has a huge hole in the front.  It will not be alerting anyone today.  Perhaps you could disassemble it for scrap.
Time and the elements have reduced them to a mound of filthy ribbons.
A piece of light titanium, usable for crafting or repairs.
A small pellet of silvery metal, still warm to the touch.
A broken chunk of clearcrete.  Basically a clear rock.
A small pellet of fissile material.  Handle carefully.
A yellow drum meant for the storage of hazardous substances.

The Rivtech Churninator 4000, the only churn to be banned by 13 religious sects.  The legs are currently folded up for travel.  Unlike a standard churn that requires cream separated from raw milk this churn requires only raw milk, salt and a healthy respect for glowing objects.
data.//: I figured bionic preppers would have a sci-fi solution to some low tech problems.

description.str: This is a crafting_pseudo_item if you have it something is wrong.

data.description: A strong, durable metal.  Highly valued for its weight to strength ratio and an excellent upgrade to aluminum for those properties - albeit a lot more expensive due to rarity.  More commonly used in jewelry and medical implants.
data.//: Density 4.506g/cm³ ~ 1.127kg/250ml @ stack 1000 = 1g/unit

data.description: An internal implant to correct a musculoskeletal problem such as a bad hip or back.  It is made of titanium due to its biocompatibility.
A dental implant made of pure titanium, used to replace teeth due to its biocompatibility and durability.
A thick, masculine watch made out of titanium.  It is durable, light-weight and water-resistant, an excellent watch to have in a hostile environment.
A thick, masculine ring made out of titanium.  Made in a variety of styles and finishes, they're valued for their durability.
A very heavy sphere of radiation shielding completely obscures the inner workings of this hyperspace-age device.  Any experienced salvor knows that opening it would completely ruin it.

A gleaming rod of hyperspace-age alloy, manufactured through arts lost to the discontinuity.  A critical and near irreplaceable component of interstellar industry, it would fetch a high price anywhere.
A mass of corroded metal and plastic, identifiable as a pistol only due to its general shape.  Some of its components might still be salvageable.
Pitted and corroded, this weapon is barely recognizable as a rifle.  Some of its components might still be salvageable.
Not much of this weapon remains, at most it could be used to bar a door.
A small box of heavily corroded metal.  Its more fragile internal components wasted away long ago.
This transparent slate of computation glass was once an incredibly versatile hypercloud access point.  It continues to display "No Connection" in ancient English script.

This transparent lune of computation glass was once an incredibly versatile hypercloud access point.  It continues to display "No Connection" in ancient English script.  Although completely useless these sometimes gain popularity as a fashion accessory.
A creased card with images and a personal message.

An ancient document from before the Discontinuity, detailing the purchase of the Vanishing Arc by your great-great-grandfather, signed and validated by a long nonexistent Earth polity.

A simple legal curiosity of no real value, true ownership of this ship is guaranteed by the self-destruct mechanism you have programmed into its main reactor.

An ancient medal given for exemplary service in Van Maneen's Exploratory Navy.  You have no idea what the Van Maanen Navy was, or how this thing ended up in the display case, but getting rid of it would make you uncomfortable.
Identity codes for Nyssia, Aztlan, Luzhan, and many other polities in the spinward frontier, all forgeries.  You fathom most of them would still work.
A 20-round magazine for use with the Seyfert 84k.
A magazine for the MarSec handguns.  It holds 14 rounds.
A transparent polymer 22-round magazine for Silvergram pattern smart pistols.
A 40-round magazine for use with 25mm firearms.
A 100-round box magazine for use with 5x50mm flechette firearms.  Designated as RMFB100.
A 50-round box magazine for use with 5x50mm flechette firearms.  Designated as RMFB50.
A standardized 30-round magazine compatible with most UICA issue rifles.
A standardized 100-round double drum magazine compatible with most UICA issue rifles.
A speedloader for the MarSec T72 revolver, holds 9 rounds of 7.50mm ammunition.
A translucent 45-round box magazine, for use with the SR-77.
A large box magazine and accompanying feed chute for the Vahagn 10XR.  Holds 80 rounds of 7.50mm SDART ammunition.
This speedloader, made by Rivtech for use with the RM99 revolver, can hold 5 rounds of 8x40mm caseless rounds and quickly reload a compatible revolver.
A conical device salvaged from an alien artifact.  Grooves etched on its circular face slowly pulse with purple light.
A standard-design power cell compatible with most common energy weapons.  Can be recharged by connecting to a power source.
A compact power cell compatible with most common energy weapons.  Can be recharged by connecting to a power source.
A functional but poorly-built power cell compatible with most common energy weapons.  It cannot be recharged.

A thin strip of transuranic metal, glowing a somber blue from within its shielded glass prison.  A rare and sought-after relic, it could be used to momentarily power all sorts of technology from the late Hyperspace Era.
A pressurized 5L canister designed to feed an industrial foam gun.
A 150-round box magazine for use with 3x35mm flechette coilguns.  Marketed as GGS150.
A 75-round box magazine for use with 3x35mm flechette coilguns.  Marketed as GGS75.
A tiny canister that can safely store up to 4 grams of solid hydrogen in a cryo-pressurized state.
A reinforced canister that can safely store up to 20 grams of solid hydrogen in a cryo-pressurized state.

A yellow and red canister that can safely store up to 40 grams of solid hydrogen in a cryo-pressurized state.  A complex nozzle with integrated digital failsafes make it incompatible with military railguns.
A removable 30-round horizontal magazine, for use with the Raketa shotgun.
This speedloader holds up to eight 12ga shotgun shells, intended for use with the Drotik.
A high-density energy cell purposely made to power voltaic weaponry.

Some lemon vines.  Definitely GMO.
Proof that man went too far before the Cataclysm.

Never charge your phone again with the Rivtech atomic smartphone.  Rated for 10 million years of use, this cutting-edge gadget had been on public markets for less than a week when the Cataclysm hit, and their eye-watering price made them a rarity.  It includes an alarm clock, a high-resolution camera, and a bright flashlight.

use_action.msg: You activate the flashlight app.

use_action.message: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.

data.description: A small, sharp shovel, perfect for breaking off chunks of ice.
A shovel with a steel blade.
A sturdy metal shovel used for picking up snow and moving it somewhere else.

A compact imaging tool, capable of scanning and visualizing objects hiding behind walls, maintenance panels and all other sort of visual barriers.  While normally used to diagnostic potential faults within the internal systems of spaceships, the ability to peer between obstacles grant it obvious surveillance applications.  It can be activated to reveal a small conical area around you.
A handheld motion scanner normally used for pest control within spaceships.  This model features an integrated screen to highlight the location of detected motion.  It must be activated to function.

use_action.msg: The %s screen flashes on.

passive_effects.description: Passively detects movement at 10 second intervals.

data.description: This active motion scanner will survey your surroundings every ten seconds and audibly alert you when movement is detected.  Wielding it will accurately reveal the location of motion sources.

use_action.msg: The %s screen flashes briefly before fading out.

data.description: A pyrotechnic metal suspension that can be applied to metal surfaces and ignited to create 'temporary' welds.  Intended for use in emergency situations.

One of the many versions of UASTA certified plasma torches, essentially a civilian plasma railgun used to deliver focused waves of plasma for precision welding or metal cutting.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or demolition work, and is sometimes transformed into a weapon by mining & salvage outfits of questionable repute.
This phone is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

use_action.message: The phone turns off.

use_action.msg: You deactivate the flashlight app.

data.description: Your custom crafted atomic smartphone.  Most notably a confidential executive-level override program allows you to remotely control most robots.

use_action.msg: You activate the flashlight app.

use_action.message: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.

data.description: This phone is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

use_action.message: The phone turns off.

data.description: Rivtech's premiere self-heating kitchen appliance, complete with lid, hand-crafted with the power of the atom to reach any temperature in thirty seconds.  As bulky as it is, its plutonium power source means that it can be used to cook an absurd amount of meals without ever worrying about running low on power.  Unsurprisingly, sales weren't particularly good because of the prospect of irradiating your food, but internal shielding ensures that only trace amounts find their way into the center.
A huge, gas-powered saw with a diamond blade.  If it has gasoline, it can be turned on to turn it into a powerful metal cutting tool.

use_action.msg: You rev up the power cutter!

data.description: A huge, gas-powered saw with a diamond blade, currently a whirling blur.  It's consuming gasoline, but can be used as a fantastic tool for cutting metal.  You can also use it as a terrifying weapon, if you're into that sort of thing.

use_action.msg: Your power cutter falls quiet.

data.description: This former power cutter has been lightened and stripped of all those unnecessary safety measures, turning it into a gas-powered killing machine.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You rev up the murdersaw!

data.description: This fearsome weapon is currently whirring loudly and shaking with the force of its own power.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: Your murdersaw falls quiet.

data.description: An ignitable device that produces oxygen through an exothermic chemical reaction.  Often stocked as the last backup in case of total life support failure.  You could activate it, but that would just waste it.

This is a unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a device developed jointly by military and scientific interests for use in combat and the field.  The UPS is designed to power armor and some guns, but drains batteries quickly.  It can be worn strapped to either leg for ease of access, and it's been waterproofed to protect the delicate electronics.  Has its own custom battery, rechargeable and with higher capacity, but not removable
