A set of very small tools and encrypted digital keys normally used to repair bionic modules in clinical settings.  They will allow you to disassemble simple bionics, but anything more complex would require even more specialized tools.

A set of very small robotic tools and encrypted digital keys originally designed to disassemble and test the quality of industrially produced bionics.  A highly skilled and patient engineer could use them to manually assemble new cybernetics.

data.name: cybernetic power port mod
data.description: This device replaces standard power connections and battery ports for electronic devices with a carefully-shaped port that hooks into bionic implants.  When applied, it will convert an item to run directly off of bionic power.
A modified laptop, now additionally capable of transmitting in the ultra-high frequencies utilized by robots.  Activate it to command robots from afar.

use_action.msg: You light up the screen.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The laptop's batteries need more charge.

use_action.msg: You stop lighting up the screen.

data.name: portable virtual reality rig
data.description: A portable virtual reality rig with glasses for the HUD and the computing functions wrapped around the torso.  When powered on it will provide an overlay on everything you experience.

use_action.msg: The holosuite comes to life around you.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The laptop's batteries need more charge.

data.description: A portable high-power radiobeacon.  Signals a drone shuttle from Port Augustmoon, which will make landfall in about 30 minutes and leave 4 hours later, whether you board it or not.  Single use, all expenses paid in advance, and non refundable.

use_action.description: Call a shuttle.

use_action.msg: You power down the virtual overlay.

passive_effects.description: You are wearing equipment that gives 1 additional perception but causes you to see strange things.

data.description: Matrioshka Fabritechnics created this portable nanotech forge for when expeditions are setting up a basecamp far from population centers.  Once deployed it can be used to craft ultratech marvels that otherwise are too minute for human crafting.

description.str: This is a crafting_pseudo_item if you have it something is wrong.

data.description: A compact power source that employs the decay of transuranic elements to generate a small but constant amount of electricity and is commonly used in remote locations to power up equipment.  Must be integrated into a power grid before use.
A compact jet injector from a first aid kit.  A light based assistive injection system allows use without any medical training.
The interface jack of an implanted infolink, coiled within your forearm and accessible through a small port in your wrist.  It can be used to interface and hack into electronic devices.
A battery slot installed in your upper torso, designed to power bionic implants.  Compatible with the power cartridges used by laser weaponry.

Matrioshka Fabritechnics this device that can create pressures beyond those that create diamonds.  Once deployed it can be used to craft ultratech marvels that require substances of singular qualities.

description.str: This is a crafting_pseudo_item if you have it something is wrong.

data.//: Makes it look more sci-fi so it isn't out of place, not many actual changes otherwise.
data.description: A rugged kitchen in one tool, made for use within small spaceships or in the wilderness.  It can automatically prepare a variety of dishes while its owner focuses on other tasks.
This micro-cooker is currently cooking a dish.

A military mess kit designed for long-range reconnaissance patrols deployed behind enemy lines.  All of its parts are made from thin sheets of aluminum-superalloy composite and are insulated with ceramic coating.  Relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the smoke-producing chemical-fueled hexamine stove.  Compact, durable and lightweight.
This small device easily deploys anywhere you need it and will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries placed within it's storage space.
When deployed and powered this device can warm a small room enough to doff your EVA gear.
A small folded metal tripod that can be deployed to illuminate an area around itself.
A storage battery fit for improvised shelters.

data.name: robot carrier
data.description: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo, with additional railings to keep a large machine in place.  It is meant to hold large drones and robots for transport.  Use it on a suitable robot to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.
A segment of thick armor plating that would normally be found mounted on a spaceship.  Incredibly heavy.

A vehicle-mounted gantry for supporting an exosuit upright during maintenance and repair.  Includes the specialized tools needed for complex repairs and will also charge the suit's power when activated from the vehicle's controls.

The CE-4, commonly known as "The Claw", is a popular self-defense weapon used by corporate enforcers everywhere, especially on dangerous frontier worlds.  Made from a cylinder of heat activated memory-alloy, the flick of a switch allows it to morph between a less-lethal bludgeon form and a sharpened, super heated blade.  Currently, it is in its less-lethal configuration, and looks like a sleek side-handle metal baton.

use_action.msg: You activate the claw, and its bludgeoning surface slowly flattens into an edge as it begins to glow red-hot
use_action.need_charges_msg: The claw is out of charge.

data.description: The CE-4, commonly known as "The Claw", is a popular self-defense weapon used by corporate enforcers everywhere, especially on dangerous frontier planets.  Made from a cylinder of heat activated memory-alloy, the flick of a switch allows it to morph between a less-lethal bludgeon form and a sharpened, super heated blade.  Currently, it is in its lethal configuration, and looks like a sleek sword, humming softly as its blade glows from heat.

use_action.msg: The blade stops humming, and its edge dissipates into a smooth curve as it cools.

data.description: A delicate strand of light links the antipodes of this crescent-shaped device.  If the strand is interrupted, the device clanks and shudders before violently emitting a bolt of plasma from its apex.

A huge, heavy metal gauntlet lined with tubing and gauges.  Slow and unwieldy, it uses internal pressure to deliver devastating blows, but takes tremendous strength to use effectively.  Thanks to an internal microreactor, it doesn't require power of its own.
These gloves are designed for handling organisms that live in extremely cold temperatures.  They can also be used to freeze your foes to death.

passive_effects.description: Strikes from this weapon can freeze targets solid.

data.description: A grenade launcher mounted onto your right-hand wrist.  Less powerful than a proper grenade launcher, but infinitely more portable, and quick to reload.

description.str: The 120mm cannon from a tankbot.  If you have this, you'd best be debugging!

data.description: A luxury baseball bat made out of titanium that was banned from competitive sport due to the increased performance that put defenders at risk.
Designed to evade security measures, this knife is a must have for any Cataclysm dinner party.
A broad white-ceramic knife that is constantly kept coated in neurotoxic oil by a handle mounted reservoir.  Don't cut yourself.
A three pronged spear that is surface treated to be used confidently above and below water.

An ornate bow used by Aztlani nobility during hunting rituals.  Designed to fell the plated creatures of Aztlan, its articulated and power assisted limbs allow it to fire projectiles with a strength comparable to modern assault rifles.

With its drawing aid system currently disabled, firing it will require truly superhuman strength.  It can be activated to toggle it drawing assist functionality.

use_action.msg: You connect the bow to your UPS.

data.description:
An ornate bow used by Aztlani nobility during hunting rituals.  Designed to fell the plated creatures of Aztlan, its articulated and power assisted limbs allow it to fire projectiles with a strength comparable to modern assault rifles.

With its drawing aid system enabled, it can be much more easily drawn, at the cost of a modest amount of UPS power consumption per arrow.  It can be activated to toggle it drawing assist functionality.

use_action.msg: You disconnect the UPS.

data.description: An ornate, single-handed sword used by Aztlani hunters to finish injured game.  Made from gleaming composite alloy, its tip and frontal blade have been sharpened to a monomolecular point, while its back features a serrated saw edge.

A bow made from readily-available materials, and quickly and cheaply put together.  It is not made to be pretty, but to get a job done.  Its nocks and string are made of shape-memory alloy that help increase string tension in the string.  The memory alloy requires a UPS source to be activated.

A crossbow constructed of readily available materials, and quickly and cheaply put together.  While it isn't very pretty, it gets the job done, and its drawing mechanism is motorized allowing quick reloading.
A long filament of nested carbon nanotubes only a few microns in diameter.  In essence a very thin, very strong and very sharp blade that you throw at a moment's notice.

data.name: escape pod seat
data.description: The cushioned and upright facing seat of a single-seater escape pod.  A storage space beneath it holds survival supplies.

data.name: ship seat
data.description: A cushioned, adjustable seat with an integrated safety harness.  Normally seen within spaceships of all sizes.

data.name: chirurgic suite
data.description: A multitude of surgical arms seamlessly meld with the chromed ceiling.  They expectantly unravel with your approach, animated by an AI whose performances blur the lines between medicine and art.
data.//: Easy installation

data.name: Autodoc Mk. XVI
data.description: A commercial surgical robot often found within licensed clinics and corporate hospitals.  Its various AI routines assist during surgery, but they are no replacement for the actual operator's skill.

data.name: salvaged Autodoc
data.description: The kind of worn-down and dubiously safe surgical device that is perfectly at home in a back alley clinic.  It would take great skill to safely operate this.

data.name: sleep pod
data.description: This is a climate controlled sleep pod.  An easy way to reduce energy costs in dense urban environments.

data.name: cryo pod
data.description: This is a long term sleep pod.  Cryo pods are mostly used by people waiting a short term for organs or criminals avoiding heat right after a crime.

data.name: cryo pylon
data.description: This super chilled pylon is so cold it seems to pull in warmth towards itself and create a light breeze of freezing air.

data.name: active micro heat mill
data.description: This comparatively-small wind turbine heat mill turns wind energy into a relatively small amount of constant heat.  This heat provides a modicum of respite from the neverending cold of Salus IV; they were sometimes built in the dozens to create agricultural zones outside of greenhouses.

data.name: broken micro heat mill
data.description: This broken-down heat mill once provided respite from the cold.  Designed to operate without human maintenance indefinitely, but has broken down - or been intentionally damaged.

data.name: CRISPR Biolab
data.description: A boxy looking device of arms, droppers, and pipettes.  It was used pre-Cataclysm to do gene-editing experiments.

data.name: nano forge
data.description: Matrioshka Fabritechnics nano forge looks like a solid black box.  Apertures for ingredients open with a hum as the console commands are entered.  DO NOT INSERT ANY PART OF YOUR ANATOMY.

data.name: 3D printer
data.description: This box was used for rapid prototyping of products and for general entertainment purposes in the masses.

data.name: translocator buoy
data.description: A near undetectable spatial distortion field centered around a free floating golden mote.  Examining it from up close would let you encode it for use with a translocation device.

data.name: telepad
data.description: A smooth tile of metal, hiding beneath it the complex machinery of a translocator.  The engineering required to build these is poorly understood nowadays, so this one has likely been here since the Hyperspace Era.  Examining it from up close would let you encode it for use with a translocation device.

data.name: neural net inserter
data.description: This device looks like a cross between some kind of nightmare dentistry equipment and socketing tool mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful for those projects that require putting delicate items into hard to reach spaces.

data.name: monomolecular saw
data.description: A wire the size of a cheese cutter runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing atomically precise cuts at almost any angle.  Even unpowered it gives off a visual distortion for several inches around it to prevent you from losing a hand.  It is impossible to deconstruct this device without the wire self destructing.

data.name: military SICC terminal
data.description: Console interface for a Standard Interstellar Communications Cluster.  With the machine connected to it broken, it can only be salvaged for parts.

data.name: military SICC master computing array
data.description: A massive metal construct reaching as high as the ceiling, this Master Computing Array of a Standard Interstellar Communications Cluster used to be the pinnacle of quantum waveform manipulation technology.  Now, though, it's nothing more than a box full of delicious electronics.

data.name: sabotaged military SICC master computing array
data.description: Vandalized remains of a Standard Interstellar Communications Cluster.  Wires and connectors spill out from a torn side panel, revealing the mangled carcass of a century-old beast.  Although stripped of its core components, careful searching may reveal useful electronics for scavengers like you.

data.name: military SICC satellite link
data.description: A large satellite dish mounted on a towering amplification platform, linked to an orbital satellite that probably doesn't exist anymore.  Although the satellite dish is of little use due to the unorthodox geometry, the amplifier circuitry will prove invaluable for high-energy gadgets.

data.name: military SICC power supply
data.description: Dedicated power supply module for a Standard Interstellar Communications Cluster.  Capable of drawing thousands of watts during operation, it requires a dedicated heat dissipation array to function normally.

data.name: destroyed military SICC power supply
data.description: An incoherent mess of molten polymer and charred metamaterial, this badly damaged module used to be the power supply for a Standard Interstellar Communications Cluster.  It seems to have undergone a catastrophic overload event, which is weird considering the array of failsafes these things are equipped with.

data.name: military SICC heat dissipation array
data.description: A miniature forest of metallic fins and sparkling panels, this is a dedicated heat dissipation module for a Standard Interstellar Communications Cluster.  It is installed outside to utilize the frigid air for maximum cooling.

data.name: DIRT data interface
data.description: All-in-one integrated console for a Driving Intelligent Realtime Topography rover-mounted vehicular terrain scanner system.  In other words, a useless display monitor.

data.name: DIRT computation core
data.description: Data analysis and computing core for a DIRT terrain scanner system.  Rugged design and internal shock absorbers help this hefty metal box withstand extreme cold and harsh driving conditions.

data.name: dismantled DIRT computation core
data.description: It seems that you are not the first one to think of dismantling this precious metal box for the goodies inside - The top lid of this DIRT computational core is missing, and the hollowed-out insides are clearly visible from the opening.

data.name: DIRT scanner array
data.description: Mounted on a self-stabilizing gimbal, this high-tech sphere is full of various sensors and scanners that automatically map out the surrounding terrain with an amazing accuracy.

data.name: Exosuit gantry
data.description: A gantry for supporting an exosuit upright during maintenance and repair.  Includes the specialized tools needed for complex repairs and will also charge the suit's power when active.  This one is not currently functioning.

data.name: drone recharging station
data.description: An hybrid recharge and storage point for robots of all types.

data.name: ancient processor
data.description: Hundreds of paper thin photonics lie staked within its core, most are shattered or otherwise damaged beyond repair.

data.name: drone scheduler core
data.description: An AI unit meant to manage large cadres of working drones from afar.  This one is in a very bad shape, and it's not clear if it can be repaired.

data.name: pristine drone scheduler core
data.description: An AI unit meant to manage large cadres of working drones from afar.  It as functional as the day it was built, at least if its system checks are to be believed.

data.name: broken command console
data.description: A complex control station for an habitat or space ship.  It might still be possible to salvage some parts from it.

data.name: shuttle seat
data.description: The cushioned and upright facing seat of a short-ranged shuttle pod.  Has a locking bar that fits over your shoulders.

data.name: escape pod seat
data.description: The cushioned and upright facing seat of a single-seater escape pod.  A storage space beneath it holds survival supplies.

data.name: metal vapor forge
data.description: An automated robotic arm capable of precisely depositing metal atoms into any desired shape.  All manufacturing processes of interstellar significance require units such as this, and they are extremely difficult to replace.

data.name: robotic arm
data.description: An automated robotic arm used in assembly lines, which appears to be more general-purpose than specially designed assemblers.  Despite being functionless now, the parts could be useful.

data.name: high-pressure pumping station
data.description: A high-pressure pump used to move fluids through industrial systems.  Complex but relatively mundane it construction, it can be salvaged for low grade scrap.

data.name: catalytic core
data.description: A great pillar of gleaming alloy, used in a variety of industrial metalworking processes.  A critical and near irreplaceable component of interstellar industry.

data.name: coral obelisk
data.description: Facets of white coral erupt from the ground and assemble themselves into a free standing column.  The living surface is bioluminescent and rarely sparkles with golden light.

data.name: coral pedestal
data.description: Fluted white coral gently coils itself into a short pedestal.

data.name: Mercurial Resequencer
data.description: A large bio-sarcophagus and accompanying control machinery.  Used in gene editing and for general medical purposes, can impart or remove traits using a variety of gene templates.

data.name: Deactivated Mercurial Resequencer
data.description: A large bio-sarcophagus and accompanying control machinery.  Used in gene editing and for general medical purposes, can impart or remove traits using a variety of gene templates.  This one stands lifelessly, its screens black and the hum of machinery replaced by an eerie silence.

data.name: metal table
data.description: A serviceable but simple table made completely out of metal.  Spartan in appearance and commonly found within habitats and spaceships.

data.name: Ravaged Mercurial Resequencer
data.description: A large bio-sarcophagus and accompanying control machinery.  Panels dangle loosely from their hinges revealing a rat's nest of wires and cabling ripped from the machine.  Useless metal and electronics scraps are strewn about haphazardly on the floor.  It's clear anything of value has long been taken from this machine.

data.name: habitat kitchenette
data.description: A tiny sink and cooking surface only big enough to fit an electric hotplate, placed above and below many integrated storage units.  The minimal space in which you could technically cook.

data.name: storage board
data.description: The wall-mounted, steel and plastic storage solution of tomorrow.

data.name: integrated washroom
data.description: Waste and water pipes, conjoined into the most compact bathroom that could possibly be built.

data.name: industrial floodlight
data.description: A wall mountable floodlight, designed to illuminate large areas with a bright, white light.  Still functional thanks to some unknown backup power source.

data.name: screen mirror
data.description: A wall mounted digital display.  It would once have served as an entertainment and advertising system.

data.name: screen mirror
data.description: The screen wall is awash with rolling advertisements.

data.name: intermodal shipping crate
data.description: A sealed metal crate used to ferry cargo to and from orbit.  This one appears to be open.

data.name: sealed intermodal crate
data.description: A sealed metal crate used to ferry cargo to and from orbit.  This one appears to be secured with an electric lock.

data.name: powered down intermodal crate
data.description: A sealed metal crate used to ferry cargo to and from orbit.  This one appears to be secured with an electric lock that has shut down.

data.name: reinforced display case
data.description: A secure metal case at about waist-height, with reinforced glass paneling on top.  Useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off.  Secured with an electronic lock.

data.name: powered down reinforced display case
data.description: A secure metal case at about waist-height, with reinforced glass paneling on top.  Useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off.  Secured with an electronic lock.

data.name: reinforced display case
data.description: A secure metal case at about waist-height, with reinforced glass paneling on top.  Useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off.  This one had its lock hacked and is open.

data.name: broken display case
data.description: A secure metal case at about waist-height, with reinforced glass paneling on top.  Would be useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off, if the glass hadn't been shattered.

data.name: foam sofa
data.description: The classic corporate-style sofa, modular foam cushions mounted over a minimalist stainless steel frame.  A mainstay of frontier design since before the discontinuity.

data.name: Net Breacher recliner
data.description: A reclined metal chair adorned with soft fabric padding.  A number of cables dangle from the headrest, waiting to be connected to a bionic interface.  In the past, this state-of-the-art equipment would have served as a hypercloud access point for cyber security specialists.

data.name: security override panel
data.description: A slim wall mounted metal panel covering an electronic interface to manually override nearby security systems.

data.name: burnt out security override panel
data.description: A slim wall mounted metal panel covering an electronic interface to manually override nearby security systems.

data.name: safe
data.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with an electronic lock.  This one isn't actually locked, just closed.

data.name: safe
data.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with an electronic lock.  With a hacking tool and the right skills you might be able to crack it.

data.name: powered down safe
data.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with an electronic lock.  With a hacking tool and the right skills you might be able to crack it.

data.name: open safe
data.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with an electronic lock, albeit significantly less secure with the door open.

data.name: Genetech display mannequin
data.description: A life-size painted plastic figure of a person displaying prominent genetic alterations.  Commonly used as part of Mercurial Ad campaigns intended to sell the public on Genetech treatments.

data.name: atomic backup generator
data.description: Backup analog dials remain functional, and some latent heat is still present in its aged core.  It will not be long until the cold snuffs it out completely.

data.name: ancient controller
data.description: Some of its components remain viable, but most has decayed into useless scrap.

data.name: ECU
data.description: The central node of a life support system, tasked with regulating atmospherics and water flow to the rest of an habitat or ship.

data.name: Cryo-fluid pump
data.description: An insulated metal tank prepared for the storage of exotic cryo-coolants.  Relatively advanced in construction, it can be salvaged for valuable scrap.

data.name: atmospherics controller
data.description: An imposing brick of circuitry inlaid tubing adorned with a single console.  It might still half-work, even after all this time.

data.name: automated charging station
data.description: An automated charging console for electric vehicles.

data.name: broken automated charging station
data.description: An automated charging console for electric vehicles.  It's broken.  This is not a good thing.

data.name: habitat kitchenette
data.description: A tiny cooking surface only big enough to fit an induction top, placed above and below many integrated storage units.  The minimal space in which you could technically cook.

data.name: fridge
data.description: A compact refrigerator and freezer unit.  Its plugged into a ship's power supply, so it should be expected to work for a very long time.

data.name: hydraulic cylinder
data.description: A large cylindrical actuator that extends and retracts the landing gear of the ship.

data.name: landing skid
data.description: Retractable landing gear for a spaceship, hydraulically actuated and designed to absorb the impact of landing.

data.name: Direct fusion drive
data.description: A powerful fusion engine fueled by helium.  A miracle of hyperspace age technology, painstakingly reproduced from original schematics without true understanding.  Its core components are notably expensive.

data.name: Multi-axis maneuvering thruster
data.description: A set of highly maneuverable chemical thrusters used is small to medium spacecraft.

data.name: radioactive slag
data.description: A pile of melted slag from a destroyed spaceship reactor.  Incandescently hot and highly radioactive, you'd need a purposefully armored suit to even approach it.

data.name: foamcrete wall
data.description: A lightweight wall made from unreinforced foamcrete.  Not nearly as resilient as a real wall, but it will block sight and the elements nonetheless.

data.name: foamcrete floor
data.description: A relatively flat slab of unreinforced foamcrete.

data.name: clearcrete wall
data.description: A barrier made of clearcrete, perfect for greenhouses but looks extremely fragile.  It is most definitely not fragile, and it's probably alarmed in the event of a breach.

bash.sound: a cross between steel bending and stone shattering!

data.name: foamcrete wall
data.description: Automatically deployed by the ship to block breaches and seal off damaged sections, this foamcrete wall is a temporary solution at best.

data.name: foamcrete floor
data.description: Automatically deployed by the ship to block breaches and seal off damaged sections, this foamcrete floor is a temporary solution at best.

data.name: hard vacuum
data.description: The cold inhospitable vacuum of space.  Going this way without an EVA pack will end in either a slow cold death as your life support fades or a slow hot death as you drop into the planet's atmosphere.

data.name: coral floor
data.description: Thin shelves of coral latch together into a flat mosaic and portray the geometries of life.

data.name: coral floor
data.description: Filaments of white coral grow tall and weave themselves into a sinuous wall.  The living surface is ornately grooved, and golden light slowly flows within its gaps.

data.name: leviathan annelids
data.description: Several massive protrusions emerge from the ground, coiled together into a tower.  At the top, blue and purple tentacles sway in the wind.

data.name: lichen tree
data.description: A massive corrugated body sprouts from the lichen here, branching out into mushroom-like limbs, dust filling the air as the wind meets it.

data.name: fossilized conifer
data.description: A long dead tree standing on spindly legs similar to a Cypress which tapers into a point until spreading out in a hollow dodecahedron.

data.name: infested fossilized conifer
data.description: A long dead tree standing on spindly legs similar to a Cypress which tapers into a point until spreading out in a hollow dodecahedron.  The trunk seems to be splitting as tendrils of mold dig into it, clinging onto the tree like a frame.

data.name: lichen shrub
data.description: A small mound of lichen grows here, noticeably bigger than the lichen and moss around it.

data.name: lichen shrub
data.description: A small mound of lichen grows here, noticeably bigger than the lichen and moss around it.  A few clumps have been removed.

data.name: moss bush
data.description: A mound of moss, with large colorful stems protruding out of it.

data.name: geothermal bladder
data.description: Black veins support a large formation of bleached coral as it grows around the rim of this geothermal vent.  Above it, red and purple tentacles caress a balloon-shaped organ as it breathes.

data.name: breather
data.description: On the ground here lay several colorless coral reefs, the black veins are noticeably more engorged as they breathe.

data.name: overgrown vent
data.description: The coral and veins on the ground here have fused into a sea anemone-like structure; pufts of smoke and hot air emit from its mouth.

data.name: lichen
data.description: Many colorful species of ice-lichen, thriving above an uncharacteristically fertile segment of ice.  Either endemic, or surviving genecraft from an aborted terraforming project.

data.name: lichen bed
data.description: Familiar, yet unfamiliar.  Lichens and moss cling to rocks and lifeless dirt here, providing a squishy but colorful grass.

data.name: glacial ice
data.description: A small segment from the near planet-wide glacier of Salus IV.  Gets called 'ground' around these parts.

data.name: dirt
data.description: A relatively flat area of black dirt with no observable growth on it, caked with shards of rock.  The only real ground besides the glacial ice.

data.name: basalt floor
data.description: A relatively flat area of gray stone, warm to the touch.

data.name: geothermal vent
data.description: A basalt column stands here, perpetually emitting foul-smelling gas, similar to rotten eggs.  It is very warm to the touch, hot enough to burn you if you aren't careful.

data.name: fumarolic ice tower
data.description: A solid cloud-like structure, formed when water vapor escapes from the crust and meets the freezing air.  It is still emitting some gases.

data.name: bleached coral floor
data.description: Small outgrowths of white coral spring from an underlying lattice of black, pulsating veins.

data.name: toxic sewage
data.description: A pond of rust colored water, a thin sheen of iridescent murk reflects light across its surface.  Even brief immersion is likely to prove fatal.

data.name: closed metal door
data.description: A galvanized steel door, forged to withstand punishment and impede anyone or anything.  This one is secured with an electronic lock.

data.name: open security gate
data.description: A metal floor adorned with hazard lines indicating the presence of a security gate.

data.name: closed security gate
data.description: An extremely resilient gate made of assorted steel, carved and pounded into shape.

data.name: reinforced concrete floor
data.description: An extremely resilient floor made from carefully placed rebar and poured concrete, capable of providing protection from the elements.  As for the matching roof, it still requires supporting walls, otherwise it may very well cave in.

data.name: metal floor
data.description: High-quality and tough checkered metal flooring to reduce the risk of slips and falls.  Can support a roof.

data.name: metal floor
data.description: Prefab steel flooring for habitats in hazardous environments.  Its covered with a heavy layer of highly toxic industrial precipitate.

data.name: clearcrete skylight
data.description: A roof made from transparent fiber-reinforced concrete, allowing light to pass through.  Often used to build greenhouses in unfavorable environments.

data.name: metal floor, inactive overhead light
data.description: High-quality and tough checkered metal flooring to reduce the risk of slips and falls, with a still-functioning inactive light attached to the ceiling above.

data.name: linoleum tile, inactive overhead light
data.description: A section of flooring made out of a tough, rubbery material.  Colored a simple white.  There is a still-functioning inactive light attached to the ceiling above.

data.name: strong concrete floor, inactive overhead light
data.description: An extremely resilient floor made from carefully placed rebar and poured concrete, with a still-functioning inactive light attached to the ceiling above.

data.name: concrete floor, inactive overhead light
data.description: A bare and cold concrete floor with a still-functioning inactive light attached to the ceiling above.

data.name: simple metal floor, overhead light
data.description: A crudely welded-together metal floor with steel trusses and supporting girders.  Can support a roof.  A still-functioning light hangs from the ceiling above.

data.name: simple metal floor, inactive overhead light
data.description: A crudely welded-together metal floor with steel trusses and supporting girders.  Can support a roof.  A still-functioning inactive light hangs from the ceiling above.

data.name: habitat wall
data.description: An industrially fabricated assembly of lightweight metallic framing and insulated cover sheets, used to quickly assemble standardized colonial infrastructure.  Capable of resisting the merciless cold and not much else.

data.name: habitat window
data.description: A prefabricated porthole style window, equipped with metallic shutters for both protection and privacy purposes.  It cannot be opened, but with its shutters are retracted, it could be smashed with no particular difficulty.

data.name: habitat window (shutters)
data.description: A porthole style window of standard design, completely covered by sturdy metallic shutters.

data.name: broken habitat window (shutters)
data.description: The shutters of this porthole are deployed, but the lack of a window between them allows the frozen air to leak into the room.

data.name: broken habitat window
data.description: The glass panel that would have covered this porthole has been broken, allowing unfettered access to the rooms within.

data.name: broken habitat segment
data.description: Exposed structural ribs and battered plate metal are all what remains of this habitat segment.

data.name: nanofabricator control panel
data.description: A small computer panel attached to a nanofabricator.  It has a single slot for reading templates.

data.name: starship hull
data.description: A hull segment from a civilian starship.  Only sufficiently armored to defend against the vacuum and radiation of space, the only dangers you'd expect to find on the other side.

data.name: broken treads
data.description: A large set of broken and frozen over vehicle treads.

data.name: THI-14 StarCrane instrument panel
data.description: A large console, instrument panels and control surfaces.  You can fly the ship from here.

data.name: THI-14 StarCrane instrument panel
data.description: A large console, instrument panels and control surfaces.  You can fly the ship from here.

data.name: cargo bay ramp control
data.description: A large console used to lower and raise the cargo bay ramp.  The ramp needs to be retracted before you can take off.

data.name: retracted bay ramp
data.description: The closed cargo bay ramp of the ship.  It needs to be lowered before you can disembark.

data.name: landing stair control
data.description: A wall mounted control panel for the ship's landing stairs.  Traditionally, its poorly seen for the ship's captain to disembark using the cargo bay ramp instead of these stairs.

data.name: diamond-matrix canopy
data.description: A massive near-unbreakable starship canopy.  Most nanofabricators would struggle to produce a replacement nowadays.

data.name: diamond-matrix canopy (floor)
data.description: A giant pane of diamond-matrix glass, angled to allow viewing beneath the ship's hull.

data.name: gunship locker
data.description: A locker built into the hull of a ship.  May contain equipment.

data.name: ruined hull
data.description: This patch of hull has more holes in it than an ancient terran cheese.  It may provide some cover or it might get shot through.

data.name: gunship hull

data.name: prison grating
data.description: A detention wall made up of crisscrossed stainless steel bars.  There doesn't appear to be a lock on the bars, maybe look for a computer nearby?

data.name: storage board
data.description: The wall-mounted, steel and plastic storage solution of tomorrow.

data.name: view port
data.description: A thick, round window surrounded with a strong metal frame.  It's sealed closed.

data.name: starship corridor
data.description: Large metal plates with access panels to the conduits hiding beneath.

data.name: starship loading bay
data.description: A great slab of carbide, printed as a single piece.  It could withstand centuries of abuse, and indeed it has done so.

data.name: VENTR aerospike
data.description: One of eight powerful aerospike engines that allow the StarCrane to reach orbit.

data.name: StarCrane nacelle
data.description: Twin nacelles house independent reactors and fuel supply units.  Hundreds of thousands of StarCranes were built during the 22nd century, and back then you could easily swap a malfunctioning nacelle for a new one in a matter of hours.

data.name: Iblis Interplanetary Drive
data.description: The housing and guts of an Interplanetary drive engine.  It is plastered with warning signs.  If it's not working you could probably try to break into it for parts.

data.name: Iblis Interplanetary Drive Console
data.description: The control panel for the engines and generators that power the drive.  It would likely render the ship irrecoverable but it might do some damage to any robots near or in the ship if you set the engines to overload.

condition.u_query: Do you want to overload the ship's drive?

data.name: Iblis Interplanetary Navigation Console
data.description: The control panel for navigation.  Useless here on the ground but in space the only way to plot long distance travel.

data.name: Wraitheon Gunnery AI

data.name: command console

data.name: diamond-matrix glass
data.description: The diamond cubic lattice distorts distant light sources into eight pointed stars.  The galactic core is visible through the glass, but no spacer would ever give it more than a passing glance.

data.name: filled autoclave
data.description: A device that can steam its contents at high enough temperatures to completely sterilize them, killing any possible contaminants.

data.name: sample freezer
data.description: A specialized freezer capable of maintaining temperatures of -80 Celsius, and is often used only for the preservation of delicate scientific samples.

data.name: shaker incubator
data.description: A tool for keeping chemical broth nicely mixed, at just the right temperature to grow bacteria.  Although, more bacteria is probably the last thing you need, considering the circumstances.

data.name: high-performance liquid chromatographer
data.description: This high-tech tool would, with electricity and an experienced user, be a very useful way to separate chemicals in a liquid or aqueous phase, based on their affinity, to the stationary phase in a tube.  At least, that's what the label says.

data.name: gas chromatographer
data.description: This high-tech tool would, with electricity and an experienced user, be a very useful way to separate chemicals in a gaseous phase, based on their affinity, to a stationary phase in a tube.  At least, that's what the label says.

data.name: mass spectrometer
data.description: Inside this large white box is a carefully balanced set of electric field generators that can precisely separate ionized particles based on their charge-to-mass ratio, firing them into a detector that measures the exact mass of the particle hitting it.  Invaluable for chemical analysis and other advanced sciences, it's not as useful anymore.

data.name: nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer
data.description: This is a giant electromagnet with carefully tuned measurement equipment used to observe how magnetic fields affect nuclear spins.  It is a common workhorse for the discovery and study of chemical structures.

data.name: centrifuge
data.description: This is a centrifuge, a liquid separating device with an automated analyzer unit.  For some reason, this one has an attached battery pack.  It could be used to analyze a medical fluid sample, such as blood, if a test tube was placed in it.

data.description: The anchor-boatman, borne on the frozen wind like a predatory dandelion seed, subtly inclines its rigid parachutes as it drifts towards its prey, its clawed tentacles undulating and flicking as they taste the air for signs of life.  Soft things that get too close are hooked, bled out, and dragged behind it for months as it extracts every bit of nutrition it can.  Scavengers that try to take its prey often join them.
A large fluffy three-legged herbivore, extremely fast and cowardly.  It usually grazes alone, and relies on its keen senses to stay safe.
A large furred herbivore, with its heavy head constantly against the ground.  It uses its clawed hooves to shovel up the snow to reach any dead plant life to eat.
A small creature covered in blue down, scurrying across the ground fast as it digs through the snow with claws buried in its down, looking for food.  It works in large packs with its fellow kin.
A six-legged animal, showing relative intelligence in not only its ability to track and hunt down prey, but its strategy of covering itself with the skin of its hunts to warm itself.
A tall bird with two long, muscular legs, a long neck, and a long sharp beak.

data.name: skittish scavenger
data.description: A scavenger willing to engage in violence to scavenge your remains.  Will run after a reasonable show of force from their would be victims.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Let's see what loot you are carrying!"

data.name: opportunistic bandit
data.description: Armed with a rifle, this bandit seems to feel quite sure of their impending victory.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "I bet you're worth a pretty penny!"

data.description: The mi-go have set up some defenses here.  This horrifying techno-organic amalgamation appears to use brains in jars as their operating system.  On the plus side it looks like an easy headshot.
The Whately family deploys mi-go style techno-organic defensive turrets.  They claim that these turrets are made from family members near death, but you have doubts.

The Wraitheon Pathfinder is a massive, house-height armored robot.  It is armed to the teeth with a 40mm anti-material grenade launcher, a 5.56 anti-personnel gun, and an electroshock capability to defend against melee strikes.  Manufactured by Wraitheon for the ESCA military, it was used along with infantry thanks to the flexibility of its reverse-jointed legs.

Designed by Wraitheon, the Regulator is effectively an automated battle tank designed for high-risk urban fighting.  Armed with an anti-material missile launcher, a 40mm grenade launcher, and several anti-personnel weapons, it's designed to match the fervor of freedom fighters with the industrial might of Earth.

The Honda Crop King.  Originally designed for agriculture, it has a trio of spiked retractable cables and where it used to mount pesticide sprayer the PrepNet Phyle have modified it to have a flamethrower for their war against the Mycus.

Clad in sable and gold armor, this luxurious combat humaniform is intended to serve as a bodyguard to society's wealthiest.  Still with its wrist sword extended, it resembles an ancient knight, standing an eternal watch.
data.//: Much lower armor than usual since this is a player allied robot only.

data.description: A small, spiked quadcopter robot equipped with a high-power spotlight.  This automated seeker drone was originally designed to harry and harass fugitives while maintaining visual contact for other pursuers.
One of the many cheaper models produced by ENIAC.  It is supposedly multi-purpose, and equipped with several tools to facilitate this; however, it is commonly used for janitorial work.

data.name: TsKBEM Likvidator
data.description: A now ancient industrial robot line first made by the Soviet TsKBEM, and still in use thanks to its easily obtained fabrication schematics.  Built to operate within nuclear reactors and waste repositories, the Likvidator is assembled around an armored bipedal chassis that mounts several heavy manipulator arms.  Legend claims it was originally designed after a nuclear disaster during early space-age Earth.

A top of the line luxury model, the Famulus is a humaniform robot, derived from Wraitheon schematics with slight alterations to give it a more human appearance.  Designed to be a robotic servant, its AI tailored for the needs of each customer, it is arguably one of the few commercial robots to pass the Turing test.

data.name: TsKBEM Udarnik
data.description:
A highly customizable light industrial and agricultural robot.  Its original design dates back to the ancient Soviet Union; the aptly named Udarnik "shock worker" was the trigger behind the automation revolution, and with subsequent adaptations, became the workhorse of early human space colonization.  Although outdated by modern standards, the Udarnik is still commonly seen in frontier worlds - thanks to its easily obtainable fabrication schematics.

This particular version is equipped with a mix of construction and heavy cargo-handling tools and was likely involved in the construction of colony buildings.

data.name: rampant Udarnik
data.description: An erratic and dangerous Udarnik that mistakenly attempts to hammer everything on its sights.  Although this corrupted robot is not built for combat, its sheer size and hydraulic strength make it extremely dangerous up close.

name.//~: Its in Russian.  Not a typo.

data.description: An ancient security drone intended to safeguard extractive outposts in hostile environments.  Its construction vaguely recalls an alien crustacean, with a single sensory oculus and four spade-like legs mounted underneath a disk of space-ship grade armor.  Zenit units can mount a wide variety of "deterrent" weapon modules, and its difficult to tell what this rogue unit is capable of.

data.name: TsKBEM Brandspojt
data.description: An old and decidedly uncommon firefighter robot of Soviet design.  Crab-like in form, its back mounts a squat water tank beneath a turreted water cannon.  While effective for its original function, the design lacks the flexibility of others from the TsKBEM, and most Brandspojt units still in existence are museum pieces.

data.name: Croplord 2SPL
data.description: Twin linked rotors allow this ubiquitous EINAC drone to comfortably hover above fields and deploy pesticides at prodigious rates.  They have no ability to detect humans within their work areas and will readily disperse lethal pesticides near them.

death_function.message: The Croplord crashes into the ground.

data.name: faulty surgical droid
data.description: A free roaming medical robot capable of administering powerful anesthetics and performing complex surgical operations, usually in that order.  Faulty bio-diagnostic programs resulted in numerous lawsuits before the Cataclysm.

data.name: rat snatcher
data.description: A small and flimsy hexapod drone that relies on sheer speed to hunt rats and other small pests.  It has either gone rampant or been maliciously reprogrammed.

data.name: grab-bot
data.description: A salvaged skitterbot repurposed to grab onto and immobilize enemies.  It's meant to work in a pack.

data.name: pest hunter
data.description: A salvaged skitterbot refitted with an 8mm integrated firearm.  The robot's small size precludes rapid-fire, due to recoil, and requires the use of lightweight caseless ammo.

A supposedly non-combat refit of Wraitheon's Imaginifer series, outfitted for crowd control and riot suppression.  This unit is outfitted with a beanbag shotgun and a taser and has been painted in the white and blue scheme of UICA's military police.
data.//: Medium instead of heavy armor, since this is a 'non-military' robot.

data.name: Wraitheon Imaginifer
data.description:
Imaginifers are Wraitheon Industries standard military humaniforms, company parlance for an android designed to seamlessly integrate into standard infantry units.  Although originally designed for UICA's expeditionary forces they are now commonly employed by any faction that can afford them.  This particular unit seems to belong to the Company itself.

Wraitheon humaniforms are designed to take full advantage of a humanoid shape, not to look human; programmed for game theory, not for sapience.

data.name: Wraitheon Hashashiyyin
data.description: An imaginifer variant of unorthodox design, the Hashashiyyin dispenses with most of its armor in favor of active-camo systems and a lightweight, more agile frame.  Commonly employed in scouting and counter-sniping roles.  This unit is equipped for close range ambush, and weilds a 35x50mm dart gun.

data.name: Wraitheon Suppressor
data.description: Looking more like a tank than a robot, the Suppressor is built to deal with vehicles (including tanks) and personnel alike.  Equipped with a 40mm grenade launcher, it can easily dispatch anything in its path.

An autonomous anti-personnel weapons platform, mounting a laser on an insectoid chassis.  The Fulgent designation excels at 'controlling' riots and (sometimes simultaneously) putting down potential freedom fighters.

data.name: Wraitheon Irradiant
data.description: An autonomous anti-armor weapons platform, mounting a 5kg plasma railgun over an insectoid chassis.  The Irradiant designation excels at ambush and midrange combat, where it can leverage its superior agility and reduced sensor profile to successfully engage technologically advanced foes.

special_attacks.description: The Irradiant emits a chilling robotic shrill as it fires its plasma railgun.
special_attacks.targeting_sound: the climbing pitch of a charging plasma railgun

data.name: Wraitheon Isohypsa
data.description: A bulky aerial drone that mounts an advanced AI overwatch unit within it bulbous carapace-like armor.  As an autonomous drone control platform, the Isohypsa is principally meant to coordinate and enhance the combat capabilities of simpler Wraitheon robots in lieu of human operators.

special_attacks.monster_message: The Isohypsa emits a rapid sequence of sibilant tones!

data.description: A microplane drone designed to seek enemy personnel before detonating at close range.
An autonomous weapons platform, made to disrupt or disable electronics - especially other robots - with an electromagnetic pulse.

data.//: A monster so that the player and other monsters can shoot at it without the need of custom AI.
data.description: A bulky device that will constantly discharge electricity in a small radius around it.
data.//2: Deliberatedly electric and not electronic, so it can be immune to electric damageand EMP.

data.description: A quadcopter drone largely comprised of a high-resolution camera lens and a speaker, this robot hovers above the ground, documenting the carnage and mayhem around it.  While it is no longer able to report to a central authority, it's likely that some of its automated alert systems are still functional, given that the thing seems to have an operational charging station somewhere.

One of the many models of armored law enforcement robots employed shortly before the collapse of civilization.  Solar powered like many other robots, it maintains its programmed pursuit of law and order, propelled on a trio of omni wheels.

A nonviolent riot-control bot, designed to suppress riots and make mass arrests of those participating.  Though its relaxation gas is by far its best-known weapon, it carries a blinding spotlight and a low-powered stungun for self-defense--in addition to a supply of electronic handcuffs.
data.//: Medium instead of heavy armor, since this is a 'non-military' robot.

data.description: Found on nearly every frontier planet, the ubiquitous TSKBEM STEED (Surface Traversing Equine Emulating Drone) is an incredibly rugged quadrupedal machine based on old Earth horses and mules.  Capable of crossing the roughest terrain, powered by a compact atomic reactor, generous storage capacity, light armor, and a lifetime warranty, the STEED is a priceless tool for prospectors and homesteaders.  This version has been ruggedized against Salus IV's extreme cold, but does not keep you warm while riding.

petfood.feed: The %s activates as you swipe the registry key.  A nearly inaudible hum is the only indication the STEED is active.

data.description: A broken STEED, it looks beyond repair.  At least the atomic core shielding should be intact.

data.name: UICA Imaginifer
data.description:
Imaginifers are Wraitheon Industries standard military humaniforms, company parlance for an android designed to seamlessly integrate into standard infantry units.  This particular unit is currently equipped with light blue UICA livery and wields a SR-P77.  Its rugged design and technological sophistication make it far more formidable than the human soldiers its nominally meant to support.

The Wraitheon humaniforms are designed to take full advantage of a humanoid shape, not to look human; programmed for game theory, not for sapience.

data.name: Parallax-3A secutor
data.description: Pitted steel and silicon will remain steadfast even after it's charge was long claimed by the unyielding cold.  Its single azure eye casts a cruel and calculating gaze upon the ruins of an universe made unfamiliar.

It walks heavily, each step resonating with the weight of its rust-bitten frame.  A single azure eye scans its surroundings with predatory hunger, and any movement is met by the destructive gaze of a grafted light-cannon.

data.name: bee bot
data.description: A salvaged utility robot converted into an AI monitored bee hive that periodically removes and delivers honey combs.

data.name: floating lantern
data.description: A salvaged drone repurposed into a mobile light source.

data.name: Scavbot Skorpion
data.description: The Scavbot Skorpion is a refurb of colonial perimeter defense bots found across many systems.  Because they are designed to defend against pirates, raiders, feral uplifts, hungry scavengers, rival mining clans, and any other enemy that is unlikely to attack with heavily armored units, these reprogrammed and refurbed versions are often found in the employ of the very types of people it was originally purposed to fight.  Often found as the core of a light patrol or attack squad.

data.name: floating heater
data.description: A salvaged eyebot repurposed into a floating space heater.  It emits a constant jet of warm air to heat an enclosed space.

The TX-5LR Cerberus is an upgrade to its predecessors.  It features a state of the art x-ray laser cannon system with three barrels.  Each barrel will fire once and be exhausted until the part can be replaced.
The Sol Systems model 12 laser turret was once a popular choice for home and business security.  It's integrated laser rifle boasts a cost-effective deterrent to any would-be trespasser.

Schwarz Walders are a bipedal uplifted animal originally developed by a German company as forest rangers for the expanded Black Forest Conservation Area.  Like all Uplifts they have a human level of intelligence and are indentured laborers to the corporation that grew and raised them, until they reach age of enfranchisement dictated by UICA regulations or they earn their citizenship early.  Shortly afterward the creation of the first Schwarz Walders it was determined that they also made excellent long range reconnaissance units that could operate independently indefinitely.  This was one of the most popular Uplift models before the Discontinuity, and many frontier planets still retain significant feral and otherwise independent populations.  They are skilled marksmen and this one appears to be armed with an SMG.
A young Schwarz Walder.  If one is out here, a very protective parent is likely nearby.

The Infeme are uplifted from apes and other near-human ancestors.  The Zulu word for monkey became the catch-all term for many species of uplifts whether majority chimp, gorilla or baboon.  Several worlds experienced a series of events similar to the old pre-spaceflight movie series 'Planet of the Apes' during the Discontinuity.
The Cecaelia were the corporate answer to the frailty of unmodified humans under the sea.  These individuals have spent a lifetime beneath the waves seeing conflicts you can't even imagine.

special_attacks.targeting_sound: "Under the water, it's an endless war."

data.description: A young Cecaelia.  If one is out here, a very protective parent is likely nearby.

An alien that appears to have evolved for survival in the depths.  Its tubular gray body bears numerous sets of paired appendages with clawed protrusions, and a pair of thick muscular fins.  You see glimpses of its shape, shifting in and out of the water.

An alien that appears to have evolved for survival in the depths.  Its tubular gray body bears numerous sets of paired appendages with clawed protrusions, and a pair of thick muscular fins.  You see glimpses of its shape, shifting in and out of the water.  It is carrying a conical object that hums with an odd keening sound.
This towering zombie is covered in wounds and shedding fur.  Once it may have prevented forest fires in national parks, now it kills anything it catches.
Imagine a gorilla.  Now imagine it dead and rotting and somehow looking at you with more hate than you had previously imagined possible.
An undead Uplifted Elephant of ginormous size.  It still wears its assault grade armor.
There is driftwood coming out of oozing wounds.  It moves towards you on a mass of writhing tentacles, black eyes like the deepest trench of the sea.

A human stands here, towering around 2 meters high.  Its flesh is frozen solid, colored black and blue from frostbite.  It constantly scratches at its flesh with its claw-like hands, surveying the land with frozen and foggy eyes.
A human stands here, its body bulging and ripped as the tissue is torn, showing bluish muscle, and gray bones.  Ice crystals jut out of its visible wounds as it wanders.
A human stands here, comically thin and scratching its scar-ridden flesh, any flesh it rips off grows back in seconds.
A human stands here, several rust-colored limbs jutting out of its back, the limbs moving around and grabbing at the air while the person looks blankly around…
A starfish-like creature stands here, covered in black metallic fur as it stands out, pointing in a specific direction.
Numerous claw-like limbs closely wrap around this alien arachnid's head and thorax, forming a protective barrier.  Its antennae twitch and writhe, and it seems to grope wildly toward threats.

The remains of a long lost colonist, shaped and rebuilt into a twisted reflection of the insectoid and canid forms.  It scuttles across the ground, looking blankly with vestigial eyes as it sniffs the air.
Unidentifiable walking remains, hunched and wandering in apparent pain.  An alien plant peeks meekly from its open mouth, leaking green liquid as its host stumbles.

messages: You dream of warm, alien winds.
You dream of landscapes lit by the light of alien moons.
You stand at the edge of a fissure into strange earth.  Mustard brown gasses caress and lift your fronds
You dream of being vivisected by humans.  One asks if the other thinks you can feel pain.
Trapped in a cage, you mimic the sounds of your guard's spawn.  He threatens you and enters the cage.  He screams, you recall.
It's your birthday.  But everyone has given you these hideous metal and plastic objects.
The stars await you, your chariot of fire is ready.  The holds are full of slaves.
You have transitioned from a dying race to a glorious future.
You have a strange dream about thundering ponderously through ancient, brittle tundras that crackle under your thick round feet.
Your dreams give you a strange, languorous, heavy feeling.

You dream of swinging your heavy head to shake the clinging snow and ice from your large, limpid brown eyes.  The weight is off, as if you had something… extra on either side of your mouth, and though you are surrounded by snow and bitter pelting winds, you feel confident and toasty-warm beneath your shaggy coat.

Your dream is a stream of shaggy loam-brown fur trailing into an ocean of punishing, icy white.  Together, you are all strong.  When you look around, you see elephantine faces looking back from all angles and you know they mirror your own.  You just… know.

You dream of your usual patient languor being interrupted by a flash of white teeth against a carmine-soaked muzzle.  In an instant a thunderous fury overtakes you and you trumpet your rage… right before you bring that trumpeting snout, bring down those heavy spears of ivory on either side of it, down upon your attacker.  They lie, bones shattered, bleeding out their red into the icy white and causing it to steam  Just like that, your calm is restored.

You dream of slowly, patiently, plodding through the world to go from goal to goal, unrushed and unworried, for you are far too large and tough to kill for anyone or anything to bother trying to attack.  And if they do… it'll be the last mistake of their life.  Waking up gives you a brief jolt of fear and dysphoria, for your body feels so weak and fragile and incorrect compared to the powerful thing you know you are.

Your thoughts within your dream may be slow, and it may take you some time to reach a conclusion, but what's the rush?  What's the hurry?  You are a huge and ancient thing with a pedigree that stretches back to a time before sapient life first had the gall to raise a sharpened stick and call itself superior.  You are huge and powerful and all that work against you shall fall.  You… you have all the time in the world, now.
Life is lonely without a family of Tusked Ones beside you, thundering as one through this desolate world in search of the hidden places.  Perhaps… perhaps you should start your family.

data.name: Esper
data.description: You are an esper, capable of accessing the hidden powers of the human mind.

data.name: Esper Legacy
data.description: One of your ancestors received noetic treatments during the Hyperspace Era and that legacy has been passed down to you…but the powers have not.  Perhaps one of your relatives does, or perhaps they do not, but you were raised with the knowledge that it was always a possibility and to avoid receiving any genetech treatments that could damage your family's esper powers.

data.name: Esper Advancement
data.description: This is the trait for the Esper scenario that lets them advance.  It exists to have a different description than Esper Legacy and is not visible during gameplay.

data.name: Electrokinesis
data.description: The ability to control electricity with your mind.

data.name: Telekinesis
data.description: The ability to move objects without touching them.

data.name: Telepathy
data.description: The ability to read thoughts and influence others' minds.
Your strength, coordination, and sensory acuity have been increased through genemod treatments.
Your concentration and memorization abilities have been increased through genemod treatments.
Your resistance to disease and infection, as well as your ability to recover from injuries, have been improved through genemod treatments.
The efficiency of your metabolic processes, from the length of your sleep cycle to losing fatigue after exercise, have been improved through genemod treatments.
Your physical appearance has been improved through genemod treatments.
A course thick matt of fur, somewhere between a ballistic vest and attic insulation.
Your dermis has toughened and thickened to provide additional protection.
Leathery and heavily armored, your lamellar skin has toughened for the fiercest battles ahead.

effect.u_message: You think about activating your immune system and your body warms with exertion.

false_effect.u_message: You are too exhausted to focus your immune system.

effect.u_message: You think quite pointedly about activating your immune system and your body hums with exertion.

false_effect.u_message: You are too exhausted to focus your immune system.

description.str: NPC trait that makes monsters see it as a PrepNet.  It is a bug if you have it.

data.description: Your mannerisms and accent are a dead giveaway that you were raised on Earth.  Whatever your thoughts about the homeworld might be, the simple fact that you can call it home is likely to affect relationships with people liable to care about such things.
You are a duly sworn law enforcement officer, with jurisdiction that technically extends to the Salus System.  Whether you can find anyone who that matters to is questionable.
You are an UICA affiliated private-security professional, with jurisdiction that technically extends to the Salus System.  Whether you can find anyone who that matters to is questionable.

You're a doctor who went out to space and has somehow ended up out on the frontier in the Salus System.  At least out here you get a lot more hands on life or death work compared to the core UICA worlds.

Some worlds maintained human life but lost technologically advanced civilization.  As these worlds get rediscovered some organizations leave the worlds to develop, while others see a source of cheap labor.  Whether you snuck onto a ship or were Shanghaied onto one you've somehow ended up on the hell that is Salus IV.  At least you have some experience surviving outside of what these spacers call 'civilization'.

You are a UICA Inspector from a civilized part of space.  You have the authority to investigate under a variety of different legal frameworks, UICA, planetary, corporate, system, pre-Discontinuity legal systems for worlds that have only recently been re-discovered.  All of this means that you are nearly a law unto yourself, though you wonder how much that matters in a place like Salus IV outside of maybe Port Augustmoon.

As a member of the Astrographic and Gatepoint Division you are responsible for spreading the boundaries of the Frontiers and protecting interstellar travel.  This gives you wide ranging latitude when it comes to addressing threats to interstellar travel.  Does this technically make you a member of UICA's very own secret police?  Yes, yes it does.

data.name: YUGGOTH
data.mutagen_message: Strange memories of another world overwhelm you…  they fade, but not before you change your genetic structure to suit them.
data.memorial_message: Prepared the way into the galaxy.

data.name: Mastodon
data.mutagen_message: You feel a desire to trumpet and toot.

data.description: Your species was created as the ultimate shock troop.  Inherit the earth, pedigree your ancestors, crush the foe.

data.name: Mi-go acclimatization
data.description: Fleshy fronds grown from your scalp function like organic heat sinks.  They allow you to live comfortably within the mi-go atmosphere.
You think you know how to instruct your body to process radioactive particles out of itself faster than normal.
You can instruct your immune system to flush out radioactive particles at an enviable speed.

data.name: Facial Tentacles
data.description: A set of tentacles surrounds your mouth.  They allow you to eat twice as fast.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

data.name: Mouth Tendrils
data.description: Skin tabs and odd flaps of skin surround your mouth.  They don't affect your eating, but are unpleasant to look at.
The immune system of these beings transcends anything seen in humanity and appear to be able to target even directed infections such as fungal infestations.

data.name: Warm Natured
data.description: Your body becomes much more efficient at distributing heat from itself.
Your skin has thickened and toughened further, acting as natural armor.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

Your skin has thick diamond shaped enamel scutes that both armor your body and allow you to move more smoothly in water.  While difficult to penetrate, it also limits your flexibility.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Neural Improvement
data.description: You see the world a little differently today.  Intelligence + 1

data.name: Expanded Consciousness
data.description: You are beginning to see a way off this planet.  Intelligence + 2

data.name: Uplifted Consciousness
data.description: As humans uplifted our pets in the final years this process is lifting you to a new level of intelligence.  Intelligence + 4

data.name: Alien Intelligence
data.description: You can see the connections from A to B to C to D.  You look at fellow survivors like you are imagining taking them apart.  Intelligence + 5

data.name: Enhanced Reactions
data.description: Today is the day to start juggling.  Dexterity + 1

data.name: Quickening
data.description: You are starting to move like they do.  Dexterity + 2

data.name: Otherworldly Grace
data.description: You no longer move like a human, others find it disconcerting.  Dexterity + 4

data.name: New Muscles
data.description: You see some new muscles that you aren't sure you've seen on humans before.  Strength + 1

data.name: Muscle Fiber
data.description: Fibrous tissue seems to be spreading through your body.  Strength + 2

data.name: Mi-go Ears
data.description: Your ears have split into a series of tuberous projections.  They waggle towards far away sounds.

data.name: Detachment
data.description: When were you ever like these creatures, helpless before the changes ravaging this world.

data.name: Eldritch
data.description: You have a sinister aspect to your demeanor, no longer part of this world.  You feel no sorrow at the deaths of humans and your brain now processes combat skills more efficiently as you mentally dissect your opponents.

data.name: YUGGOTH
data.description: The death throes of this world are the birthing pangs of yours.

data.name: Fetid scent
data.description: Your sweat now smells otherworldly, and not in a good way.  The mi-go still hate you but at least they aren't offended by your smell.

data.name: Eerie
data.description: You are off-putting to others.  Your mannerisms have changed as if human interaction is becoming foreign.

data.name: Mi-go Wings
data.description: You have a pair of large, veiny wings.  They don't appear to be made for this atmosphere but they grant a powerful buffeting attack.

data.name: Mi-go breathe
data.description: You can now breathe the gasses the mi-go thrive in.

data.name: Uplifted
data.description: You come from uplifted animal stock.  This decreases morale penalties for being wet.

data.name: Hauler
data.description: You are capable of carrying far more than someone with similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is increased by 60%.

data.name: Patched Fur
data.description: Your skin has patches of light fur.  This has no impact on your life except marking you as not fully human.
Your fur has grown out and thickened, providing great protection from attacks as well as considerable insulation.

data.name: Crushing Feet
data.description: Your feet have grown massive and ready to support huge weight.  This allows kicking attacks to do much more damage, provides natural armor, and removes the need to wear shoes; however, you cannot wear normal size shoes.  Reduces wet effects.

attacks.attack_text_u: You kick %s with your massive feet

data.name: Face Bumps
data.description: You have a pair of bumps on your face above your mouth and beside your nose.

data.name: Tusks
data.description: You have a pair of small tusks on your face.  They allow you to make a weak piercing goring attack.

data.name: Pointed Tusks
data.description: You have a pair of long, pointed tusks, like someone weaponized an elephant.  They allow you to make a strong piercing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing mouthgear that is not made of fabric.

attacks.attack_text_u: You stab %s with your pointed tusks!

data.description: Your face resembles that of an elephant, with a significant trunk.  It looks fierce but prevents wearing mouthgear.  Prehensile and able to perform some fine detail work.

data.name: Three Fingered
data.description: Your hands have fused into three-fingered paws.  Fine manipulation is a challenge: permanent hand encumbrance of 10, difficulty with delicate craftwork, and your gloves don't fit.  But they handle water better.

data.name: Trumpeting Voice
data.description: You have a trumpeting, elephantine voice.  Threatening NPCs will be easier, but lying will be very hard.
Genetic tampering made your body incredibly strong.  Strength + 7.
An experimental cryosleep procedure has permanently altered your body, allowing you to better tolerate cold temperatures.

data.name: Empathic Leadership
data.description: You have a natural talent for leadership and can easily see yourself in others.  Quite literally.  In fact, you can swap control to any other character that follows you.
You took the bionic skullgun out of your noggin, but that didn't replace the brain cells you lost when you installed it.

dynamic_line.gendered_line: Now try not to do whatever you did again.  No, don't tell me more.

concatenate.no: This might not be a very private place.
concatenate.yes: This feels like a good place to relax.  Want to play doctor with real scalpels?
This place is so boring.  We should take people and kill some drugs.
Water water everywhere.  Let's go skinny dipping.  I bet you'll attract some leeches.  I need them for something I want to do to you.  It'll be so weird.

I like it down here.  This reminds me of that time I was down in a place like this and someone creeped up behind me and hit me in the back of the head with a shovel.  *shiver*  It still gives me goosebumps.

I love nature.  It smells so good out here, like living things growing and multiplying and dying and returning from the dead with horrifying new powers and trying to slowly rip us apart and eat us.  It brings back really happy memories for me.
I love swampy places like this.  The smell of the pussy willows, the sound of the crickets, the giant mutant mosquitoes hungry for our blood.  It's like we're in a sexy vampire romance novel.
What a beautiful facility.  I bet they have all kinds of lovely toys to play with.  We should kill everyone here and do some creative self-experimentation.
Ooh, it's like a murder mystery here.  Are we the murderers, the murdered, or the mystery?

data.dynamic_line: What level of hell is this?  I spent weeks in a sulfurous hell being tortured.
Then they started cutting me open and taking out my organs but adding new ones.
Now that I finally am able to move and have some freedom, I plan on finding some of these demons and punching through them until I find the devil himself.
I heard the song before the aliens captured me.  I did what I could to help the other Bonesingers.
One day I was being chased by some aliens and suddenly I was ambushed by another one that shot me with some kind of pain ray.
Eventually they took the bones from my body.  It's strange though, I still hear the song calling to me, even in this new body.
I just spent what felt like weeks in a dream that I was acting as a targeting computer for some kind of alien turret.
Now I'm in some kind of Mary Shelley nightmare?  I mean at least I have mobility.

responses.text: What does that have to do with anything?

data.dynamic_line: I'm going to keep going with this dream, hopefully soon I'll get to one where I can fly.
Antes do Cataclisma eu era o cientista que encabeçava um laboratório militar no meu país.  Foram dias difíceis…

Nós estávamos pesquisando um remédio que curasse um virus altamente letal na época, mas os resultados dos testes mostravam que o remédio era mais letal do que o próprio virus.  Então, ao invés de recolherem os remédios das prateleiras, eles nos forçaram a vendê-lo como sendo a cura para o vírus.
Bem… aqueles sem cérebro seguiram cegamente o líder.  Quanto àqueles com algum cérebro… bom, acho que você está conversando com um deles agora
Things have been getting weird for the last couple of years.  Then we started hearing rumors of strange lights in the sky at night.
One night I heard my neighbor calling for me to come help him.  I went outside wondering what he could possibly need my help with in the middle of the night.

Some kind of hideous alien was standing over my neighbors disemboweled corpse.  It looked at me and said 'You're a great neighbor' then everything faded to black.  I feel like everything in my body fits differently now.

I worked in a top secret lab.  Things kept getting crazier and crazier outside and the scientists inside started making desperate experiments.  They worked on something called interdimensional portals.
The eggheads kept saying we needed to find a way out of here before everything went sideways.  So we needed to open more portals even if we hadn't had time to take all the precautions.

One day they opened a portal trying to find an earthlike planet and suddenly portals were opening all over the lab and these fast and dangerous aliens overwhelmed the lab.  They killed most of the staff and took the rest prisoner.
Monsters!  Monsters everywhere.  Everyone is suspect, how do I know you aren't a monster?
You can't trust anyone these days.  Everyone is either a cannibal or a monster or a government spook.

responses.text: Why would you trust me then?

data.dynamic_line: Because, what if I'm the monster?
If you think this Universe is bad, you should see some of the others.
Believing something existed and then finding out it didn't was like reaching the top of the stairs and thinking there was one more step.

responses.text: What does that have to do with anything?

data.dynamic_line: I think a lot of psychopaths are just geniuses who drove so fast that they lost control.
